name: Night Trail Run (Sollentuna) — Hundtrail / 5 km & 10 km
description: Night Trail Run is a nighttime trail race focused on the experience and the magic of the dark. Dog Trail is a special class where you can share the evening with your dog over 5 km or 10 km, on courses designed to make for a memorable evening in the forest. The event emphasises safety in the dark: the courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is required. All proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: Courses marked with reflective markers
Flexible start time: 18:00–19:30 (10 km until 19:00)
Two distances for runners with dogs: 5 km and 10 km
additional: Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (10 km runners can start until 19:00). The courses are marked with reflective markers and a headlamp is mandatory. The event is for runners who want to run with their dog (5 km and 10 km). Flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30 (10 km until 19:00); courses marked with reflective markers; headlamp required.

name: Hellasloppet
description: Hellasloppet is a family-friendly running event at Hellasgården in Nacka, welcoming runners of all ages and abilities. The races pass through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills on lovely running trails and roads, with short courses for children and longer options for recreational runners. The youngest runners have a relatively flat course, and the event is designed as an enjoyable day with music, refreshments and prize-giving ceremonies. It is described as a local, friendly family race with plenty of parking and bicycle parking.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Hellas area, by lakes and over hills
Lovely running trails and sections on roads—mixed terrain
Three distances: 400 m (the MICA race), 1,400 m and 5 km
additional: Location: Hellasgården, Ältavägen 101, Nacka; the bus from Slussen is listed as a transport option. There is plenty of parking and bicycle parking by the start area. Prize-giving ceremonies take place throughout the event, and refreshments will be available. The MICA race (400 m) is part of Hellasloppet. Distances include 400 m, 1,400 m, 5 km and 7.5 km, as well as a 1.5 km walking loop. Bus from Slussen to Hellasgården; plenty of parking around the start area and space to park bicycles in the start area; refreshments will be available.

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race consists of eight laps around Lake Växjö on what the organizer calls “Sweden’s fastest course.” The course is very flat (approximately 3 m of elevation difference) and mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. A relay and a children’s race are also offered, and the course is marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Lake Växjö
Very flat course, approximately 3 m of elevation difference
Mostly paved, with about 300 m of fine gravel; marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed to other users, so runners share the pedestrian and cycle paths with walkers and cyclists; motor traffic is encountered at three points along the course. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. Teams can take part in the relay, and the event also includes a children’s race in 2026. The relay consists of four runners, each running two laps. The course remains open to pedestrians and cyclists, and runners share the space with them and with motor traffic at three points.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The courses are gently undulating and feature a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain and running on sand along the coast—participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race suits both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also includes team competitions. The participant cap is 1,000.
course_highlights: Gently undulating terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging hills and sections of running on sand by the sea
17 km: approximately 60% trail, 25% terrain and 15% beach; elevation gain approximately 310 m
Event venue at Strandridaregården, only approximately 100 metres from the sea
additional: Participant cap: 1,000. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children’s race starts individually from 13:00 to 15:00. Bib distribution from 10:45 (collect your bib at least one hour before your start). Time limit: the finish closes 2 hours 50 minutes after the 17 km start (at 15:30); the final 6 km lap must be started at least 60 minutes before the finish closes. Venue: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and parking is permitted only as directed by officials (carpooling tips are available via the race’s Facebook group). Bag storage is available for a fee (20 kr, cash or Swish). Children’s race with a medal and no entry fee; online registration closes on the Wednesday before the race; late registration is available at the start and finish area; bibs must be collected by 10:45; parking near the venue is limited; refreshments are available at all stations; electronic timing, with times available online.

name: Uppsala Marathon (inkl. DM i marathon)
price_range: Maraton: 825 kr; Halvmaraton: 625 kr; Stafett (4 deltagare): 1800 kr
description: Uppsala Marathon is a city and nature marathon that runs through historic Uppsala, starting and finishing at Uppsala Castle. The race combines the lively atmosphere of central Uppsala with scenic views along Lake Ekoln, the Fyris River and the mounds of Gamla Uppsala. The event offers a marathon, half marathon and four-person relay, and also serves as the District Championships (DM) in the marathon. The race is spectator-friendly and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Uppsala Castle; passes Carolina Rediviva and the central pedestrian streets
The route runs along the shores of Lake Ekoln and the Fyris River and out towards the mounds of Gamla Uppsala
Flat, fast, single-loop course consisting of half asphalt and half hard-packed gravel
additional: Start and finish at Uppsala Castle. The start area opens at 07:00; bib pickup is available from 1–16 October at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 4–6) and on race day, 17 October, from 07:30 (no later than 45 minutes before the start). Registration is accepted via RaceID, and Epassi can be used for payment. Maximum entries: Marathon 1,500, Half Marathon 2,500, Marathon Relay 150 teams. Everyone who registers by 15 September 2026 will have their name on their bib. Minimum age is 17 for the marathon/half marathon (born in 2009 or earlier). The prize ceremony takes place at the finish area at 13:00. Food and non-alcoholic drinks are available at the finish area; relay teams receive a finisher shirt and medal. The recommendation is to travel by public transport or bicycle (Slottsbacken or Blåsenhus bus stops, routes 2 and 7); parking is within walking distance. DM medals are awarded in the Marathon and Half Marathon; the medal ceremony is on the Tuesday after the race; minimum age is 17 for the marathon/half marathon; Epassi payment, transfers via RaceID, start times, transport and parking, bag drop, changing rooms/showers, insurance and prizes; registration is open until 12 October 2026, with the possibility of closing earlier if the entry limit is reached.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a friendly race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) are offered. The organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap; 10 km = 2 laps
The course is officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and qualifies for seeding
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. The 5K is one lap and the 10K is two laps. Pacers carrying flags will be available for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. You can register up to 5 runners at a time through the regular registration; group registration is available for more runners. Team registration (three people) gives a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. Race bibs are not sent out. The course and course profile are shown on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: 17 October 2026, starting at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K is one lap and 10K is two laps; aid stations will offer UMARA sports drink and water; bag drop at the start/finish; parking garages nearby; start list and pacer information; limited bag-drop facilities and race-bib collection on site.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race features a marked 5 km loop over varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class; the 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails and marshland
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum
additional: Muddy, challenging terrain; registration via the website, with payment by card or Swish on site; parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Night Trail Run 30 km
description: Night Trail Run in October offers evening trail races focused on the experience of light meeting darkness. Choose 5 km, 10 km or 30 km, starting and finishing at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. For the 30 km, you navigate using a downloadable GPS route and map, and there are energy stations along the way. Sign up today—all proceeds go to youth sports at Attunda Orienteering Club.
course_highlights: A night trail race by headlamp, with the course marked by reflectors
The 30 km route is run using a GPS route and map and has two energy stations
The final section of the 30 km follows the same reflector-marked course as the 5/10 km
additional: For the 5 km and 10 km, you can start at any time within the stated windows (18:00–19:30 for the 5 km; 18:00–19:00 for the 10 km). For the 30 km, you receive a GPS route and map in advance; the race has two energy stations and a time limit of 4 hr 30 min. The final section follows the reflector-marked course. The start and finish are at Väsby gård in Sollentuna. The organizer asks participants to finish by 20:30 at the latest, and registration is open until one hour before each start. The 30 km starts at 16:00 on October 17, 2026. The 5 km has a flexible start time between 18:00 and 19:30, and the 10 km between 18:00 and 19:00; the course follows the reflector-marked route to the finish.

name: Stockholms Brantaste
description: Stockholm’s Steepest is an intense hill race in Hammarbybacken, taking place on 17 October 2026. The race is just over 3–3.5 km long, with a steep climb and more than 200 metres of elevation gain. It welcomes both experienced runners and beginners looking to challenge themselves. The finish is at the top of the hill, with a great view over the city. The children’s races, Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta, are also offered, but registration may be closed at certain times.
course_highlights: Approx. 3–3.5 km with more than 200 metres of elevation gain
Up and down the steep slopes of Hammarbybacken; finish at the top with a view over the city
Intense hill-focused race (finish-line services and water stations along the course)
additional: Race confirmation is sent by email (usually about 2 weeks before the race, or sooner for late registration). Bib distribution is listed as taking place in the event area on Hammarby Fabriksväg (the information text specifies bib distribution) and opens from 09:30 according to participant information. The bib contains a chip and should be worn unfolded at a 45–90° angle; attach it with safety pins (bring about 4) and write your name, phone number and medical information on the back. The race includes timing, a medal and water stations; the children’s races have water at the finish and a medal. Registration for Brantaste Mini and Brantaste Minsta may be closed at certain times. Free hill-training sessions in Hammarbybacken are held before race day.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal, where each lap is 6,706 metres. The format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start at the top of every hour, for up to 12 laps in total. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The competitor who completes the most laps—and is fastest on the final lap—wins the women’s or men’s class. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical but runnable loop in scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate afternoon start time.
course_highlights: A 6,706 m lap starting and finishing at Bubblan in Toredal
Approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the waterfront path around Garnudden
Several longer climbs, a final downhill section, and a flat asphalt stretch toward the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens on 1 March 2026. Rönninge 6h (6 June 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration is via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, with on-site registration. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se by 1 October, with an administrative fee of SEK 45. The race has hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, and so on; the final start is at 20:00. Laps are recorded with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Refreshments are served at 20:00 for the final lap. Race details: 6,706 m per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, final start at 20:00; approximately 80% asphalt and gravel; women’s and men’s classes. Mini Backyard is organised by KIF Toredal, and the on-site fee is SEK 50.

name: Täby Halvmarathon
description: Täby Half Marathon is a fast, easy-to-run half marathon through beautiful natural surroundings, starting and finishing at Näsby Slott. The course offers coastal views along the shores of Värtan, a scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, and a final stretch back by the sea with views towards Bogesundslandet. The race is officially measured and organised by Täby IS Friidrott, and is ideal for runners looking to end the season on a fast and scenic course. In previous years, the race has been very popular, with limited places, so the organisers encourage early registration.
course_highlights: The first ~5 km follow the shores of Värtan, with sea views
A scenic loop around Lake Rönninge, passing Ängsholmsbadet and Skavlöten outdoor recreation centre
Approximately 125 metres of elevation gain; roughly 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel
additional: Start and finish at Näsby Slott. Lilla TäbyMaran for children aged 5–11 (1.2 km), with start times at 10:00 (born 2017–2020) and 10:15 (born 2014–2016). Sports drink from partner Umara is served at the aid stations. The half marathon has a cut-off time of 2 hours 45 minutes. Race bib collection: at Stadium in Täby Centrum from the Wednesday before the race, and at the start area from 09:00–10:45 on race day. The course has approximately 125 metres of elevation gain and is roughly 2/3 asphalt and 1/3 gravel road; aid stations along the course serve Umara. Previous capacity: approximately 1,500 places.

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen — perhaps the fastest officially measured 10 km race of the autumn, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course is 100% on cycle and pedestrian paths and fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for runners chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Officially measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% paved cycle and pedestrian paths — a very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
additional: Changing rooms are available on site, but the organizer recommends that participants arrive changed. On-the-day registration is possible if the race is not full. The organizer does not award medals and instead donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for each registered runner. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, plus a draw for approximately 20 prizes. Names and photos from race day may be published on the club’s website and social media. Contact details: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Registration deadline: 15 October; on-the-day registration is possible if places are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medals will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be drawn among all participants; contact details are provided in the text on the event page.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet returns in 2026 with a new, city-side course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is 18 October, and the routes are designed to be easy-running urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.
course_highlights: A new route that mostly follows walking and cycling paths through residential areas
Passes the Södra Ryd church ruins, Vadsboleden, Aspö, Havstena and Billingen/Dälderna
Start and finish at the small car park by the tennis hall at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde
additional: All distances start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde (the small car park by the tennis hall). The race office can accept late entries subject to availability until 30 minutes before the start; entries may be accepted from 08:30 on race day. Parking is available at Billingehov’s large car park. Valuables can be handed in at bib collection and reclaimed by showing your race bib. Terrain: a city-side course on walking and cycling paths. Start/finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde. Distances: 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. Parking at Billingehov’s large car park. GPX files are available. Course information may change.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race through overgrown woodland with natural obstacles in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area in Haninge. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometre distances, with muddy sections, trail paths and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both experienced runners and beginners who don’t mind getting dirty and muddy. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race. The event is organised by Marathongruppen, with any surplus going back to sport.
course_highlights: Overgrown woodland and natural obstacles
Muddy sections and challenging terrain
Trail paths in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area, Haninge
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 2 September; otherwise, they can be collected at the venue from 08:30. Race bibs are personal and must be worn with the timing chip. After the race, warm showers are available in tents, along with basic rinse-off facilities. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Travel by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Transfer of a starting place to another person is possible for a fee until 24 September. The event also includes children’s races and often takes place alongside other cross-country races. Information about registration, parking and start times is available.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description:
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-
Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organised by Enhörna IF in Södertälje. The race starts and finishes at Enhörna Friluftsgård and offers several categories for children, young people and adults. It is a well-established competition with a long tradition, where participants can enjoy a varied and scenic course. The event is open to everyone and follows the competition rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: A combination of road and cross-country running
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård (sports ground)
Several distances and categories for children, young people and adults
additional: Late registration on site is possible until 60 minutes before each start, for an additional fee of SEK 100 for adult categories and SEK 50 for youth categories. Start times for youth categories are 11:00, 11:10 and 11:35, and for adult categories 12:30. By registering, participants consent to the publication of their names and any photos on the website and social media. Road and cross-country running, different distances for children, young people and adults, registration by 4 April, late registration on site until 60 minutes before the start

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running race held in Råda, starting and finishing at Rådåsgården in Lidköping. The races take place on scenic exercise trails in Rådaskogen and offer several distances of up to 16.7 km, suited to different age groups and recreational categories. Umara sports drink is served during the race to give runners extra energy. Paprikaloppet for the youngest children is held earlier in the autumn in collaboration with Ica Hjertberg. Join us for an enjoyable, well-organised running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Scenic exercise trails in Rådaskogen
Start and finish at Rådåsgården in Lidköping
Umara sports drink served during the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 11/10 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 7:30. Timing is provided by C-time. Registration is through RaceID until 9:30 on race day; there is no separate on-site late registration. Distances for runners in the Västsvenska Löparcupen vary according to age and category. The race takes place on exercise trails in Rådaskogen; registration is through RaceID; Umara sports drink is served; registration is open until 11 October; the start and finish are at Rådåsgården.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälan via formuläret på hemsidan stänger fredag 26 september klockan 23.59

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan till Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C är helt gratis

description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a challenging race held at the classic Yxbacken outside Norrköping. The race consists of five laps, each featuring a tough climb of 100 metres of elevation over 350 metres, followed by a descent on the family slope. Participants can choose to run with or without timing. Poles are allowed, but runners using them are not included in the timed category. After the race, participants are treated to food and drinks as well as a free leg massage, and everyone receives a medal as proof of their achievement.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the foot of Pernilla Wiberg’s home slope, Yxbacken
5 laps with a 100-metre climb over 350 metres on each lap
A descent on the family slope between each climb
additional: Race bibs can be collected at XXL on Friday 3 October between 14:00 and 18:00. Late registration is available via the website until 1 October and on site with payment by Swish. Water is available at the start and finish area. Manheims Säteri provides food and drinks after the race, Fenix Brewery provides non-alcoholic beer, and Finspångs Brunnsborrning provides sports drinks. Free leg massage is offered before and after the race. Professional chip timing uses a chip attached to the race bib. Toilets and a staffed bag drop are available at the event area. The event takes place in October and features challenging terrain with steep hills and multiple laps, making it a popular and challenging race for adventurous runners.

name: Stockholm: ALL OUT
description: All Out Dubstep is a long-running and influential club night in Stockholm that has shaped the city’s club music scene for almost two decades. With a unique mix of sub-bass, mutated garage, hip-hop, electro and techno, the resident DJs create an atmosphere that stretches from Kingston to London. The event also celebrates birthdays with a diverse line-up of DJs and artists playing everything from dancehall to afro and samba. It’s a party for everyone who loves club music and the vibrant energy of the dance floor.
course_highlights: Deep sub-bass and mutated garage at its core
A mix of hip-hop, electro and techno, with influences from Kingston and London
A broad range of music, from dancehall to afro and samba
additional: Free entry between 15:00 and 18:00, then admission from 200 kr. The event runs from 15:00 to 03:00 and is held at Capital Sound System in Kvarteret / Hus 7, Styckmästargatan 10, Stockholm. Music, club, dubstep, techno, hip-hop, afro, samba, dancehall, pre-party

name: Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Kilterrängen
description: Are you one of those who prefer trails to asphalt? Whether you’re a curious beginner, a recreational runner or an elite runner, Kilterrängen is for you. The 16 or 6 km trail race takes place in autumnal Kil, with a few tough final kilometres full of hills, including the notorious ski slope.

images.alt_text: Deltagare i terrängloppet Kilterrängen löper längs en sjö under hösten.
Löpare i terränglopp med sjö och höstlöv i bakgrunden.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Set along the rocky shores of Sweden's Kullaberg, Kullamannen by UTMB® offers trail courses that range from a fast 20 km to a challenging 100-mile test of endurance. Runners traverse rocky headlands, beech and pine forests, and coastal paths with dramatic ocean views, making it an adventure-focused event for trail runners of varying ambitions. The event weekend combines technical coastal terrain, well-supported aid stations and organised race services to welcome both international and local participants.
course_highlights: Rocky coastal trails and cliffs along Kullaberg with ocean views
Runs through beechwood and pine forest singletrack and compact dirt trails
North Shore 20K features narrow beachside paths and a night start (headlamp required)
additional: Minimum ages: North Shore open to runners born in 2010 or before. Registration sales windows: UTMB Index holders 18 - 20 Nov 2025 (exclusive), open to all from 20 Nov 2025 until 10 Oct 2026 or until sold out. Registration includes race bib, access to aid stations, baggage transport depending on distance, medical assistance and after-race services. Transfer to a shorter distance allowed until 3 weeks before the event (deadline: 2026-10-10). Bib distribution and expo in Båstad on the event weekend. Races range from 22 km to 100 miles; start in Höganäs, via Mölle and Kullaberg, finish in Båstad; November weather can be tough; DNF rate 40-60% for 100-milers; Running Stone lottery and direct qualification for the UTMB World Series Finals.

name: Halloweenloppet
description: Trail race in the dark.

images.alt_text: Belysta skyltar 5 km och 10 km vid mörkt terränglopp.
Deltagare springer på en stig i mörker med pannlampor på Halloweenloppet.
Deltagare med pannlampor springer en mörk skogsstig under Halloweenloppet.

name: Finalloppet Göteborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Parvelbanan, ca 250 m, anmälan endast på plats tävlingsdagen. 40 kr

description: Finalloppet is western Sweden’s largest cross-country race. It has been organised by Göteborgs Skidklubb since 1968 and is held at Skatås Motionscentrum in Gothenburg. The event offers several distances (19 km, 10 km, 5.3 km, 2.3 km and 1.9 km, as well as Paraloppet and Parvelbanan) for both competitive and recreational runners. The courses alternate between technical trail sections and wider forest roads, and are marked with clear arrows and kilometre markers. The organiser brings the finish area and services together at the event venue at Skatås and provides water stations, medical care and a sweep crew on all courses.
course_highlights: The 19 km course has an advanced trail section of approximately 2,500 metres
The 10 km course includes a trail section just over 500 metres long that is often wet, muddy and rocky
The courses are marked with orange arrows and coloured kilometre markers; the leading groups are guided by a cyclist
additional: Registration is handled via RaceID (payment by card, Swish or Google Pay and Mobile BankID). You can register several people at the same time and buy gift cards via RaceID. The organiser offers Startklar insurance as an optional add-on, which reimburses the entry fee in the event of illness, injury or pregnancy. The event venue is at Skatås Motionscentrum, with finish and service tents, a medical tent at the finish, and medical staff at certain water stations (Ugglemossen and Svarttjärn). The sweep crew sets off after the last start for each course and is responsible for runners still on the course. Donate 50 kronor to Jontefonden when registering; a GPX file is available to download for the 19 km course.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The event offers several distances for adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and children’s and youth classes. The courses run partly on trails and partly off-trail, with challenging hills such as Strutsabacken, where the Bergatroll title is awarded to the fastest runner up the hill. The event is family-friendly, with changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and safety staff along the course.
course_highlights: A tough, very hilly trail race, partly on trails and partly off-trail
Strutsabacken (the ski slope), a challenging hill with the Bergatroll competition
Aid stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs with timing chips can be collected on race day by 11:15 at the latest and must be worn visibly on the front of your shirt. Chip timing records both finish time and the time taken to run up Strutsabacken. Aid stations on various distances provide water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the IKHP lodge. Valuables can be handed in and collected at race-bib pickup. Safety staff and Red Cross medical personnel will be on site. Children’s and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400 m Knattetrollen has a free start time between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and the Bergatroll, and safety measures including medical support.

name: Höstmilen
description: Höstmilen is a trail race in the Kolmården forests outside Åby, north of Norrköping, taking place on 1 November 2026. The course follows trails between Sörsjön and Lillsjön and offers scenic, challenging terrain for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The event is organised by OK Kolmården and has three main race options: the classic 10.6 km, Höstfemman 5.2 km, and races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Trail race on paths between Sörsjön and Lillsjön
Höstmilen 10.6 km (Sörsjön → Lillsjön) and Höstfemman 5.2 km (start/finish at Lillsjön)
Running through the scenic, hilly terrain of the Kolmården forests
additional: Online registration closes on 29 October at 23:00; after that, it is possible to register on 31 October from 11:00 to 14:00 at XXL and at the start area on 1 November. For the classic Höstmilen, a bus runs from Jurslaskolan to the start at Sörsjön. The race information sheet will be published approximately one week before the event. The adult races have just two prize categories: Men and Women. A complete list of registered participants will be published on the “Registered” page. Distances and competition formats are 10.6 km, 5.2 km and children’s races (1.4 or 2.0 km); team, company and school competitions. The Höstmilen race information sheet and registration are available via hostmilen.nu.

name: Energiruset
organizer: IF Göta Karlstad och Karlstads Energi
description: Energiruset is an evening race in Mariebergsskogen, organised in collaboration between IF Göta and Karlstads Energi. The race takes place on Thursday, 5 November 2026, and is family-friendly, with a choice of distances of 2 km and 5 km. The 5 km distance has a competitive category for those who want to test themselves; much of the course runs through woodland, and some sections are unlit. After finishing, all participants are treated to a hot dog by the organisers.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mariebergsskogen, including woodland.
Some sections of the course are unlit; a headlamp is recommended.
Distances: 2 km and 5 km; the 5 km has a competitive category.
additional: Date and location: Mariebergsskogen, Thursday, 5 November 2026. You can buy a headlamp when registering. Practical information (chip collection and exact start times) will be published on the organiser’s website. A previous race briefing is available as a PDF: https://ifgota.se/files/PM_ER_2025.pdf. After the race, IF Göta and Karlstads Energi will treat participants to a hot dog. The course will be open during the evening for non-competitive participants, who can start within a specified time window. The start times are tentatively around 18:00.

name: Jämjöhalvan och Jämjöhallenstafetten
location: Jämjö, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden
price_range: Jämjöhalvan 21,1 km: 300 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 400 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 10 km: 250 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 350 kr (3/10-2/11); Jämjöhalvan 5 km: 200 kr (4/6-2/10) eller 300 kr (3/10-2/11); Barnlopp 50 kr; Jämjöhallenstafetten: 600 kr per lag (4/6-2/11).
description: Jämjöhalvan is a mass-participation race organized by Team Blekinge LF, with distances ranging from a children’s race to a half marathon, as well as a relay (Jämjöhallenstafetten). The half marathon and other races take place on a fast, spectator-friendly loop course around Jämjö and can also be used as qualifying races for events such as Göteborgsvarvet. The event centre and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum, and in 2026 the Swedish Veterans Championships in the half marathon will be held alongside the race. Runners of all abilities are welcome—the event emphasizes running community and clearly marked laps.
course_highlights: Loop course: 4 laps for the half marathon, 2 laps for 10 km, 1 lap for 5 km
Fast, spectator-friendly course around Jämjö
Distances are officially measured (measured 25 Sep 2021), and course marshals are stationed along the route
additional: The start, finish and event centre are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Start locations vary by distance. The half marathon and Jämjöhallenstafetten start at 10:30, the 10 km at 10:40, the 5 km at 10:45 and the children’s race (500 m) at 12:45. Runners must keep to the right and pass on the left; runners who are not running at a fast pace are asked to keep right. In the relay, teams hand over a baton in the exchange area near the lap point; late registration is not available for Jämjöhallenstafetten. Late registration for other distances is open on race day from 08:00 to 10:00 at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. Payment is accepted in cash or via Swish. Start times: 21.1 km and Jämjöhallenstafetten 10:30, 10 km 10:40, 5 km 10:45, 5 km youth class (ages 12–16) 10:45, children’s race 12:45. Start locations vary by distance. There is no late registration for Jämjöhallenstafetten. The start and finish are at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum. The course is a loop with water stations every 5 km, in cooperation with Umara. Changing facilities and showers are available at Jämjö Kunskapscentrum from approximately 09:00. Free open training sessions are held on 17 September and 15 October before race day.

name: Skanneloppet
price_range: Fram till 7 oktober: 17,3 km 200 kr; 7,6 km 150 kr; 3,9 km 100 kr. 8 oktober – 24 oktober: 17,3 km 300 kr; 7,6 km 200 kr; 3,9 km 150 kr. 25 oktober – 5 november: 17,3 km 400 kr; 7,6 km 300 kr; 3,9 km 250 kr.
description: Skanneloppet is organised by IS Skanne and takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, starting and finishing at Tingvalla Nöjespalats in Åstorp. The race is run individually, with approximately ten runners starting per minute, and offers three courses for both elite runners and recreational participants. The courses are hilly and run mostly on gravel roads, with sections of asphalt and off-road trails. The race is suitable for both young and old. Information about registration and start lists will be published on the organiser’s website.
course_highlights: Three distances: Red 17.3 km, Blue 7.6 km and Green 3.9 km
Hilly terrain—mostly gravel roads, with sections of asphalt and off-road trails; particularly hilly at the beginning
Water stations are marked on the map (yellow circles)
additional: Bib collection from 08:00 on race day; find your bib number in the start list inside Tingvalla and collect it yourself. No on-site registration. Registration closes on 5 November. Those who register before 24 October will have their name printed on their bib. Start times are between 10:00 and approximately 11:05, with around ten runners starting per minute. The courses are hilly; the 17.3 km and 7.6 km courses include sections of off-road trails, asphalt roads and gravel roads, while the 3.9 km course is entirely on gravel roads and off-road trails. No showers or changing facilities; toilets are available. A commemorative plaque is awarded to everyone who finishes; commemorative medals are awarded after 5, 10, 20, 30 and 40 completed races. Contact: skanneloppet@isskanne.se, Diana Nilsson 070-847 73 47, Torbjörn Persson 0702-90 23 40.

images.alt_text: IS Skanne-logotyp från inbjudan till Skanneloppet.
Löpare vid start och mål för Skanneloppet i Åstorp.

name: Höstrusket
description: Höstrusket is a trail and road race in Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, taking place on 7 November 2026. Choose from 10 km, half marathon (21.1 km) or marathon (42.195 km), with the start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen. The race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners, and features encouraging pacers, well-stocked aid stations and an atmospheric end to the running season in the Royal National City Park. The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs, and the surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Fisksjöängsvägen in Norra Djurgården (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station)
Certified courses, mostly on asphalt with some gravel; 10 km: +103.9 m, marathon: total elevation gain +439 m
Well-stocked aid stations and lap support, as well as clearly marked kilometre signs
additional: Start/finish at Fisksjöäng (approx. 800 m from Ropsten metro station). Bib collection, pacer tent, food and coffee sales, bag drop for warm-up clothes and toilets at the event area. Changing and shower facilities are available at a nearby venue for a fee, a few hundred metres away. Chip timing by RaceTimer; pacers are available for several finish times (lists by distance). Cut-off times: 10 km 2:00, half marathon 2:30, marathon 5:30 (cut-off at the final lap point at 13:40). Minimum ages: 10 km from age 15 (age 13 when accompanied by a guardian); half marathon and marathon from age 17. Some aids and vehicles (poles, inline skates, strollers, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs) are not permitted; special conditions apply for guides and wheelchair users. The surplus goes back to sport. Registration is open.

name: Kroppefjäll Trailrun

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 900 meter: 0 kr för de allra minsta

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 350 kr för ungdom under 18 år

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: 10,5 km: 550 kr för ungdom under 18 år

description: Kroppefjäll Trailrun is an evening race at Kroppefjäll B&B in Dals Rostock, offering runners three main distance options (42 km, 21 km and 10.5 km) in two-person teams, as well as a children’s race around the pond. The course is technical terrain with plenty of singletrack and natural trails, and the race has a relaxed, adventurous atmosphere with no official timing. After the finish, participants can use the large sauna and take a refreshing dip in the pond. Accommodation can also be booked at Kroppefjäll B&B with discounts. The organisers welcome both experienced trail runners and younger participants (Lilla KTR) in a friendly setting.
course_highlights: Approx. 60% singletrack/off-trail, 35% gravel road/forest road and 5% oil-gravel road
Race format: trail running in two-person teams
Lilla KTR: children’s race around the pond (approx. 900 m), with the option to run 1–3 laps
additional: Bus to the start from Kroppefjäll B&B; GPX file for 21 km; bring your own fluids; bib pickup in the days before the race or the evening before; accommodation discounts via Trailrun1/Trailrun2; the Lilla KTR race takes place on 7 November at 18:00; registration deadline: 4/11.

name: Iron Backbone Ultra
description: Iron Backbone Ultra is a trail adventure in Kristinehamn built around the Järnleden and offers three distances (15, 30 and 50 km). The race takes place on varied and characterful terrain—deep forests, bogs, small lakes, pastures and old trails—putting both mental toughness and the joy of running to the test. The start and finish are at Hultets friluftsgård, and the 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden. The organiser, Topp & Dröm, welcomes both experienced trail runners and those who want to try trail running for the first time.
course_highlights: The course largely follows the Järnleden through varied terrain (forests, bogs, lakes, pastures and old trails)
Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn
The 15 km course partly leaves the Järnleden
additional: Three distances are offered: 15 km, 30 km and 50 km; start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård; from 1 October, places are limited to ensure a specially designed medal for every participant; organiser: Topp & Dröm (contact person Lasse / telephone 073-853 75 21), and the information pages have sections on aid stations and equipment. Start times: 30 km and 50 km at 17:00; 15 km at 17:30. No cups are provided at the aid stations; bring your own cup. Start and finish at Hultets friluftsgård, Kristinehamn. Entry fees are updated over time, and from 1 October, places are limited to secure a specially designed medal for every participant.

name: Finalloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Parvelbanan, ca 250 m, anmälan endast på plats tävlingsdagen. 40 kr

description: Finalloppet is western Sweden’s largest cross-country race and has been held annually in Gothenburg since 1968. The race offers several distances from 1.9 km to 19 km, with varied terrain and challenging features, including an advanced trail section on the 19 km course. The event is well organized, with clear course markings, water stations and medical services on site, making it popular with both elite runners and recreational runners. The event venue is centered at Skatås Motionscentrum, creating a pleasant and friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The 19 km course includes an approximately 2,500-metre advanced trail section
The courses are marked with orange arrows and clear kilometre markers
Water stations are located at several points along the 19 km course
additional: Registration is available through RaceID, with payment by bank card, Swish or Google Pay. Start groups are divided by expected finishing time for the 19 km and 10 km races, with fixed start times for some groups. A sweeper follows runners on all courses for safety. Startklar insurance can be purchased during registration. Benify wellness allowances are accepted. The Parvel course is a short course with registration available on site only. Photos are taken during the race and may be used for marketing. Late registration is available until one hour before the start. Medical services are available on site, and transport information is provided. The entry fee is not specified.

name: Borås 6-timmars
description: Borås 6-hour is an annual timed race organized by SOK Knallen, where participants run as far as possible on a 1,892-meter loop around Byttorpssjön in Borås. The course is almost completely flat and consists mostly of compacted gravel, with a short section of asphalt, making it easy to run. During the race, refreshments with drinks and light food are available at the lap point, and the goal is to have fun and challenge yourself for six hours. After the finish, medals are handed out and an awards ceremony is held for the leading runners. The race starts at 10:00 at Byttorps IP, with changing facilities and race-bib pickup in the clubhouse.
course_highlights: 1,892-meter loop around Byttorpssjön
Compacted gravel surface with approximately 30 meters of asphalt
Almost completely flat and easy-to-run course
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on race day from 08:00 to 09:30, or the day before between 17:00 and 19:00. Parking is available at Byttorps IP, with approximately 30 spaces. Bags can be left in a truck by the refreshment tent. Refreshments including Coca-Cola, pickled cucumber, hot dogs, sandwiches, snacks and UMARA sports drink are available at the lap point. After finishing at 16:00, chips are removed and a medal is handed out along with a hamburger and water. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 16:45 in the clubhouse. The minimum age to participate in the half marathon and longer distances, including the 6-hour race, is 17. The event takes place around Byttorpssjön in Borås, and registration and results are available online. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across the region.

name: Jätten Bule-löpet
location: Österbymo, Ydre kommun, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: Jätten Bule-löpet is a long-running cross-country race organised by IFK Österbymo on the first weekend of November. The race celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2019 and attracts runners of all ages to the forests of Ydre. Distances range from KnatteBule for the very youngest, to 2.4 km for children aged 4–12, as well as 5 km and 10 km events for running or walking on challenging terrain. The event is an autumn festival that welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on hilly, challenging forest terrain
Distances ranging from a children’s race to 10 km for adults
The race runs through the forests of Ydre around Bulevallen and the Bulespåret trail
additional: Distances include KnatteBule for the youngest participants, 2.4 km for children aged 4–12, and 5 km and 10 km events for running or walking. Bulevallen is the meeting point, and IFK Österbymo, together with Ydre Municipality, is responsible for the Bulespåret floodlit trail, a hilly 2.4 km route used during the event. The race includes various distances, from children’s events to adult races, and takes place in the scenic surroundings of Ydre. In 2026, weather conditions may affect the terrain, but the race is open to all runners and outdoor enthusiasts.

name: Gränsö Trailrun
description: Gränsö Trailrun is a running event in Gränsö Nature Reserve outside Västervik, offering technical and scenic trails, coastal rocky shorelines, and some of Sweden’s finest oak pastures around Gränsö Castle. Choose between 8 km and 15 km on well-marked courses, or let the children take part in Gränsö Kids Trail (up to age 12). The race offers both timed participation and Fun Run without timing, and encourages an enjoyable experience in nature—why not combine it with a spa visit at Gränsö Castle? Welcome to experience the Västervik archipelago at its best.
course_highlights: Coastal rocky shorelines and the cliffs of Skanvik along the course
Trails through sparse pine forest and valuable oak pastures, with technically varied sections
The 15 km course has a bonus loop on Ekholmen; the 8 km and 15 km courses join at the Kroken aid station
additional: The event center opens at 09:00 at Gränsö Castle. Start times: Gränsö Kids Trail 10:15, 8 km 11:00, 15 km 11:15. The first finishers are expected at approximately 11:35, and the finish closes at 13:45. Courses are marked with hanging red-and-white tape and signs; parts of the course follow existing hiking trails. Surface: mainly trails/hiking paths, with sections of rocky terrain, natural terrain, and short road stretches. Aid stations: one on the 8 km course and two on the 15 km course. All children receive a medal and refreshments after finishing. Registration is online and remains open until one hour before the start. 8 km and 15 km courses; online registration until one hour before the start; aid and hydration stations along the course; timed participation or Fun Run without timing; start times: 11:00 (8 km) and 11:15 (15 km); first finishers at approximately 11:35; finish closes at 13:45; spa option at Gränsö Castle.

name: Novemberflåset 2025
description: Novemberflåset is a road race in Strömstad, organised by Strömstad Running Club. The race is open to both elite runners and recreational runners and features an easy-to-run, officially measured 10-kilometre course. This traditional autumn event attracts runners of all ages and abilities. Strömstad Running Club works with the municipality to promote running and outdoor activities in the area.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10-kilometre road course
Easy-to-run, fast course
Held in Strömstad, surrounded by beautiful scenery
additional: Strömstad Running Club also organises other races and training groups, including Löparkidz and trail running. Results from previous years are published on the club’s Facebook page. The club also offers club clothing for children and adults. The race takes place on 14 November 2026. Results will be published after the event. Registration is available via the organiser’s website. The event is open to both elite and recreational runners.

name: Kristianstad Trail
description: Kristianstad Trail is organized by Härlövs IF in the Bockeboda area outside Kristianstad and is promoted as an autumn highlight for trail runners. The race offers several distances, making it accessible to both experienced trail runners and recreational runners. Preliminary race information and courses are published on the website, along with information about course previews ahead of the event. Organizer pages and the registration link are collected on the race website.
course_highlights: Running in Bockeboda Forest — woodland terrain near Kristianstad
Several distances: approx. 25 km (25–26.4 km), 12 km (12–12.9 km) and 5 km (5.3–5.7 km), depending on the measurement method
Course distances are listed with variations depending on different measurement methods
additional: Registration: the page mentions individual and group registration. The website mentions insurance and includes a registration link for a previous year’s edition (Registration for Kristianstad Trail 2025). Course previews have also been held ahead of the race, and late registration has previously been announced as available via Racezoo. The race has a long tradition in Kristianstad, and information about this year’s edition is available in news articles and race information on Härlövs IF’s website and the RaceID page.

name: Team Fillinge Ultras Terränglopp
location: Gummiverkstaden, Bankekind, Linköping Municipality, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Team Fillinge Ultra’s trail race is a friendly, local event organized by Team Fillinge Ultra. The race is approximately 10 km long and consists mostly of scenic gravel roads and lovely trails just outside Fillinge, south of Bankekind/Linköping. The event is being held for the second year and has a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere for trail runners who want to enjoy nature. Meet at Gummiverkstaden (gathering at 10:40); the race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: Approximately 10 km
Mostly scenic gravel roads and lovely forest trails
Gathering and start at Gummiverkstaden, south of Bankekind (near Fillinge/Linköping)
additional: Information meeting at 10:40 at Gummiverkstaden; start at 11:00. The race is organized by Team Fillinge Ultra (contact: marcuslundin@gmail.com). Website operator/event partner: Trailrunning Sweden AB (info@trailrunningsweden.se). New course route for 2025 and all 100 entries sold out one week before the race; new hiking prize “The Golden Toaster”; logistics information includes a bus from Linköping toward Åtvidaberg (get off at Sandtorp) and parking at Gummiverkstaden (limited space; carpooling encouraged).

name: Hammarby Alpin Marathon
location: Vindskyddet i Barnbacken, Hammarbybacken, Stockholm, Sweden
description: Hammarby Alpin Marathon is a unique alpine marathon in the heart of Stockholm, running up, over and around Hammarbybacken. The race consists of 22 laps and is slightly longer than a standard marathon—a microultra that, in the organiser’s words, could also be called Sweden’s probably slowest marathon. The course is technical and spectator-friendly, with the lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope. The event is a festive Advent celebration organised by Stockholm Multisportklubb.
course_highlights: 22 laps around Hammarbybacken (start, lap point and finish at the shelter in the children’s slope)
Start at the bottom of the hill (to the left of the lift when facing the summit) and climb over the “Trysil” section by the jetty
Technical sections: down along the service road, around the chimney, through Indianparken, inside the allotment gardens and along the cycle path
additional: Organiser: Stockholm Multisportklubb. Registration takes place at the lap point/finish (the shelter in the children’s slope). Nearest metro station: Hammarbyhöjden. Start location: at the bottom of the hill, to the left of the lift. Registration is via RaceID, according to the registration page. Registration and finish are at the shelter in the children’s slope; bags can be left at the foot of the hill; a tarpaulin is provided in case of rain; toilets are behind the car park; the right of public access applies; results are published after the race (top 10 faster).

name: SpriT Frontyard Dalby by Night
location: Dalby, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional end-of-year race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured the finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen, providing a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and ties to the club make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race information, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. Historically, the event has had changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen. Historical information and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: Sylvesterloppet Göteborg
description: The Sylvester Race in Gothenburg is a popular 10 km race held on New Year’s Eve, starting and finishing at Heden. The course is flat and spectator-friendly, and runs for two laps through central Gothenburg, including Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and around Svenska Mässan. The race is a perfect way for both elite runners and recreational runners to end the year. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and has a chance to win prizes in a prize draw. All classes start together at 12:00, with a warm-up 15 minutes beforehand. Registration is via MittLopp, with designated start groups based on expected finish time.
course_highlights: Flat, two-lap 10 km course through central Gothenburg
Passes Avenyn, Ullevi, Gårda and Svenska Mässan
Starts and finishes at Heden on a spectator-friendly course
additional: Start groups are divided according to expected finish time, with intervals of a few minutes between them. Race numbers can be collected at Nordstan and Heden in the days before the race. Electronic chip timing using the chip on the race number is used, and net times are reported. Registration is available until one hour before the start if the race is not full. Company and group registrations are handled by email at kansli@solvikingarna.se. The race takes place in Gothenburg on New Year’s Eve, with registration via MittLopp and different classes for different ages and categories. There is also a fancy-dress class with prizes, and changing facilities and showers are unavailable due to the redevelopment of Heden.

name: Sandsjöbacka Trail 180
description: Sandsjöbacka Trail is one of western Sweden’s most exciting and challenging winter trail races, offering distances of 30k, 60k, 90k and 180k. The races feature varied terrain, from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running in a magical setting. Whether you’re an ultrarunner or a recreational runner, there’s a challenge to suit you. Welcome to experience the community, challenge and joy of Sandsjöbacka!
course_highlights: Terrain ranging from easy-to-run trails to technical trail running
Elevation gain from approx. 1,000 m (30k) up to approx. 5,000 m (180k)
Magical winter scenery in the Gothenburg area
additional: The 180k race is an out-and-back race starting in Skatås and turning around at Tjolöholm. The Friday start time can be chosen freely between 11:00 and 20:00, but all 90k and 180k runners must start together at 06:00 on Saturday morning. Drop bags and a place to rest are available in Tjolöholm. Self-support applies on the Skatås–Tjolöholm section, according to Fastest Known Time rules. A headlamp is recommended for dark sections. There are time limits and several aid stations with closing times along the courses. The event is known for its scenic course and challenging terrain, making it a popular choice for trail runners in the region.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter
description: EcoTrail Stockholm Winter is a new winter adventure for runners who love nature even when the temperature drops. The race offers three distances on snowy trails in Norra Djurgården, with the start and finish at Stora Skuggan. All finishers receive a unique winter medal and can enjoy a warming after-run with hot drinks and snacks. The race is suitable both for competitive runners and for those who want to enjoy nature at a more relaxed pace.
course_highlights: Rolling snowy trails in Norra Djurgården
Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km distances
Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, with good public transport links
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggan, Norra Djurgården. Metro and bus from the city centre to the start. Aid stations at 4 km on the 6 km and 12 km distances. Warming after-run with hot drinks and snacks after the finish. Unique medal for all finishers. Trail terrain, winter conditions, registration via EQ Timing, no cancellations, option to purchase cancellation protection.

name: Winter Run (Stockholm)
description: Winter Run Stockholm is a winter race on a unique 5 km course that starts and runs through Skansen, as well as following a loop around Djurgården. The course is partly paved and partly gravel, with a distinct climb up to Bollnästorget and a few smaller hills on Djurgården. Participants are encouraged to compete in bright and imaginative outfits, creating a festive and colourful atmosphere. The event is organised by the athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and any surplus goes back to sport.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 57% paved surface and 43% gravel
Just over 1 km of running inside Skansen
A substantial climb up to Bollnästorget
additional: The course is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association and officially measured by an approved course measurer. If the surface is icy, shoes suited to winter conditions are recommended. Any surplus from the race goes to sport. The event includes activities for children and families, with a festive winter atmosphere and entertainment along the course.

name: BTR Winter 12 km
location: Öströö fårfarm, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

name: Bocksten TrailRun Winter
location: Öströö fårfarm, Åkulla bokskogar, Varberg, Sweden
description: Bocksten TrailRun Winter is a scenic trail race held in the Åkulla beech forests, starting and finishing at Öströö Sheep Farm. The race offers several distances, from 5 km to the Ultra 44 km, and features beautiful forest trails, lake views and challenging elevation. With carefully planned routes through sensitive nature reserves and a strong sense of community among runners, this race is a unique experience for trail enthusiasts. Only 1000 race places are available, contributing to an exclusive and personal atmosphere.
course_highlights: Singing beech forests and enchanting spruce forests
Sparkling lakes along the route
Plenty of enjoyable elevation on beautiful trails
additional: Start times vary by distance: Ultra 44 km starts at 08:00, 12 km starts at 10:00, 5 km starts at 10:15 and 22 km starts at 10:30. Maximum 1000 race places in total. Startklar insurance can be purchased for a refund in case of illness or injury. The routes are not public in order to protect the nature reserves. Helping other runners when needed is mandatory. Littering results in disqualification. The event welcomes participants of all ages, celebrates 10 years, and is a community-oriented trail race in scenic surroundings.

name: Snapphane Race
location: Hjortakrokskolans idrottshall, Sölvesborg, Blekinge County, Sweden
description: Snapphaneracet is a challenging trail race that follows in the footsteps of the Snapphanar through the beautiful Ryssberget in Sölvesborg. The race offers several distances from 13 km to 50 km, with plenty of elevation and varied terrain, including beech forests and mossy coniferous forest trails. The winter edition offers an extra-tough challenge, with icy and muddy sections. The organizers look forward to welcoming runners for a tough and scenic experience in February.
course_highlights: Ryssberget, home to one of Sweden’s largest beech forests
Moss-covered, winding coniferous forest trails
Challenging hills and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. Sweden Runners members and members of FysKompaniet Träningscenter receive a 15% discount on the entry fee. Startklar insurance can be purchased to receive a refund in the event of illness or injury. Name changes are possible for a fee up to 8 days before the race. Trail race in Ryssberget with distances from 13 km to 50 km, a winter challenge, course updates via GPX, headlamp required for some distances, start and finish at Hjortakrokskolans sports hall, no cups at aid stations.

name: Vårtävlingarna
description: Vårtävlingarna is a classic running race in Gothenburg, held every year in early March. The race takes place on the well-known “grusåttan” course in Skatås, where participants can choose to run 8, 16 or 32 km. The event has a long tradition dating back to the 1960s and serves as a kickoff to the racing season in the Gothenburg area. The field is a mix of recreational runners and local elite athletes, and the race starts with a fast, lively surge. In 2026, Vårtävlingarna Trail will also make its debut.
course_highlights: The “grusåttan” course in Skatås, approximately 8 km per lap
Choose to run 1, 2 or 4 laps (8, 16 or 32 km)
Start and finish in Skatås, with a lively start reminiscent of calves let loose in a field
additional: 2026 start times: 32 km starts at 10:10, 16 km at 11:00, and 8 km at 13:00. The race is a mix of recreational runners and elite athletes. Vårtävlingarna Trail makes its debut in 2026. The start and finish are in Skatås. The race serves as a kickoff to the racing season in the Gothenburg area. The course is the “grusåttan” in Skatås. The race serves as a kickoff to the racing season in the Gothenburg area and has a strong tradition. This year’s edition includes a new trail race, offering participants additional variety.

name: Edsvidsleden Trailrun
price_range: 50 kr för T-shirt från tidigare år
description: Edsvidsleden Trailrun is a classic trail race in Trollhättan, offering a beautiful and challenging 14 km course along the Edsvidsleden trail. The start and finish are at Forngården, and the course follows a marked hiking trail with some sections additionally flagged. The race is open to everyone who wants to experience trail running on lovely paths, with water available at two stations. It is a well-organised race with a long tradition and a friendly atmosphere for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: 14 km course on the classic Edsvidsleden trail in Trollhättan
The course follows a marked hiking trail, with some sections additionally flagged
Water is available at approximately 9 km and in the start and finish area
additional: The start and finish have been moved to Forngården in Trollhättan. There is no parking at the start; park on the streets in Strömslund or at Torsbovallen. Bring your own water and cup. T-shirts from previous years will be sold on race day for 50 kr each. Course records for men and women are listed for the 14 km, 28 km and 56 km distances from previous years. All participation is at your own risk and permits the publication of photos and videos on social media. The event is a trail race on marked paths, with water stations, no chip timing and a prize ceremony for the top finishers. Participants are advised to bring their own cup and water.

name: Equinox Adventure Ultra
description: Equinox Adventure Ultra is a unique trail-running race held during the spring equinox. The race is a long-distance experience in which teams of two runners navigate on their own and are self-sufficient through equal parts daylight and darkness. Participants can choose between a long distance of at least 100 km or a shorter distance of at least 50 km. The race starts on Saturday at 12:00 and runs until Sunday at 18:00, offering a challenging experience immersed in nature over a full day.
course_highlights: Long-distance trail running through forests and nature
Self-sufficient teams of two runners
Navigation through equal parts daylight and darkness during the spring equinox
additional: The race runs from Saturday at 12:00 until Sunday at 18:00. Each team consists of two self-sufficient runners who must navigate on their own during the race. The race is self-sufficient, with participants using a map and compass to navigate through forests, trails and open landscapes. The start location is secret, and the race takes place around the spring equinox in Nyköping, Sweden.

name: Ursvik Ultra
location: Ursvik, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
price_range: 550 kr för de olika distanserna, efteranmälan 650 kr
description: Ursvik Ultra is a long-running ultramarathon that always takes place on the third Saturday in March. The race offers three distances: 75 km, 45 km and 15 km, all on a hilly, varied trail course combining lit running tracks and trails. Participants will experience challenging terrain with gravel surfaces that can range from dry to muddy or slushy, depending on the weather. Food and drink are available at the lap point during the race, and changing rooms and showers are available at nearby Brotorpshallen. Ursvik Ultra is a perfect start to the ultra season for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 15 km of hilly trails with 320 metres of elevation gain
A mix of lit running tracks and larger and smaller trails
Varied surfaces, from dry and firm to muddy and slushy
additional: The start is at Ursvik trail centre. Race packs can be collected from 2 hours before the start. A transition area is located by the refreshment and food station. Changing rooms and showers are available at Brotorpshallen. Late registration is available on site on race day for a fee of 650 kr. The course closes at 23:30; after that, no one may continue onto the course, but participants may finish a lap already in progress. The nearest metro station is Hallonbergen, about a 1 km walk from the sports ground. Bus 504 stops right outside Motionsgården. The race includes changing rooms, showers, food and drink, as well as mandatory equipment such as a headlamp and a change of clothes. The race starts on the third Saturday in March, with a transition area at the lap point and free parking for participants.

name: adidas Premiärmilen
description: adidas Premiärmilen is a 10 km race that kicks off the running season in Stockholm. The race follows a scenic course in Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing near Universitetet metro station. Runners can test their fitness, qualify for a starting corral at adidas Stockholm Marathon, and enjoy a well-organised event with experienced pacers. The course is officially measured and combines asphalt, gravel and paving slabs, with a total elevation gain of 117 metres.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Norra Djurgården, starting and finishing near Universitetet metro station
Total elevation gain of 117 metres
Surface: asphalt (64.7%), gravel (29.8%), paving slabs (5.3%) and wooden bridge (0.2%)
additional: Time limit: 2 hours from the start. Qualifying race for adidas Stockholm Marathon. Prize money is awarded to the top three women and men starting in the first starting group. Minimum age: 15. Walking poles, prams, inline skates, roller skis, bicycles, handcycles and racing wheelchairs are not permitted. Wheelchair participants may take part with a guide and a freewheel and start in the last starting group. The race is run on a mix of asphalt, gravel and paving slabs, with the start provisionally scheduled for around 11:00 and a two-hour time limit. Registration is open until 28 March 2026, and payment can be made by Swish or credit card.

name: Hoka Torekov-Båstad Lördag
location: Torekov, Båstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Hoka Torekov-Båstad is a varied 21 km trail race between Torekov and Båstad. The race offers beautiful views of the sea and nature, perfect for anyone looking to enjoy the freedom and challenge of trail running. As part of the Outnorth Trail Tour, the race brings together Sweden’s elite trail runners and offers a unique nature experience along the coast. After the race, you can take part in an After Run buffet with delicious food and live entertainment at Hotel Skansen.
course_highlights: 21 km of varied trail running between Torekov and Båstad
Beautiful views of the sea and nature
Part of the Outnorth Trail Tour, featuring Sweden’s elite trail runners
additional: An After Run buffet is available after the race at Hotel Skansen for SEK 445 per person, with food and live entertainment. The race is limited to 1,500 participants, with the option to book accommodation at Hotel Skansen and join a shared After Run party with food and live entertainment.

name: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT)
location: Romeleåsens höjder, Genarp, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Genarps IF Trail (GIFT) is a technical trail race across the heights of Romeleåsen, with three distances: 10, 20 and 30 km, featuring elevation gains of 150, 340 and 620 metres respectively. The race is open to all runners, from recreational runners to elite athletes, and the 30 km distance is also a district championship event and part of Skånes TrailCup. The start and finish are at Ekevallen, Genarp sports ground, and there are aid and energy stations along the course. The entry fee includes food and drink after the finish, and showers and changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Technical trail race across the heights of Romeleåsen
Three distances: 10 km (150 m elevation gain), 20 km (340 m), 30 km (620 m)
Aid and energy stations along the course
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day, one hour before the start. Showers and changing rooms are available. After the race, hamburgers, beer and other drinks prepared on site are included. The 30 km distance awards 1 UMTB point and is a district championship event. The 20 and 30 km races run clockwise, with a challenging uphill switchback on the north side of the ridge. The race is part of Skånes TrailCup and offers food and drink after the race, with aid and energy stations along the course and facilities for changing and showering.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Växjöloppet is a running festival held in Växjö, starting on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The races cover distances of 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km. The longer distances offer a scenic course through Bokhultet Nature Reserve and finish with a shared section around Lake Växjö. The final stretch takes place at Lagunvallen, near the finish line in Strandbjörket. Younger runners can also take part in Lilla Växjöloppet, with several shorter untimed distances. Växjöloppet is a day of movement, enjoyment and community for the whole family.
