description: Welcome to Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar—a guided 15–17 km run through the magical beech-forest landscape near Åkulla. We’ll run past small lakes and Bexell’s “talking” stones, and through dense beech forest, in 2–3 pace groups so everyone can keep up. After the run, we’ll finish with a locally produced picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café. We recommend carpooling and can help coordinate it.
course_highlights: Run in the beech forests of Åkulla
Pass small, picturesque lakes
Bexell’s “talking” stones along the route
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. Distance: 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. The organizer recommends carpooling and offers help coordinating it. Carpooling is recommended and can be coordinated; a picnic/meal at Öströö Fårfarm Café follows the run.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2026—a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from children’s races to a half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. The start and finish are in Strandbjörket, with the start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The course combines forest trails through scenic Bokhultet with paved sections around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run over two laps on largely the same course, offering variety and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing through Bokhultet (mostly deciduous forest), becoming a forest trail after the first kilometre
The final approximately 3.5 km are paved and run around Växjösjön, with the finish straight at Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and several children’s race distances in Lilla Växjöloppet (children’s races are not individually timed). The 21.1 km race is run over two laps (the first lap is just over 11 km, the second is 10 km). Water stations: the 10 km course has four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km and 6.5 km); on the 21.1 km course, runners can take water eight times (including at 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5 and 16.5 km). Lilla Växjöloppet: participants in some children’s races receive a race number, medal and fruit; Tidningslöpet provides a T-shirt and diploma. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the entry fee (register via mittlopp.se and submit the receipt to your employer for reimbursement through the wellness allowance). A team competition is available; start lists and participant information are on the official website. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet; water stations are located along the course (4 on the 10 km course; up to 8 water stops on the 21.1 km course); the Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and the tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; the finish closes at 14:30.

name: Risenloppet
location: Genarp, Lund Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event taking place on 9 May 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish at Nolhaga Park will be celebrated with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event is aimed at everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, with beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultramarathon has substantial total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2–9 people per team), with stages of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish at Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, runners can enjoy a finish-line celebration and After Run, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 ahead of race weekend.

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen, Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with fundraising for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken, on mixed terrain, with a new start every hour on the hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next one. The event offers an aid station, a medal, a goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved pedestrian/cycle paths
A steep uphill section at Örnberget and illuminated trails along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens on August 1. Name changes can be made until 2026-04-17 for a fee of 150 SEK (by emailing info@runraisers.com with the new participant’s details). Race bibs are distributed on Thursday, April 30. Race format: a mass start every hour on the hour; anyone who does not complete the loop within 1 hour is out. The entry fee includes an aid station, race photos, a medal, and a goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event benefiting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the entry fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; the entry includes an aid station, a medal, race photos, a goodie bag, and prizes for the winners.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail race in scenic areas around Vessigebro, starting and finishing at Gurkbänken at Brovallen. The race offers adult classes at 5 km and 10 km, as well as several children’s classes (1,000 m and 2,000 m). Start times are arranged with families in mind: children start at 10:00, adults at 11:00, and participants with dogs start in waves from 11:30. Registration is via the RaceID app or website, or by emailing the organizer as described on the event page.
course_highlights: The race follows trails and forest paths in scenic areas around Vessigebro
Start and finish at Gurkbänken at Brovallen in central Vessigebro
Adult distances of 5 km and 10 km; children’s classes at 1,000 m and 2,000 m
additional: Children start at 10:00. Adults without dogs start at 11:00; participants with dogs start in waves one minute apart from 11:30. Dogs are allowed—email kontakt@hallandsloppet.se to register for the dog start. You can register via the RaceID app or website, or by email with your personal details if you do not want a RaceID profile. Registration is through RaceID; a Facebook post mentions that the entry fee will increase soon.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund, organised by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course that runs mostly along narrow trails through the beautiful Småland landscape—through dark, fairytale-like forests, along lakes and over long slopes with fast descents. There are men’s and women’s categories over 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register up to race day; the children’s race is free and participants receive a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails through the Småland landscape
Through dark, fairytale-like forests and along lakes
Long slopes and fast descents
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. To register, email sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com. Payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration is available on race day. The children’s race is approximately 1 km; all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish. A parent may accompany the child around the course. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window: Saturday 10:00–16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 record number of participants: approximately 45; 2024 women’s course record for 26 km: 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children’s race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
location: Karlsrofältet, Linnéplatsen, Botaniska Trädgården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a 12.5 km trail race in the Änggårdsbergen nature reserve in Gothenburg, organised by Språng Träning & Äventyr. The one-lap course features technical trails, hills and several viewpoints—a true trail race in the heart of the city. The race suits both those looking to push themselves and those who want to enjoy nature. The start and finish are at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. The organisers welcome participants seeking adventure and close-to-nature experiences.
course_highlights: Technical trails, hills and fast downhill sections
Varied terrain: soft, pine-needle-covered and mossy trails, as well as short gravel sections
Several viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg, in a nature reserve in the heart of the city
additional: Start and finish at Karlsrofältet (approx. 300 m from Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden). Friends can start together in three start groups: 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. Race bibs can be collected from 09:30 on race day; race numbers will also be sent by SMS on Friday. Trail shoes with a substantial tread are recommended; spiked shoes are prohibited. There is one aid station approximately halfway around the course and another after the finish. Energy partner Moonvalley provides sports drinks and bars. Wooden medals inspired by Vitsippsdalen. Start places can be transferred via Eq-Timing for 100 kr (name changes/transfers must be made by 27/4). Practice runs are offered (21 March: hill-running technique; 12 April: full-course practice run). Medical staff will be in the finish area. Public transport: take the tram to Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden or a bus to Linnéplatsen. Parking is available around Slottsskogen; avoid parking in the Änggården residential area. Children aged 8 and over can run with a guardian, who is responsible for the child.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a fast, easy loop course in central Trosa. Each loop is 6.706 km, and the race continues for as long as participants can complete a loop within one hour. The race starts on 2 May 2026 at 10:00. In the Backyard format, anyone who completes a loop within the hour may start again, until only one participant remains. The event is open to the public and family-friendly, with Mini-TUB for children (starting at 12:15) and awards for the top three men and women. The organiser provides sports drink, fruit and sandwiches at the start/finish area, and holds prize draws throughout the race.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop (main course)
Runs mostly along the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 metres of elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (follows the main course for 700 m before branching off)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on the Trosa Ultra Backyard Facebook page; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition in which each club’s three best results count (the club with the three best results receives 20% off next year); tent pitches outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy supplies available (sweets, sports drink and fruit), plus a Selfie Corner after the race; free silicone cup from Umara for all participants in the main race.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark Trailrun is a family-friendly trail race held in the Ecopark at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for more experienced runners. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has become a popular tradition for both recreational runners and families.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Ecopark, with distances ranging from 1 km to 30 km
Scenic setting featuring woodland and open landscapes
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The race is cancelled in 2026 due to unforeseen circumstances. Nordens Ark is a large outdoor park with approximately 4 km of walking trails in the wildlife park, offering a feel for the terrain. The park is cash-free and offers free parking and electric vehicle charging stations. Participants and visitors are encouraged to respect the animals and follow the park's rules. The event was planned for 2026 but has been cancelled for this year. It was an outdoor event with the start and finish at Zooliden, Nordens Ark, winding through the beautiful countryside of Sotenäs.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners and families. In 2026, the event offers a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories) as well as recreational 10 km and 5 km races, and this year’s edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. All races start at 13:00 from their respective start locations, and the finish is at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish countryside and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The route follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
A scenic route through beautiful Swedish countryside along the canal
additional: Transport: Buses are arranged from Borensberg to the respective start locations (the half marathon to Ljungsbro, the 10 km to Sjöbacka, and the 5 km to Brunneby) and must be booked and paid for when registering. No transport is provided after the finish; places may be available on race day, subject to availability. The bus fee listed on the registration pages is 100 kr. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; the price per runner is 20% lower than for individual registration, and team registration is only available online. Race bibs are collected at the respective start locations. Registration is valid only once payment has been received; if payment has not arrived within 10 days, the registration will be cancelled. Further details will be provided later in the race instructions. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, and 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; buses to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bankgiro; late registration from 11:30 to 12:30 at an increased price; race bibs are collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organised by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the event in Säter. The association’s website has the invitation with the course route, race information and start list, as well as results from previous years. Information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in its news section. The club encourages participants to read the race information and schedule before the event.
course_highlights: Course route published (see invitation/course route)
Race information and start list available on the event page
Results from 2025 and previous years published
additional: The invitation, course route, race information and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results from previous years are available there as well. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration information. The association’s official hashtag is #sätersfriidrott. Contact the association office at siffriidrott@telia.com; website contacts are listed on the contact page. The 2024 SäterMaran results include information on the half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions, as well as different age categories, indicating that both distances may be offered as part of the event.

name: Avloppet
location: Sobacken Energi- och Miljöcenter, Borås, Sweden
description: Avloppet is a short 5 km race held alongside Kretsloppet in Borås and organised in collaboration with Borås Energi och Miljö. Registration and payment are made directly on the organiser’s website up to race day, and the Swedish Athletics Federation’s rules apply. The field is limited (maximum 150 participants), and the organiser offers optional chip timing. Event information and confirmation are sent to the email address you provide when registering.
course_highlights: 5 km distance on a hilly gravel course
A unique theme, with the course heading out towards the sewage pipes at Sobacken Energy and Environment Centre
Limited field (maximum 150 participants), with parking at Sobacken
additional: Chip timing is available as an optional extra; a charge of 200 kr applies if the chip is not returned. Results are published on the Kretsloppet website, and parking is available at Sobacken.

name: VAIS-loppet

tiers.description: Loppet är gratis för medlemmar i Växjö AIS.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: VAIS-loppet is an enjoyable trail race in the Fylleryd nature reserve, organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km. The long course follows much of the Trestugespåret and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the floodlit trail. Both races start together at VAIS-torpet at 18:30, and the event ends with refreshments. The race is free for Växjö AIS members; non-members pay an entry fee of 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
The long course (8.4 km) follows much of the Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly towards the end
The short course (4.4 km) follows the floodlit trail, and both courses finish with a long hill up to VAIS-torpet
additional: Race information will be published on April 28; a map and course profile are available as a PDF; registration is stated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event ends with refreshments at VAIS-torpet. Trail race in Fylleryd Forest with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the entry fee.

name: Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen i Halmstad, Sweden
description: Vårruset Halmstad takes place on 6 May 2026 at Civila flygfältet by Aleskogen in Halmstad. The event offers 2.5 km and 5 km distances; the 5 km course is officially measured and includes timing. Individual entries include a medal, finish-line bag and race bib, while team entries include a post-race picnic, a medal and a quiz with prizes. Registration is online, and the deadline is race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Age recommendations depend on the distance and whether children are accompanied by an adult. Vårruset is organised by Marathongruppen in collaboration with several athletics clubs. The event emphasises a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to socialise afterwards.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km course at Civila flygfältet by Aleskogen
Timing on the 5 km course, plus a medal and race bib
Team entry includes a post-race picnic, Vårruset music quiz and prizes
additional: Online registration; the deadline is race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Age recommendations: 5 km for children up to 13 years old (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km for children up to 11 years old (7 when accompanied by an adult). Team entry includes the added benefit of a post-finish picnic. Teams of 5 are invited to a picnic after finishing; all entries include a medal and finish-line bag. Timing on the 5 km course is optional and can be declined. Registration is available until race day, one hour before the first start.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women’s fun run organised by Marathongruppen in Uppsala on 7 May 2026. The event offers 2.5 km and 5 km distances, starting and finishing at Studenternas IP. Participants can enter individually or as part of a five-person team, and can opt out of timing for a more relaxed experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are treated to a picnic, with a focus on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Enter as a five-person team or individually; timing is optional
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; online registration; early registration is encouraged; teams consist of five people; teams are offered a picnic after the finish. The 5 km course is officially measured. Registration is available until race day, up to one hour before the first start, and timing can be optional.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset Vänersborg is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running tour and takes place on Thursday, 7 May 2026, with the start and finish at Sanden along Vassbottenleden. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course; timing is optional at registration. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish, making the event social and family-friendly. The event is presented by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Vänersborgs SK and is aimed at recreational runners of all ages, subject to the recommended age limits.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden)
Choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course
A fun team atmosphere — teams of five receive a picnic after the finish
additional: What’s included (individual registration): medal, finish-line bag, Vårruset music quiz and prizes, timing for those who opt in, and a race bib. Team registration (5 people): picnic after the finish, medal, finish-line bag, timing (if selected), and race bib. Recommended ages: 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years when accompanied by an adult); 5 km: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by an adult). Registration is online and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the first start. Contact Vänersborgs SK: varruset.vbg@gmail.com; Vårruset main switchboard: +46 8 545 66 440 (Tue–Thu 09:00–15:00). The course is partly paved and partly gravel, and is flat and easy to navigate throughout. Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (certified 5 km course). Individual registrations include a medal, finish-line bag, and music quiz and prizes; team registrations include a picnic after the finish, a medal, and a finish-line bag. You can register online until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start.

name: Run for Change
description: Run for Change is Hand in Hand’s running initiative, where every kilometre is connected to efforts to fight poverty, with a particular focus on women’s entrepreneurship in Kenya. The initiative is both a virtual running journey, in which participants log kilometres in a shared Strava Club, and a way to raise awareness of the organisation’s work at major running events. You can take part whenever and wherever you like—by running, walking or cycling—and help raise funds and spread awareness. The initiative often culminates in a finale alongside the Stockholm Marathon, where Run for Change is featured at the expo and during the race.
course_highlights: Virtual distance—run whenever and wherever you like
Join the organisation’s Strava Club, where every kilometre counts
Finale and visibility at the Stockholm Marathon (previous finales have been held there)
additional: Participation is flexible: you can run, walk or cycle and log your kilometres in a shared Strava Club. Run for Change uses a temporary tattoo as a symbol and has previously had a booth at the Stockholm Marathon expo. The initiative aims both to raise funds and to spread awareness of Hand in Hand’s work supporting women’s entrepreneurship. Virtual run with Strava Club; fundraising and awareness of entrepreneurship, as well as support for Hand in Hand’s work in Kenya; the finale has previously taken place alongside the Stockholm Marathon

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr/vuxen, barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis
description: Bankvarvet is a fun run in Kisa, taking place on 7 May 2026. The event focuses on the joy of being active rather than achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap, and welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Entertainment, activities and food experiences are also on offer throughout the day, making it a festival for the whole family and groups of friends. Bankvarvet encourages community spirit and setting your own goals, whether you walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
Focus on the joy of being active and setting your own goals
Family-friendly event with entertainment and activities
additional: The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00 and has over 2,000 participants. It includes entertainment, activities and food experiences. Participants are encouraged to sign up with friends or family for an even more enjoyable experience. Ultramarathon runner Frida Södermark shares training tips ahead of the race via the bank’s social media. The race starts at 18:30 in Kullaparken, Kisa; activities for the whole family; businesses can take part; entertainment and food throughout the day.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly recreational running event starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town. There is also the KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the route and is a local celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and fun on Saturday, 9 May 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometres, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the route runs close to the Svartån River
99 percent asphalt; a few challenging uphill sections and the final kilometre through central Mjölby towards Gästisparken
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Intersport on Friday, 8 May, 12:00–18:00 (a 25% discount coupon is provided when collecting your number). Uncollected race numbers will be distributed in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The tab at the top of the race number is the timing chip—without it, no time will be recorded. Late registration is available 30 April–7 May via the website, and can also be completed at race-number collection on 8 May or in Stadsparken on 9 May (Swish only). Fitness4You will lead the warm-up. Refreshments are provided by, among others, ICA Supermarket Mjölby, with water and sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Participant numbers have been high in previous years, with 1,074 runners mentioned in coverage of the event. Registration for 2026 opens, and results and records are published by the event’s organising media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred, following a pleasant, flat course along Lake Hulingen. There is a 10 km course and two children’s races, and the organizers welcome both club runners and recreational runners. Children can also enter the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizers refer participants to the race-day information on the event page.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children’s races
A pleasant, family-oriented event setting at Herrstorpet
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the 10 km race starts at 11:00. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizers refer participants to the race-day information for more details. The children’s races start at 10:00 according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet New Building Day, with rail-bike rides, guided tours and a concert during the morning.

name: Koster Trail
location: Kosterhavets Ekobod, Västra Bryggan, Nordkoster, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Vi har också ett antal platser utan mat och dryck, de kostar 950kr inkl. moms.

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race in Kosterhavet National Park, taking place this year on Saturday, May 9, 2026, and celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race is held on Nordkoster and offers Bohuslän’s rocky shores, sandy beaches, trails, and several magical viewpoints along a course of approximately 15 km. After crossing the finish line, participants can recover with a saltwater swim and food at Kosterhavets Ekobod. The race is organized by Kosterhavets Ekobod in collaboration with local partners and has a limited number of entries (200).
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km along the coast on Nordkoster, with trails, sandy beaches, and rocky shores
Technically challenging course with sections of rocks and cliffs and many viewpoints
Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan; two aid stations along the course
additional: Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod by Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. The course has been approved by Kosterhavet National Park, and the race has only 200 entries. Two aid stations serve water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Bibs can be collected on Friday, May 8, from 18:00 to 20:00, or on race day from 10:00. After the finish, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. There are no shower facilities at the finish; bag storage is available at the start/finish. Participants need accident and liability insurance. Travel and accommodation tips are linked on the race website. Maximum 200 entries; minimum age 18; start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster; pizza and craft beer served after the race; aid stations along the course; registration opens January 10, 2026, at 10:00 via RaceID; results via RaceID.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a welcoming trail race through Åstön Nature Reserve, taking place on May 9, 2026. The event offers four distances (1, 4, 8 and 14 km) and features a mix of wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Skeppshamn, and the race promises a scenic seaside finish, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The event is organized by Tynderö IK, and the race director can be reached at the contact address provided.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km
A mix of wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn, with coastal views in Åstön Nature Reserve
additional: Date: May 9, 2026. Distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. Start and finish at Skeppshamn in Åstön Nature Reserve. Race director Linus can be reached at race.tyndero@gmail.com. The event debuted in 2025, and the 2025 results are published on the page. The Åstöloppet Trail distances are 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. The terrain includes wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain through Åstön Nature Reserve. Start and finish at Skeppshamn; registration is available via the link on the organizer’s page.

location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden

description: Kolmårdstrailen is a hilly, experience-focused trail race in the scenic Kolmården area, with technical trails, rocky slabs and plenty of elevation gain. You can choose from courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km and 6 km (as well as a 500 m children’s course). The course is described as challenging but close to nature. It passes, among other places, through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offers beautiful views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services including a water station and downloadable GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with plenty of elevation gain and sections of rocky slabs
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Lake Ågelsjön; views from Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level)
Small trails and singletrack, a wooden bridge over marshy sections, a rope in “koklämman” and a tough, partly off-trail final kilometre
additional: Regular registration is open through 3 May; late registration is available online until 6 May and then on site on race day from 09:00 to 11:00, with payment by cash or Swish. GPX data for the courses is available to download. There is a water station after approximately 7.5 km at Scoutstugan. A children’s race of approximately 500 m is available for children up to age 10. For Kolmården Night Trail, bring a headlamp; the course is marked with reflectors, there are no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as optional extras. The Kolmården events in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 metres of elevation gain), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km) and Luciatåget (7.5 km). A results page is available, and multiple distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organised by Östhammars Friidrott and takes place on Saturday, 9 May 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club’s competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants from the surrounding area. The necessary contact details are collected during registration for race administration and publication of results, and photos from the event may be used on the club’s channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club states that contact details provided during registration are used for race-related communication, and that names, ages and results may be stored for results lists and competition statistics. Photos from events may be used on the club’s website, Facebook and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request their removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed through Svenska Lag. The webpage contains the start list, registration and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a relaunch of the classic Silverlöpet, organised in collaboration with SHE. The race runs through central Sala and its beautiful surroundings, with the start and finish in Stadsparken. Choose 10 km (course measured), 5 km or a 2 km children’s race. The race is open to everyone and is presented as a community festival, with a medal for all participants.
course_highlights: Through central Sala and around Sala’s beautiful surroundings
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course has been officially measured
additional: Registration is via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is open until the beginning of May; late registration takes place on site on 9/5 (5–10 km: 08:00–09:00, children’s 2 km: 08:00–09:15). Prizes and awards: a medal for all participants; prizes for 1st–3rd place in the women’s and men’s 10 km races; prize draws for the 5 km. Silverlöpet is being relaunched in Sala; the most recent race was held in 1999. The distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is advertised by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organised by Spånga/Bromstens Bandyklubb, returning on 9 May 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and ability levels: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga centre, a 2 km course for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race. All races start and finish at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to take part, and registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga centre
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m children’s race
All races start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: Register via RaceID under “Spångaloppet 2026”. For questions, contact spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and take place in the vicinity of Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Welcome to Vellinge Beer Run 2026—a friendly and inclusive recreational race that combines running with local beer culture. The race is 5 kilometres long and starts and finishes at Vellinge Brewery in central Vellinge. The race starts at 12:00 on 9 May 2026, and the course takes you through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at the brewery. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking for a social and fun challenge.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre recreational race
Start and finish at Vellinge Brewery (Kompanigatan 18)
The course passes through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area
additional: Date and time: 9 May 2026, start at 12:00. Start/finish: Vellinge Brewery, Kompanigatan 18, 235 32 Vellinge. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at Vellinge Brewery. The race is described as suitable for all levels—both experienced runners and beginners. Date: 9 May 2026. The event emphasises socialising and local beer culture as core elements of the experience.

name: Åre Halvmarathon
location: Duved, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Åre Half Marathon is held in Åre Municipality and is a recurring trail/road race in a mountain setting. The second edition offers the half marathon as the main event, as well as a shorter 5 km option and two children’s races (300 m and 1.7 km). The event is presented by Åre Municipality and is aimed at both recreational runners and families. More information and registration are available via the event website.
course_highlights: A race in spectacular mountain scenery
The main distance is the half marathon; 5 km is also available
Children’s races of 300 m and 1.7 km
additional: The event is listed as the second edition and is scheduled for 24 May 2025, 09:30–14:00. The organizer/information text is published by Åre Municipality; registration is via the event’s own website. The date for Åre Half Marathon 2026 is 9 May; distances include the half marathon, 5 km, and two children’s races (300 m and 1.7 km); start times are approximately 09:30–14:00, and registration is via the event website.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race in Älmhult that raises money for the fight against cancer. The event is organised by Aktivitetshuset/the IKEA network and welcomes the general public, IKEA employees and their families. Registration is through RaceID, where participants choose both their distance and start time. Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00, and on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. The race weekend also includes inspirational talks and an after-run at Grillen after the finish.
additional: Register through RaceID (choose a distance and start time). Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00; on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. As this is a charity event, fees are non-refundable if you cancel. Group registration is supported (add additional participants during payment), and the confirmation email from RaceSupport includes your chosen distance and start time. Inspirational talks are held at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on 10 April, 17:00–19:00, and a talk by researchers on 24 April, 17:30–19:00). The after-run at Grillen starts at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page, and IKEA Hotell is recommended for overnight stays.

name: Sommarro Snabbare

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique, fast-paced running race in the Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race follows a 2.6 km loop through a wooded park setting, with each lap having to be completed in progressively less time (the first lap in 25 minutes, the next in 24 minutes, the third in 23 minutes, and so on), making the race faster with every lap. Everyone starts on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest—making it suitable both for fast runners and for those looking to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, no timing).
course_highlights: 2.6 km loop in a beautiful wooded park setting (Sommarro cultural reserve)
Hilly course, mostly gravel and fitness trails, with some off-road sections
Start/finish on a lawn; the race uses progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is done with a transponder worn around the ankle (number of laps is the main factor in placing; if tied, the time on the final lap decides). A lost transponder incurs a charge of 800 SEK. Water/sports drink (Umara) and an energy station are available, along with light refreshments. Changing facilities/showers are not available; there are two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, and offers a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs, totalling 67.5 km, and a shorter course with six legs, totalling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Event staff and a race announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, 67.5 km total
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, 23.5 km total
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Individual leg times, split times and teams’ finish times will be provided. The race announcer will follow the leaders from start to finish. Accommodation and food are available at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotell. Registration is open until 30 April 2026, with late registration available through 6 May. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with event staff, a group warm-up and a prize-giving ceremony for the top teams.

name: Humlestafetten
distance_verbose: 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race held in Bruksparken in Bromölla, with the start and finish in the same place. The race consists of six legs and is suitable for all runners, from recreational runners to more experienced athletes. The course is flat and easy to run, with a mix of gravel and asphalt, making the event a day filled with running enjoyment and camaraderie. The anniversary year is celebrated with a mini race for children and a draw for a hot-air balloon ride for participating teams. The mass start is at 11:00, and race bibs can be collected from 09:00.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs with timing via data chip
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and many prizes are drawn among participants. Timing is done using a data chip, and both overall time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. The race has a mass start, and slower runners are asked to keep to the right to let faster runners pass. The event includes a mini race for children, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top three in each category. Race-bib collection starts at 09:00, and showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Registration is open through 8 May 2026.

description: Lundaloppet is a recreational race held in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is known for its great atmosphere and scenic routes through parks and urban surroundings. It is a community celebration where both beginners and experienced runners come together to enjoy the joy of running in springtime Lund. The finish is inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, the race’s vibrant heart since 1997.
course_highlights: 10 km of running joy through springtime Lund
Route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly race of approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen on 8 May from 13:00 to 19:00 and on 9 May from 9:00. The warm-up for the main race takes place at the start on Svanevägen, with raised podiums along the way. Race confirmations are sent by email in week 18 and must be shown when collecting race bibs. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, and the finish is filmed. Trail and city running; registration online; race numbers and T-shirts can be purchased in advance or on site.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://lundaloppet.se/information/): 2026-05-09 — "Lundaloppet 2026 8 maj -> 13:00-19:00 9 maj -> från 9:00" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: Springtime 2025
description: Springtime Helsingborg is an annual running event in Helsingborg organised under the Springtime brand. This year’s edition takes place on 10 May 2026 and offers several race categories, including Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and the Open IFK Championships. The event is open to runners of different levels and offers both competitive and family-friendly activities. Registration is available via the website, and results from previous years are available online.
course_highlights: Several race categories for different audiences: Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and the Open IFK Championships
Family-friendly format with broad participation
Results from previous years and registration via the official website
additional: Register via “Sign up here!” on the website; results are available for several years (2011–2025). The regular registration deadline is 19/4; late registration on the website is open until 3/5, after which you can register late at Löplabbet. The entry fee includes a race bib and medal, as well as water and fruit.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset Växjö is the Växjö edition of Sweden’s largest women’s running tour, which visits 19 cities in 2026. In Växjö, participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km, starting and finishing at Strandbjörket, around Lake Växjö. You can register individually or as part of a team. A medal, a finish-line bag and the Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing is optional. Age recommendations apply, and registration is online. As an extra new feature, free HPV vaccination is available on-site during Vårruset for women born in 1994–1999, according to Region Kronoberg.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km around Lake Växjö, starting and finishing at Strandbjörket
Team and individual registration; teams can enjoy a picnic after the finish
Medal, finish-line bag and the Vårruset music quiz with prizes (timing is optional)
additional: Team picnic after the finish; online registration; part of the national Vårruset tour in 2026 (19 cities). Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). Start and finish at Strandbjörket; teams of 5 are treated to a picnic after the finish. You can register online up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; you can opt out of timing when registering.

name: Blodomloppet (Uddevalla)
