description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Uddevalla on 11 May 2026—a new local Blodomlopp event where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and children can take part in Lilla Blodomloppet. The start and finish are at Museiparken, and the course runs through central Uddevalla, passing, among other places, Östra station and sections of the old Lelångebanan railway. The event is held to raise awareness of blood donation, with both individual and team registration, followed by a group picnic after the finish.
course_highlights: The start is near Museiparken; the course runs along Kungsgatan and under the railway at Östra station
The 10 km route climbs Dynamitbacken towards Bjursjön and follows the old railway embankment (Lelångebanan)
The 5 km route turns towards Bleket, reaches its highest point at Norrskolan and is mostly downhill towards Uddevalla Hospital via a pedestrian tunnel under Road 44
additional: Team registration: 3–5 participants; a picnic bag is included. Teams may register with 1–2 vacant places and fill them by 1 May. Last day for team registration: 4 May. Individual registration closes on 11 May; late registration is available at Museiparken from 16:00 on 11 May. Wellness benefits (Epassi, Wellnet, Benify) are accepted. Blood donors receive a stated discount of 40 kr when registering. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old (a parent may accompany them without registering).

name: Vårruset Göteborg
description: Vårruset Göteborg is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place in Slottsskogen on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 18:00. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course, and the event is suitable for both walking and running. Individual entries include a medal, a finish-line goody bag, a race bib and the opportunity to take part in Vårruset’s music quiz; team entries (5 people) also receive a picnic after the finish. You can opt out of official timing when registering, and registration is open until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start.
course_highlights: The course runs through Slottsskogen, with the start and finish below Björngårdsvillan
Choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course
Parkland setting; teams of 5 receive a picnic after the finish
additional: Registration is online and open through race day (no later than 1 hour before the first start). Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). Individual entry includes a medal, a finish-line goody bag, Vårruset’s music quiz and prizes, a race bib, and timing for the 5 km (which can be opted out of). A digital option is available from 4 May to 4 June, with the medal mailed afterwards. Team entries (5 people) receive a picnic after the finish. Corporate packages are available for groups of more than 25 people via the company page.

name: Chalmersloppet 2026
price_range: Fri för studenter; övriga deltagaravgifter inte angivna
description: Chalmersloppet is a campus celebration at Johanneberg campus that celebrates wellbeing and community. The race welcomes students, employees, alumni, and companies to run, network, and have fun together in the spirit of Chalmers. Distances range from 3.14 km (including a walking option) up to 9.82 km, and students can take part in all distances for free. The event is organised by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and includes both a race and activities in a Runner Zone.
course_highlights: Start at Chalmersplatsen, past Teknologgården and up Olgas trappor (with an alternative route for participants using wheeled mobility aids).
The longer distances consist of multiple laps (2π = 6.28 km and 3π + an extra 400 m = 9.82 km), with hills and a final sprint on Sven Hultins gata.
The finish passes near Mossen/Chabo, and the course goes past Kemigården and along Rännvägen.
additional: The Runner Zone is held at Geniknölen, with activities, socialising, and an awards ceremony. Fysiken offers free changing rooms at Mossen and holds a warm-up before the race. Race bibs and T-shirts can be picked up at the tent by Teknologgården: Monday 11/5, 09:30–13:30, and Tuesday 12/5, 09:30–13:30. Participants start in groups (waves), and options are available for wheelchair users and other participants using wheeled mobility aids. Students participate for free; company places are offered in connection with sponsorship and recruitment opportunities. Distance options include 3.14 km, 6.28 km, 9.82 km, and a walk; start groups are based on participant groups. The event focuses on health and wellbeing for the whole campus community (students, employees, alumni, and companies) and includes activities such as the Runner Zone and a warm-up.

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km celebration of running in Gothenburg, bringing together tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race passes through the festival atmosphere of Slottsskogen, continues along Hisingen’s quays and by the buzz of Avenyn. The course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and numerous spectator and music stations along the route. Information about start groups and other details is sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes Hisingen’s quays and Avenyn
More than 200,000 spectators and numerous music stations along the route
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m), and the course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer. There are water stations along the course, and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to race day. Start groups are assigned according to seeding rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located at Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seeding rules and start groups are available; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, runs along Hisingen’s quays and goes by Avenyn; the race is part of Varvet Week.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, taking place for the fourteenth time in 2026 on Saturday, May 16. The event offers a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages, and the Lilla and Mini races for children. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and everyone who completes the race receives a specially designed medal. Löparakademin, a non-profit association that works with youth programs, is the organizer.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race, starting and finishing at Puckelbollplanen
DJs and music stations along the route create a suburban festival atmosphere
Children’s races: Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approx. 1.6 km, and Mini, approx. 500 m
additional: Online registration closes Thursday, May 14 at 5 p.m., but late registration is available at bib collection on Friday, May 15, and on race day, May 16, subject to availability. All participants must have a bib, which is distributed well ahead of the race. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal; Lilla participants are also offered fruit and a drink at the finish. The start/finish is at Puckelbollplanen, and Lilla/Mini have separate start times and age-grouped start fields. The race takes place in Skärholmen, Stockholm, and is free to enter through RUN4ZERO, with a medal for everyone who completes it.

name: Borgarloppet Trail Race
location: Näsvikens skidstadion, Näsviken, Ljusdals kommun, Gävleborgs län, Sweden
description: Borgarloppet is a trail race on the Borgarleden trail between the Dellen Lakes, finishing in Näsviken. The race is offered over several distances (0.6 km, 2.5 km, 6 km, 13 km and 23 km) and takes place as an all-day event. It is organised by Forsa OK and presented via Trailrunning Sweden.
course_highlights: The course follows the Borgarleden trail
Route between the Dellen Lakes
Finish in Näsviken
additional: Distances: 0.6 km, 2.5 km, 6.0 km, 13 km and 23 km; All-day event; First start listed as Saturday at 09:00; Organiser: Forsa OK; Contact and administrative information via Trailrunning Sweden (Trailrunning Sweden AB, info@trailrunningsweden.se). All-day event; start around 09:00 on Saturday; finish in Näsviken; distances of 0.6/2.5/6.0/13/23 km; Borgarleden trail between the Dellen Lakes

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Welcome to Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka in Ånnaboda, a friendly trail race where you choose how far you want to run. The race consists of three out-and-back routes that can be combined to make 10, 26 or 54 km. They offer hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with both technical sections and easy-to-run trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same race centre, creating a social atmosphere where runners meet several times throughout the day. The event is organised by the Trail and Run association and offers an aid station, a drop-bag option and a simple hot meal after the finish.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes from Ånnaboda, with options of 10 km, 26 km or 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and scenic trails
The Bergslagsleden trail is included, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint; everyone starts at the same place and time, creating a social atmosphere
additional: Maximum 70 participants. Race numbers can be collected at the race centre from 08:00. The entry fee is paid via Swish to 123 118 33 18 — include your name as the payment message. Runners must carry all the equipment and energy they need on the course; there is no support along the route, only at the race centre. The race centre has an aid station with water, Umara sports drink, bananas, sweets and more; you can leave your own drop bag there. A simple hot meal is served after the finish (vegetarian option available). Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at SM-stugan (lower car park). Parking is recommended at the lower car park. Three out-and-back routes (10/26/54 km) from Ånnaboda; maximum 70 participants; registration deadline 15 May; start at 09:00 on 16 May 2026; aid station, drop bag and meal after the finish.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Marathon, 6.7 km, 3.5 km, Backyard Ultra
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organized by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people with a sense of adventure and an interest in fitness, and emphasizes the experience of nature as much as performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through scenic, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Hilly trails and slopes in natural surroundings
Varied terrain: trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Beautiful views of Lake Vättern and the surrounding forest
additional: Now organized by Rudu Friskvård. Event hours are listed as 07:00–19:00 on 16 May 2026. Bauer Activities emphasizes that its races are suitable for both beginners and experienced participants, and that the areas (Östra Vätterbranterna) are a UNESCO-designated biosphere with a strong focus on nature. Part of the Gränna StadsTrail program. Registration/contact: info@baueractivities.se.

name: TIF Terrängen 2026
description: Welcome to the 98th TIF Terräng race at Skidstugan in Trollhättan on Saturday, 16 May 2026. The event is organised by Trollhättans IF Friidrott and has four distances: 800 m for children up to age 9, and 2.3 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km (2 laps of 5.2 km), depending on the category. It is a traditional spring race, and results from previous years are published on the club’s website. Register via the event page (REGISTER HERE); questions can be directed to the club using its contact details.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Skidstugan in Trollhättan
Four distances: 800 m (children up to age 9), 2.3 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km (2 laps)
Traditional spring race (98th edition)
additional: Organiser: Trollhättans IF Friidrott. Start and finish at Skidstugan. Results from previous years (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021) are published on the page. Registration text on the page: "REGISTER HERE" (no direct registration link is specified in the scanned pages). Location: Skidstugan in Trollhättan; date: 16 May 2026; distances: 0.8 km, 2.3 km, 5.2 km and 10.4 km (two laps). Registration and results links are available on the event page; the race is part of Västsvenska löparcupen.

name: Örbyhus half-marathon (10K) - Örbyhus
location: Örbyhus, Tierp Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand on 17 May 2026, offering 10 km and 6 km races, as well as two children’s races (1,200 m and 400 m). The course follows a scenic route along the water, passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet. The start and finish are at Kajen in Nacka Strand, and the event is combined with a family festival featuring activities, music and entertainment. The race celebrates local pride and is suitable for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the water
Passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand; family festival with activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, and children’s races of 1,200 m and 400 m. Date and location: 17 May 2026, Kajen in Nacka Strand. Start and finish at the same location, at Kajen. The day includes a family festival with activities, music and entertainment. Part of the registration fee goes to Min Stora Dag.

name: Blodomloppet Munkedal
organizer: Föreningen Blodomloppet (i samarbete med Hälle IF)
description: Blodomloppet in Munkedal returns after its 2024 debut as part of the municipality’s public health initiative, encouraging more people to get active while raising awareness of the importance of blood donation. The event attracted hundreds of participants in its first year and includes Lilla Blodomloppet for children. In 2025, Hälle IF will take part as an organiser, with activities and information about blood donation on site. Registration is open, and everyone is encouraged to take part, regardless of age or fitness level.
course_highlights: Several distances, including 5 km and 10 km
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Start and finish at Örekilsparken
additional: In previous years, Lilla Blodomloppet has been offered free of charge to schoolchildren thanks to support from the municipality. Activities and information about blood donation will be available at the event. All registered teams receive a picnic bag in the finish area (a general detail about Blodomloppet). Hälle IF is listed as a co-organiser of the event in Munkedal. Registration is open according to official information. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, Lilla Blodomloppet, Specialomloppet and a virtual race; participants can take part individually or as a team. Hälle IF is the new co-organiser for 2025.

name: Berga Brostafett
location: Berga, Laholm Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Berga Brostafett is a revival of a five-leg relay in Berga along the Lagan, organised by Lagans AIK. The event is scheduled for 18 May 2026 at 18:00 and is expected to bring together approximately 30 - 40 teams of five runners each. The total distance is approximately 10 km over five legs, with each leg ranging from approximately 1 km to 3.2 km. Information and registration are shared via Lagans AIK’s page and the event on Facebook.
course_highlights: Relay race over bridges in Berga along the Lagan
Approximately 10 km in total over five legs (each approximately 1 km to 3.2 km)
Expected participation of 30 - 40 teams, supporting Lagans AIK
additional: The page contains information about registration for Berga Brostafett but does not show a clear price or registration link. Contact details shown on the page include lagansaik@gmail.com and support@laget.se. An event calendar is available and can be subscribed to via webcal://cal.laget.se/LagansAIK-Bergabrostafett.ics. Each team has five runners; one runner may complete two legs if needed. Registration information is available via Lagans AIK, and updates are shared on Facebook.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5/10 km – 350 kr till 28 april; Efteranmälan 400 kr; Lag: 1 750 kr till 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr till 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Kristianstad in Tivoliparken on 19 May 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races for men and women, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12. It is suitable for runners and walking groups, participating individually or in teams. The scenic course heads into Vattenriket and has varied surfaces (grass, gravel and asphalt). The event traditionally ends with a picnic. It also has a clear community and blood-donation purpose and is run by local associations together with the blood centre.
course_highlights: Scenic course heading into Vattenriket
Surfaces vary between grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place entirely within Tivoliparken; the 5 km and 10 km courses cross the Helge River
additional: Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; the start and finish area is in Tivoliparken; bag storage is available (for bags only); the deadline for team registration is 12 May, and the final registration deadline for all races is 19 May; an Excel template for team registration is available on the registration page

name: Vårruset Stockholm
description: Vårruset Stockholm is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running tour and takes place on Tuesday, 19 May 2026, in Norra Djurgården. Choose between a 2.5 km distance and a measured 5 km course. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced runners, with a warm, community-focused atmosphere. You can enter as a team and finish the evening with a picnic after the race. Registration is online, and the same price applies whether or not you choose to have your time recorded.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Norra Djurgården
The 5 km course is measured
Nearest metro station: Universitetet
additional: Included are a medal, a finish-line bag, the Vårruset music quiz with prizes, a race bib and, for those who choose it, official timekeeping. You can opt out of timekeeping so that your result is not published. Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the race; team members can run different distances. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding, and the entry fee is non-refundable in the event of cancellation. There is also a digital race for participants who cannot attend in person (with medals mailed after the tour). Race bibs are mailed to the address provided at registration for entries submitted before a specified date; any surplus goes 100% back to sport.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part for free, and there is specific information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4 × 4 km in total)
Start, relay exchanges and finish in the beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging or running; timed and untimed categories
additional: Children and young people take part for free thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (school contact: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organiser offers tents and event furnishings for hire through Rent a Tent (booking deadline to guarantee availability: 5 May; contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). The start, relay exchanges and finish are all in the park, creating a lively atmosphere for spectators and the event. Teams consist of four participants; event communications mention a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal at the finish. More than 700 participants and around 180 teams took part in previous years; young people and students participate free of charge thanks to sponsorship from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration are available at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum provides a picnic for all participants; various sponsors offer tents or gathering areas.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities between 4 May and 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and race bib, and teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after crossing the finish line. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, according to the recommendations for each distance.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
The 5 km course is officially measured at all locations
Teams of five receive a picnic after crossing the finish line
additional: Individual registration includes a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. Team registration includes a picnic after crossing the finish line, a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. A team consists of five people, and the picnic voucher is issued only when the entire team (five paying participants) is registered. There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital), where you can run between 4 May and 4 June and have a medal mailed to you; digital registrations cannot be combined with in-person participation in the tour. Payment is accepted via Swish and Klarna; the wellness benefit platforms Epassi, Benefits and Benifex are supported. Instructions on how to register and information about adding team members are available in the FAQ and registration guide on the website. Free training sessions ahead of Vårruset are offered by Falu IK Friidrott in collaboration with Vårruset and Intersport; two training sessions before the race are listed.

name: Stafettvarvet
location: Slottsskogsvallen, Slottsskogen, Göteborg, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: Stafettvarvet is a spectator- and team-friendly relay taking place on 20 May 2026, starting and finishing inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. Each team consists of four participants, all of whom run the same fast 3.2 km course around beautiful Slottsskogen, with the baton handover at the arena. After finishing, the team’s entry includes a picnic bag. Companies can also book a tent site in the entrance park for a team gathering and after-run. Registration is via the Göteborgsvarvet website, and the price per team changes according to the published pricing periods.
course_highlights: Fast 3.2 km loop around beautiful Slottsskogen
Start, baton handover and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
All four team members run the same course; a picnic bag is included
additional: Registration is per team, not per team member. A team consists of 4 participants and can enter the women’s, men’s or mixed category. Relay batons, bibs and picnic bags are collected outside Slottsskogsvallen in the entrance park. Companies can register one or more teams, choose to pay by invoice and book a tent site in the corporate villages. Registration is open until 17:00 on race day, but the event may sell out earlier. The team consists of 4 participants; each runner runs 3.2 km; the start, baton handover and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen; race confirmations/bibs are collected from 15:30 to 17:30; registration is via the Göteborgsvarvet website; corporate teams and invoice payment are available; a picnic bag is included with team registration.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona on 20 May 2026—a recreational event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (800 m), or walk 5 km. The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and walkers have a separate route so participants can finish with a picnic together. The event is organised by KA 2 IF and offers individual and team entries, as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four routes: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Walkers have their own route and can set off first, then enjoy a picnic with the others
The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation and meet the requirements for competition courses
additional: Organiser: KA 2 IF (Blodomloppet contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel. 0793-299924). A team can have up to 5 participants, and team members can take part in different distances. For larger entries, an Excel template is available in the registration system for importing details, as well as the option of a customer page for companies/organisations to manage entries and discount codes in one place. Blood donors and ICA members receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. A picnic after the event is part of the programme. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m and 5 km walk; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up details will be shared later via the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening 5 km race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km loop, completed twice, with a pleasant atmosphere and great spirit along the course. You can take part individually or enter a team (at least five people), with the five fastest times combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop run twice, with a lap split halfway
Start and finish in Stadsparken; the course runs through central Västervik
The course may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Race bibs are available for collection well before the start and must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Collection: Monday 18 May – Intersport 11–14; Tuesday 19 May – Intersport 11–14; Wednesday 20 May – at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (link provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the combined time of the 5 fastest participants; if more than 9 participants are from the same organization, multiple teams can be entered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; race bibs must be collected before 17:30 on race day or according to the schedule; start at 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the programme; 20% team discount with code LAG20.

name: S:t Hans Extreme

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fram till och med 18:e maj gäller ordinarie pris (280:- för vuxna och 180:- för ungdomar/juniorer t o m 20 år och studenter).

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fram till och med 18:e maj gäller ordinarie pris (280:- för vuxna och 180:- för ungdomar/juniorer t o m 20 år och studenter).

description: S:t Hans Extreme is a welcoming but challenging trail race at S:t Hans Backar in Lund, taking place on Thursday, 28 May 2026. The race offers several categories for different levels and ambitions: Ultra (6 hours), 10 km, 5 km and a shorter 2.5 km lap, as well as team events. The course is technical, with significant elevation gain on each lap, and suits both competitive runners and those looking for a tough training challenge. The organisers welcome everyone and provide practical information about registration, payment and start times on their information page.
course_highlights: The course runs on S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km (with an out-and-back section so runners can cheer each other on); ultra runners complete as many laps as possible within 6 hours
additional: Register via Mittlopp.se (link from the organiser’s registration page). The regular online price applies until 18/5; late online registration is available 18–25/5 at a higher price. You can also register late at Löplabbet in Lund on 26/5 from 16–18 (in-store discount), and at the event venue on 28/5 (ultra categories 13:20–13:50, other categories 16:45–18:20). Payment is preferably by Swish (Lunds OK’s Swish number: 123 303 6787); cash in exact change is accepted in exceptional cases. Runners from Lunds Orienteringsklubb pay a reduced fee (50:-). Team events: the fastest team is determined over 40 km, and there is also a team competition for the greatest total distance. Course information: lap-based course at S:t Hans Backar, 2.55 km per lap with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain; the ultra categories take place within 6 hours. Start and finish at S:t Hans Backar. Registration and payment via Mittlopp.se; Swish payment; a live results link is available on the race page. Ongoing roadworks on Svenshögsvägen between Norra Ringen and Magistratsvägen may affect access; cycling or public transport is recommended.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 21 May 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but you can opt out when registering if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is officially measured (2.5 km is also available)
additional: Registration is online and remains open through race day, closing no later than one hour before the first start. Recommended ages: 5 km: 13 years (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: 11 years (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. Participant benefits include a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, and a race bib. Timing is available for the 5 km but can be opted out of. Local organiser: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training meetup will be published with separate registration via Västerås FK’s registration page. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; a team consists of five people, and registration is available as a team or individually. Timing can be opted out of during registration. Registration is online, and a picnic is served after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Take part in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Linköping! The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes that you can walk, jog or run, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for younger participants. The event is team- and business-friendly: many people take part in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. You can register individually or as part of a team, and the organiser offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (walk, jog or run)
Suitable for individual participants and teams (3–5 people; often teams of five)
The event ends with a large communal picnic
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 people); teams always pay for five, and you can add members to make a full team free of charge by 30 April (contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee until 30 April. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The deadline for team registration is 14 May; online registration is open until the start. Everyone who registers by 14 May and provides a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Race bib collection: 19 May, 11:00–19:00 (GeBlod, Storgatan 32); 20 May, 12:00–18:00 (GeBlod); and 21 May, 16:00–19:00 (Saab Arena). From 1 May, some changes may require an in-person visit. Businesses can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the event are available. The team registration deadline may be in mid-May, and payment methods include Swish, card and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, organised by OK Hällen since 2012. The event is suitable for all ages and running abilities, with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, shorter children’s races, and a new dog class in 2026. The courses combine grass, trails and roads through woodland and a residential area. The event is popular with both individual runners and teams/work groups who want to compete together. Teams receive a picnic basket, which can be collected from the catering tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trails and grass through woodland and a residential area
Start and finish on the green space next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill sprint: timing on the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Little Kids 17:40, Primary/Middle School Class 18:00, Dog 18:15–18:20 (fast dogs first), Adults (including team competition) 18:45. The participant bag and race bib with timing chip must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the relevant start. Teams receive a picnic basket (collected from the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available as directed along road 52; cycling is recommended. The dog class is limited to 30 participants, and dog owners must clean up after their dogs. A dog-friendly option will be introduced in 2026, with a separate start for runners with dogs; participants can run, have the dog pull them, or walk in Stigtomta.

name: Uka Pain (SM Trail)
description: Sweden Runners IF warmly welcomes you to Uka Pain on 22–23 May 2026 in beautiful Älvdalen. The event offers several distances, from 12 km up to 100 miles, and includes the Trail Swedish Championships/Masters Championships (28 km) and Junior Swedish Championships (12 km). The race centre and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses run through Älvdalen’s magnificent terrain, with both runnable trails and more technical sections. The event offers a real challenge and views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The 52 km course has approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain
The course climbs to the summits of Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget
Mostly trails, with sections ranging from easy-running to very technical terrain; orange course markings
additional: Entry includes a race bib, timing, energy and aid stations, a finisher’s medal and a participant T-shirt (register by 30/4 to receive a T-shirt). Race-bib collection is at The Running Company (Dalgatan 81F) from Friday 22/5. Bus transport is available between Hotell Älvdalen and Boggberget for 100 Miles participants (departure at 15:10). No on-site registration. Name and category changes are possible until 14 May. Mandatory equipment is required for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles. Cut-off times and checkpoint cut-off times are listed in the race information (e.g. 9 h for 28 km, 10 h for 50 km, 20 h for 100 km and 34 h for 100 miles). Start times: Friday 16:00–Saturday 02:00; drop bags are permitted for 100 km and 100 miles; GPS trackers are provided for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment is required for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; race centre at Hotell Älvdalen.

name: adidas Stockholm Marathon
description: The adidas Stockholm Marathon is a classic marathon that takes place this year on 30 May 2026 and attracts both elite and recreational runners. The race is 42,195 metres long, measured according to current regulations, and follows a new course through central Stockholm. The event is organised by athletics clubs Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the organisers highlight extensive runner services along the course. The race starts at Stockholm Olympic Stadium and offers seeding opportunities through events including adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan.
course_highlights: 42,195 metres, measured according to the Swedish Athletics Association and IAAF
New course through central Stockholm (including Sveavägen and Kungsgatan), passing through the city
World-class runner services along the entire course
additional: Start and finish area: Lidingövägen outside the clock tower at Stockholm Olympic Stadium. The race starts in two waves, at 12:00 and 12:10. The marathon time limit is 6.5 hours, and there are four checkpoints with cut-off times along the course. Seeding: the deadline for submitting a time for seeding is 3 May 2026; adidas Premiärmilen and adidas Premiärhalvan count towards seeding. adidas Premiärmilen (10 km) takes place in Norra Djurgården, has a total elevation gain of 117 m, mixed surfaces and a provisional start time of 11:00; the time limit is 2 hours and the contact for Premiärmilen is info@premiarmilen.se. The event is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK, and the website is provided by Marathongruppen i Stockholm AB. The event is sold out for 30 May 2026. The course runs through central Stockholm and finishes at Stockholm Olympic Stadium; runners can also take part in related Adidas events such as Premiärmilen, Premiärhalvan and Shake Out Run.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organised by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly city race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans torg, and the event includes a toddler race, Lilla Stadsloppet, and 5 km and 10 km races (with the option of running with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, 23 May 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. There is a bonus associated with the 10 km course record.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans torg
Toddler race (ages 0–6), Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), and 5 km and 10 km races
10 km: bonus/prize for a course record
additional: Register via a Google Form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Race schedule: 11:00 Toddler race (ages 0–6), 11:30 Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), 13:00 start for the 5 km and 10 km races (with or without timing). The start/finish is between the railway station and the marina at Charlie Normans torg. All races start and finish at Charlie Normans torg; the day's programme includes different races, from a short toddler race to longer running distances.

name: Cityvarvet
description: Cityvarvet is a shorter, 4.3 km version of Göteborgsvarvet. It starts at Götaplatsen and takes you along Avenyn to a spectacular finish at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is a festive event with large crowds, music and cheer stations along the course, and is suitable for beginners, fast runners and families. We recommend that children up to 13 years old run with an adult. As a runner, you have access to the Runner Zone at the finish for recovery, snacks and drinks.
course_highlights: Start at Götaplatsen and run down Avenyn towards Slottsskogen
A 4.3 km city course with large crowds, music and cheer stations
Finish inside Slottsskogsvallen and access to the Runner Zone for recovery
additional: Distance: 4.3 km. Maximum 1,500 registered runners. Registration is open until 12:00 on race day (2026-05-23). Bib and start-card collection: pick up Thursday–Saturday, 21–23 May, at the Göteborgsvarvet Expo at Friidrottens Hus (Thursday 11:00–20:30, Friday 10:00–21:00, Saturday from 09:00). Two water stations on the course. Children up to 13 years old are recommended to run with an adult. Maximum 1,500 participants; start time 13:00; bib collection at the Expo (Friidrottens Hus); bag storage at the start until 12:30; water stations along the course; electronic chip timing; maximum time approximately 50 minutes; transport and expo information is available on the start-card page; changing facilities are not provided.

name: Luleå Stadsmara
description: Luleå Stadsmara is one of Norrland’s largest and oldest running events, bringing participants, partners and spectators together for a weekend filled with activity and community. On 23 May 2026, Stadsmaran celebrates its 45th anniversary, and the whole city is transformed into a shared arena. The event features races for all ages—from the Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet for children to a half marathon, city race and cross-country race—and is designed as a community celebration where runners and spectators alike are welcome.
course_highlights: A city race that turns large parts of the city into a course and spectator arena
The JIAB Ställningsmontage race is a challenging cross-country race
The Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet give children their own lively start to the day
additional: Stadsmaran traditionally begins with the Knatteloppet and MAX-loppet. The organiser is StiL Sportcenter (Universitetsvägen C11, 977 54 Luleå). Contact reception: 0920 - 50 21 20. Information about opening hours and reception may vary on public holidays. The event offers several distances, from short children’s races to the half marathon; bib collection takes place at Stil Sportcenter, Universitetsvägen 11C; start and finish in Luleå City, with spectators along the course; the 2026 anniversary year features new elements that enhance the overall experience.

name: Uka Pain
description: UKA PAIN is a trail and ultrarunning event in Älvdalen, Dalarna, held over the weekend of 22–23 May 2026. The event offers several distances—12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles—with the 28 km race serving as the Trail-SM/VSM and the 12 km race as the JSM on 23 May. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses run through woodland in the area, marked in orange. GPS trackers and drop bags are available for longer distances, and information about accommodation and registration is available on the official pages. Some distances require specific equipment, and participants are asked to bring their own cup to the aid stations.
course_highlights: Several distances to choose from: 12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles
Trail-SM/VSM categories over 28 km and JSM over 12 km on 23 May
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen, with orange course markings and logistical support such as drop bags and GPS trackers for the longer races
additional: Race headquarters at Hotell Älvdalen; bib collection at The Running Company near the hotel; drop bags permitted for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment applies only to the 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; participants must bring their own cup to the aid stations; GPS trackers are available for 100 miles and 100 km; start times include 16:00 on 22 May for 100 miles and 09:00/10:30/23:00 on 23 May for the other distances; course markings are orange.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
location: Vänge, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Backyard Ultra Vänge is a unique ultrarunning event organized by Hagunda IF, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour until only one runner remains. The race takes place in Vänge, about 7 km outside Uppsala along Route 72, and combines challenging terrain with a scenic natural setting and a strong sense of community. There is also a team competition with a points system that rewards fair average times and larger teams; registration opens on 18/9, and the next race is planned for 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6.7 km (6,706 meters)
A trail race in scenic surroundings with challenging sections
A new loop starts every hour on the hour; complete it before the hour ends to continue
additional: The maximum capacity is listed as 180 participants (the page shows 179/180 places filled). The race has a team competition with a points system that removes the highest and lowest results to calculate a fair average and gives bonuses to larger teams. A loop starts every hour, and only those who complete it before the hour ends can start the next loop. Results and past races are published on the event’s results page. Capacity: 180 participants; 179 places filled and 1 place remaining.

name: Sidsjö Trail
description: Sidsjö Trail is a nature-focused trail race around Lake Sidsjön and Södra Berget in Sundsvall, taking place on Saturday, 23 May 2026. Runners can choose between children’s races and courses of approximately 3 km, 6 km and 12 km. The routes feature forest trails, hilly terrain and beautiful lake views. The race is suitable for both experienced trail runners and beginners, and is organised by Sidsjö Böle IF P-14 together with morron. The mass start is at 10:15, and there is no official timing.
course_highlights: Routes around Lake Sidsjön and Södra Berget with lake views
A variety of forest trails and hilly terrain
Start and finish at the Sidsjön outdoor recreation area
additional: Regular registration closes on Friday, 22 May at 18:00. Late online registration is available until 08:00 on race day, and on-site registration is open from 09:30 to 10:30. The start and finish are at the Sidsjön outdoor recreation area. Race bibs are collected upon presentation of proof of payment. Medical personnel will be on site, and all registered participants will receive a medal (wooden medals with jute cord). Sustainability measures include recycling stations and minimising single-use items. Photos and videos may be published; if you do not wish to appear, notify event@morron.se. Recommended public transport: Bus 142 (Sundsvall Böle) and Bus 3 (Mårtensro stop). ICA near Sidsjö is offering participating children a Kexchoklad at the finish. Mass start at 10:15; no timing; on-site registration is available; children’s races are offered. Photos and video footage may be published in the media; notify the organisers if you do not wish to appear in photos.

name: VirsboRUN
location: Skräddartorpet, Virsbo, Fagersta Municipality, Västmanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN, a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, 23 May 2026. You can choose to run 1–4 laps of the 5.3 km loop (up to 21.2 km), or let the children take part in the free kids’ race of approximately 800 metres. The course passes through unspoilt nature and Hälleskogsbrännan, with varied trails and beautiful views. After finishing, participants receive a medal and a freshly grilled hamburger.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop (up to 4 laps) — choose how many laps you want to run
Challenging terrain with approximately 101 metres of elevation gain per lap, including rocky sections and forest trails in Hälleskogsbrännan
Kids’ race, approximately 800 m (free), and an additional water station about halfway around (~2.5 km)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Stora Ladan from 10:00. The kids’ race is limited to 50 participants, and the women’s and men’s classes are limited to 150 starters. Late registration is available until approximately 1 hour before the start on race day. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a bag of surprises; freshly grilled hamburgers are also served (including vegetarian options). Relays are permitted (2–4 people), the maximum race time is 3 hours, and participation is at your own risk (no refunds). Participants must wear their race number visibly on their stomach; dogs are not permitted. Virsbo Fire and Rescue Service will be on site. Trail race in the forest near Virsbo at Skräddartorpet; 5.3 km loops with 101 m of elevation gain per lap; free kids’ course (800 m); medals for everyone; freshly grilled hamburgers for all competitors; outdoor gym, parking, changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets and refreshments on site.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is a city running race where runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts and finishes in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers a run through beautiful urban surroundings, according to official information sources. The date listed for the 2026 edition is 23 May, and the organiser is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. The official Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 metres, offering an additional distance option.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Run through beautiful urban surroundings
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (with consideration for different courses and experience levels)
additional: Official sources list the distances as 5 km and 10 km, with the start and finish in the city park. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 23 May. The Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 m.

description: Stadionloppet takes place on Sunday, 24 May 2026, with the start, lap point and finish at the historic Stockholm Stadion. The main event is a 5 km race on a two-lap course around the scenic areas of the stadium, and there are also categories for children and young people. The race is family-friendly and community-focused, organised by Djurgårdens IF Friidrott, with chip timing and prizes for the top three.
course_highlights: Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Stadion
The 5 km main event follows a two-lap course around the stadium
Children’s and youth categories (shorter courses; some categories are untimed)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; after that, registration is available on site only. The timing chip is attached to the race bib, and both net and gun times are used; placing is based on net time. Race packs are distributed from 10:00 on race day. Payment by card and Swish is available before race day; on race day, Swish only. Members of Djurgårdens IF Friidrott can register for free using the code sent to them. Everyone who registers receives two football tickets (one men’s match and one women’s match). Medical staff will be on site. DIF Running offers practice sessions on the race course during the spring. The listed distance options include 5 km and shorter distances (400 m, 1.2 km and 2.6 km); the first start is at 12:00. Practice sessions on the race course are offered during the spring.

description: Stadionloppet is a running race starting, completing its laps and finishing at Stockholm Stadium on Sunday, 24 May 2026. The main race is 5 km and follows a two-lap course through the scenic grounds around the stadium. There are also categories for children and young people over various distances. The race offers chip timing and attractive prizes for the winners. All participants also receive tickets to football matches as part of their membership in Djurgårdens IF Friidrott.
course_highlights: 5 km two-lap course through the scenic grounds around Stockholm Stadium
Categories for children and young people, with distances from 400 m to 5 km
Start, lap point and finish at historic Stockholm Stadium
additional: Net and gun times are recorded using the chip in the race bib. Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; after that, registration is available only on site. Payment by card and Swish is accepted before race day; on race day, payment is by Swish only. Members of Djurgården Friidrott can register for free using a code. All participants receive two tickets, one to a men's football match and one to a women's football match; tickets can be collected on race day from 10:00. Medical staff will be on site. The event also includes shorter distances for younger participants, and registration is via RaceID. The event takes place on the same day as the cycling race Stadiongirot.

name: Blodomloppet (Umeå)

price_tiers.distance: Promenad 5 km, löpning 5 km och 10 km

description: Blodomloppet in Umeå is a recreational event held to raise awareness of the life-saving importance of blood donation and promote a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 or 10 kilometres in central Umeå, starting and finishing at Skeppsbron. It is a social and inclusive activity, with participants often signing up in teams and ending the event with a shared picnic. Blodomloppet is an important campaign to recruit new blood donors and has a strong tradition in Västerbotten, with more than 1,400 participants. Children can also take part in Lilla Blodomloppet, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Skeppsbron in central Umeå
Choose between 5 km and 10 km, walking, jogging or running
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
additional: Teams of at least 5 people receive a picnic bag when they register. The deadline for team registration with a picnic bag is 18 May. Running evenings are held ahead of the event to inspire and include runners of all levels. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person on the entry fee. Registration changes are free until 21 May; after that, changes require an in-person visit and cost 50 kr. The event includes preparatory running evenings, team registration and options for businesses, and a focus on promoting a healthy lifestyle and blood donation.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is an evening race held by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken, with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The race is open to participants of different ages, and registered participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Timing is optional, and teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. The event is organized locally by IKHP Huskvarna and welcomes both recreational and experienced runners for an enjoyable spring evening.
course_highlights: The course runs by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
Choose between 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured)
Timing is optional and can be declined so that results are not published
additional: Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing; individual and team registrations include a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. You can opt out of timing during registration so that your result is not published. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (or 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (or 7 when accompanied by an adult). A free training session is held before the season (for example, 19 March at 18:30 at Rocksjöstadion). Registration is online and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IKHP Huskvarna. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km. Age recommendations: 5 km: age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams consist of 5 people; the team leader enters their details, and members enter their details before the team registration is submitted. Picnic after finishing. Event area: Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.

name: Blodomloppet Hudiksvall

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 6 maj)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km tidtagning – 350 kr (400 kr fr.o.m. 6 maj)

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Hudiksvall, a recreational race that highlights the importance of blood donation. Take part by walking, jogging or running 5 km or 10 km (both timed), or sign the children up for Lilla Blodomloppet. The local event is organised by Strands IF Friidrott in partnership with GeBlod Gävleborg and traditionally ends with a shared picnic. Registration is open, with team registration and group-specific options available.
course_highlights: Choice of 5 km and 10 km distances, both timed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Traditionally ends with a picnic after the race
additional: Timing is available for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Team registration is available (SEK 1,750), and an Excel template can be downloaded for large registrations; the organiser can help set up a registration page or discount code for groups of over 50 participants. GeBlod Gävleborg is listed as the local blood donation partner, with a contact telephone number and calling hours. Information pages provide details about race numbers, storage, changing facilities, toilets, water stations and parking. Team activities and a picnic bag for teams are mentioned. Storage near the ice rink/Holmen Arena is limited, and parking may be limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is an accessible fun run for women, held as part of the Vårruset national tour. Participants can run 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The event suits both competitive runners and those who want to enjoy an evening walk on a spring evening. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish, while individual entrants receive a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib. The event is organised in collaboration with the local club IF Göta Karlstad, with the event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km course
Event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Option to opt out of official timing at no extra cost
additional: What’s included: a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, timing on the 5 km course for those who choose it, and a race bib (team entries include a picnic after the finish). Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is online and remains open until race day, up to one hour before the first start. It is possible to take part in Vårruset digitally during the tour (4 May–4 June). Digital participants will have a medal sent to their home but cannot attend the local event. Includes pre-race meetups at Skutberget (15 April and 6 May at 18:00). Recommended ages by distance: 5 km—up to age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km—up to age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). The event also collaborates with Barncancerfonden.

name: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,5–3,8 km)

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is a friendly, festive fun run starting and finishing in Bruksparken in central Finspång. The main race is 7 km on a flat surface through the town, with a shorter AktivRundan and a children’s race (XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan) also available. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and the event is known for enthusiastic crowd support, music and award ceremonies. In 2026, the race celebrates its tenth anniversary and welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: 7 km through central Finspång on a flat, smooth surface
The course is lined with spectators and music to cheer on the runners
Shorter AktivRundan (about 3.8 km), untimed, and a 1.7 km children’s race
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken; race-bib collection at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday 26 May, 15:00–19:00; bibs not collected at Coop will be distributed at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start; the top tab on the bib is the chip that records the time; no shower facilities; everyone who walks, jogs or runs to the finish receives energy products from COOP and a water bottle sponsored by Finspångs Brunnsborrning; medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet; late registration via the website from 18–25 May costs 395 kr (online), and late registration at bib collection on 26–27 May costs 425 kr (in person). 7 km course through central Finspång (start/finish in Bruksparken); AktivRundan approximately 3.5–3.8 km; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan 1.7 km for children. Bib collection at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga; the chip is activated via the tab at the top of the bib; registration and payment via Swish are available; on race day, the event opens at 15:00 in Bruksparken. The 2026 edition is the 10th anniversary; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan starts at 17:00, and the main race starts at 19:00.

name: Finspångs Stadslopp

price_tiers.distance: Gladsheim Finspångs Stadslopp (7 km) och AktivRundan (3,5-3,8 km)
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan (1,7 km barnlopp)

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Run is an annual fun run through beautiful Finspång, starting and finishing in Bruksparken. The event offers a 7-kilometre course suitable for all recreational runners, whether you walk, jog or run. Those looking for a shorter challenge can take part in AktivRundan, which is 3.8 kilometres, while children can run the 1.7-kilometre XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026, with a lively celebration of running, music, prizes and community. After the race, an official After Run offers a chance to relax and mingle.
course_highlights: 7 km city course through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km for a shorter distance
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday 26 May between 15:00 and 19:00. Late registration is available at the start and finish area from 15:00 on race day. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet, energy products from COOP Finspång and a water bottle from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib. Showers are not available. After the race, an official After Run is hosted at Joan’s by Promotionhuset. DigFab-Spurten is an optional sprint of approximately 100 metres, with prizes of its own. Prize money and special prizes are awarded to elite runners and age categories. Trail and city race, registration via the website, race-bib collection at Coop, various distances including Lilla Slottsrundan, anniversary celebrations in 2026.

name: Blodomloppet Uppsala
location: Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
