description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Örebro—a community event that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. The event offers races and a festive atmosphere for both 5 km and 10 km (women/men), a short Special Race, and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. You can register individually or in a team of five, and the event is suitable for walkers and runners of all ages. The organizer also encourages a sense of community and often rounds off the event with a large picnic.
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (a team consists of 5 participants, with 1–2 places allowed to remain vacant). Team fees apply, and classes can be mixed; an Excel template for bulk registration is available. Lilla Blodomloppet is for children aged 1–12 (adults may accompany them), and the first 200 children to register by 2026-04-30 can participate for free under the organizer’s offer. Discounts are available for blood donors, ICA Stammis members, and through a campaign with Nerikes Allehanda (SEK 40, with some restrictions—not valid during late registration). The deadline for team registration is 2026-05-26; individuals can register until the event, approximately 30 minutes before the start, but the fee is usually higher. For registration assistance, contact orebro@blodomloppet.se or kansli@blodomloppet.se.

name: Vårruset Östersund
description: Vårruset in Östersund is a local event in the nationwide Vårruset tour, offering an accessible evening race of 2.5 km or 5 km along the shore of Lake Storsjön. The event is open to runners of different ages and offers both individual registration and team registration (teams of five), with a picnic after the finish for teams. Official timing is available for the 5 km and can be declined during registration. All participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The start and finish are by Lake Storsjön, and the event area is north of Badhusparken at the former Yran campsite.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of Lake Storsjön
Start and finish by Lake Storsjön; event area north of Badhusparken (former Yran campsite)
Choose between 2.5 km or a certified 5 km course
additional: Included with individual registration: medal, finish-line bag, Vårruset music quiz and prizes, race bib and, for those who choose it, timing for the 5 km; team registration includes a picnic after the finish. Race bib pickup at Intersport Östersund on 23 May, 11–17, and 30 May, 11–17. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is available online until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. There is also a separate Vårruset Digital (2.5 km or 5 km), which can be completed from 4 May to 4 June; digital participants receive their medal by mail and cannot take part in the in-person event. Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km (certified 5 km course); teams consist of five people and have a picnic after the finish; online registration, with the option to decline timing; medal, finish-line bag and race bib included; race bib pickup at Intersport Östersund.

name: Blodomloppet Stockholm
description: Blodomloppet Stockholm is a festive community race held to highlight the need for blood donation. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances for runners and walkers, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children, and traditionally ends with a picnic. Timed race categories are available, with prizes for the three fastest runners. Everyone is welcome—run, jog or walk for an important cause.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km options to walk, jog or run
5 km walking category where dogs are allowed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children: 1.1 km (ages 7–12) and 800 m (ages 1–6)
additional: A team consists of 5 people (at least 3 names are required at registration), and team registration must be completed by 28 May; team registration includes a picnic bag. Extra picnic bags cost SEK 250 and can be added until 28 May. Blood donors receive a SEK 40 discount (state this at registration) and a blood donor gift is distributed at the GeBlod tent; remote participants receive an ICA gift card (SEK 250) instead of a picnic bag. Invoice payment is available only for orders over SEK 1,500. Walking poles are allowed only in walking categories; strollers are not allowed during the race but are welcome in the event area. Venue at Djurgårdsbrunn; the start corral opens approximately 20 minutes before the start; the walking category is untimed; no access to changing rooms or showers; blood donors receive a registration discount (SEK 40).

name: Vårruset 2025 — Luleå
description: Vårruset in Luleå is an evening race in Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour, taking place on Thursday, 4 June 2026, with the event arena at StiL Sportscenter. Choose between 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The race is open to participants of all fitness levels. Individual entries include a medal, a post-race bag and a race bib; team entries (teams of five) include a picnic after the finish. The event combines the joy of running with social activities such as Vårruset’s music quiz and the option to opt out of official timing.
course_highlights: The 5 km course is officially measured
Choose between 2.5 km and 5 km
Arena and start at StiL Sportscenter, Universitetsvägen 11 (Luleå)
additional: Registration is online and remains open until race day, at the latest one hour before the first start. Individual entries include a medal, a post-race bag, a race bib and (for those who choose it) timing; timing can be opted out of so that results are not published. Team entries (five people) include a picnic after the finish. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (or age 11 with an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (or age 7 with an adult). A virtual race is also available (2.5 km or 5 km), with the medal sent after the tour ends; virtual registration does not include a picnic, music quiz or official timing. A training meet-up is held on the same day and at the same time in several locations (in Luleå: 19 March at 18:30 at StiL Sportscenter). Registration is binding and the entry fee is non-refundable. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team entry includes a picnic after the finish; virtual registration; timing information; age recommendations: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 with an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 with an adult); training opportunities, including training meet-ups in 19 locations.

name: Jernbrukets backyard Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad 150 kr som betalas direkt till The Tannery Club.

description: Jernbrukets Backyard Ultra is a backyard ultramarathon starting and finishing at Restaurang Jernbruket in Floda. The race follows a 6.7 km loop, which must be completed in under 60 minutes; the next loop starts on the hour, and the last runner remaining wins—the race continues for as long as the participants can keep going. The course runs through hilly woodland around the Säveån river valley and Nääs Castle, and the organiser plans both day and night running. The restaurant by the station serves as race headquarters, and the organiser highlights good food and an authentic early-summer forest experience for runners and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop in backyard format, to be completed in under 60 minutes
Hilly woodland with significant elevation gain, around the Säveån river valley and Nääs Castle
Start and finish at Restaurang Jernbruket, about 150 metres from Floda railway station
additional: The race starts and finishes at Restaurang Jernbruket (Floda stationsväg 3), near Floda railway station; the main race is limited to 100 participants. The Backe-Yard option starts at 10:00, with the final start at 15:00 (run as many loops as you like during those hours), and offers blueberry soup, Umara sports drink and snacks. After the race, a wood-fired sauna and swimming are available at The Tannery Club (fee of 150 kr, paid directly to the club). Backyard Ultra format: 6.7 km loop under 60 minutes; a start every hour; the last runner remaining wins; two courses for day and night running; location: the Floda area, with Restaurang Jernbruket as race headquarters; start time according to the Facebook page: 18:00 on 6 June.

name: NATTMILEN 2026 - Sundsvall
description: Nattmilen is a night race through Sundsvall’s urban streets, with a festival atmosphere, an after-run and the start and finish at Stora torget. The event takes place on 5 June 2026, with a mass start at 22:00. Timed 5 km and 10 km distances are available, as well as the option to run any distance without timing. The race is organised by morron in collaboration with restaurant Bloco and local sports teams, offering an experience in the beautiful stone city of Sundsvall. The organisers document the event in photos and video; if you do not wish to appear, let them know at event@morron.se.
course_highlights: Run through Sundsvall’s beautiful stone city
Start and finish at Stora torget (mass start)
Timed 5 km and 10 km distances, with the option to run any distance without timing
additional: Late registration: online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start, if places remain. Collect your race bib at Stadium City during race week or at the venue between 19:00 and 21:30 on race day. Timing uses a numbered chip and start/finish mats; everyone receives a medal. A water station with water and sports drink is available. Age limits: from age 12 when accompanied by an adult, or from age 14 independently. You may transfer your entry until Thursday 5 June at 23:59 for a fee of 100 kr via event@morron.se. Accommodation offer at Scandic City (booking: event.sundsvallcity@scandichotels.com). Mass start and timing; START at 22:00; distances of 5 km, 10 km, or 5/10 km without timing (and FunRun according to some sources); finish area with a bar; after-run; event photography and filming, with opt-out information.

name: BUM Borås Ultramaraton
description: Welcome to the new BUM – Borås Ultra Marathon, organized by SOK Knallen. The race takes place on Sunday, May 30, 2026, starting and finishing at Kypegården in Borås. The event offers distances of 50 km, a half marathon (21.1 km), and 10 km; the courses are being scouted and finalized during the spring. Registration is via mittlopp.se. According to the federation, participants must be at least 17 years old during the calendar year to run the half marathon or longer distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Kypegården in Borås
Three distances: 50 km, 21.1 km (half marathon), and 10 km
The courses are being scouted and finalized during the spring; opportunities to follow or join course scouting are shared on the club’s Facebook page
additional: Register at mittlopp.se. According to the Swedish Sports Federation’s rules, participants must turn 17 during the calendar year to run the half marathon (21.1 km) or longer distances. The courses are being developed and measured, and scouting takes place during the club’s Sunday training sessions. The organizers encourage participants to follow the club on Facebook for information about course scouting. The start and finish area, along with practical information, will be at Kypegården. Minimum age for longer distances: 17.

name: Söder Runt
description: Söder Runt is a 10 km evening race that makes a lap around Södermalm and is consistently described as both scenic and very fast. The fourteenth edition takes place on Saturday, 6 June 2026, with the first start provisionally scheduled for 19:45. The course is officially measured, flat and easy to run along the water, making the race popular with people aiming for personal bests. After the finish, an After Run party is held with food, drinks and music.
course_highlights: 10.00 km around Södermalm along the water
Flat, easy-to-run course on asphalt and gravel
Water stations after 4 km and at the finish
additional: Age limit: 14 (18 for the After Run); strollers and dogs are not permitted; everyone who completes the race receives a medal and products at the finish; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation; volunteers are mainly from Löparakademin and Fredrikshofs FIF; payment via online banking, card, Swish, or invoice/bankgiro for larger group registrations. Start at Tantolunden; finish at Hornstulls strand; flat course on asphalt and gravel; age limit: 18; strollers and dogs not permitted; After Run party; sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation.

name: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon
description: Björnfrossa Ultramarathon is a scenic but challenging trail race of approximately 65 km through the bear country of Gästrikland, starting and finishing at Kungsberget recreation facility. The course mainly follows the Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden and Fäbodleden trails, with technical trails, gravel roads, several beautiful viewpoints and approximately 1,200 m of total elevation gain. The race is organized by the Björnfrossa organizing association and has strong local roots—the idea was born in 2017 among a group of runners from Sandviken. Runners of all levels who want to experience the region’s long-distance running scenery are welcome, but the race is not sanctioned.
course_highlights: Approximately 65 km along the Gästrikeleden, Lenåsleden and Fäbodleden trails
Approximately 1,200 m of total elevation gain; a mix of technical trails and gravel roads
Several viewpoints along the course
additional: Cutoff time: 12 hours. Four staffed aid stations along the course with water, sports drink and light refreshments; trash bags are available for rubbish. Race bibs are handed out at the start area and must be worn visibly throughout the race. Drop-bag service is not available—anything you want to bring must be carried from the start. Recommended equipment: a mobile phone with a map and an emergency number, which will be announced later; there are no formal equipment requirements, but be prepared for several hours between stations. Medical staff are available at the start/finish; runners are responsible for themselves out on the course, and in an emergency call 112. Four staffed aid stations; no drop bags; approximately 15 km between each aid station; medical staff at the start and finish; call 112 in an emergency; not a sanctioned race.

name: Fiskebäcksloppet 2026 (Önnered)
description: Fiskebäcksloppet is Räddningsmissionen’s running festival in the Sjöbacka nature area, taking place on Saturday, 6 June 2026. The event offers several distances: 10 km (Tre hamnar), 5 km (Sjöbacka), 2.5 km (Lilla Fiskebäcksloppet) and a mini race. The course passes through three harbours and features beautiful scenery. All entry fees go directly to Räddningsmissionen’s social work, and the event welcomes both first-time and returning runners.
course_highlights: The course passes through three harbours
Beautiful scenery in the Sjöbacka nature area
Several distances: 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km and a mini race (approx. 500 m)
additional: The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00. Race bibs can be collected on site. There will be a group warm-up and an awards ceremony on stage. Marshals, medical staff and traffic stewards will be on site. Facilities include bicycle parking, toilets, a bouncy castle and bag drop. A team competition is available, and participants can start their own fundraiser for Räddningsmissionen. The course passes three harbours. The event area is open from 11:30 to 17:00, with race-bib collection, food for purchase, a group warm-up, an awards ceremony, a bouncy castle, medical staff and traffic stewards. Participants can also take part in the team competition and start their own fundraiser for Räddningsmissionen’s social work.

name: Victorialoppet 2026
location: Kungsgatan, Borgholms Idrottsplats, Borgholm, Kalmar County, Sweden

price_tiers.distance: Lilla Victorialoppet (2 km / 1,5 km) & Parasport (2 km)

description: Victorialoppet in Borgholm is Öland’s big running festival, offering races for the whole family—from Mini for the very youngest to the 9 km main race. The running event has a long tradition and donates part of its surplus to Crown Princess Victoria’s Fund; a virtual running option is also available. The Mini, Lilla and Victoriajoggen races start on Kungsgatan by Borgholm’s sports ground, and the event has a festive atmosphere with spectators, music and seaside views. Participants can find information about bib collection, changing facilities and prizes in the participant information.
course_highlights: The main race has a fast, easy-to-run course
Beautiful seaside views, with the courses running mostly through the harbour area
Enthusiastic spectators and music entertainment at several points along the course
additional: Bib collection on race day at Borgholm Sporthall, 10:00–18:00. There is water along the 9 km course, with music entertainment at several locations. Prizes and commemorative plaques/medals are awarded by category (Victorialoppet receives a commemorative plaque; Victoriajoggen and para categories receive a medal; Lilla Victorialoppet receives a medal, ice cream and a drink). Changing rooms and showers: men/boys at Borgholm Sporthall; women/girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Timing uses a disposable chip where timing is offered. Standard fees apply from 15 June, and late registration on 15 July has higher fees. Check-in deadlines: 9 km by 18:00, 4 km by 16:45, and 2 km/1.5 km at least 15 minutes before the start.

name: Västerås Stadslopp
description: Västerås Stadslopp is organized by Västerås Friidrottsklubb and invites everyone to a welcoming, family-friendly day of running in the city on Sunday, 7 June 2026. The event offers races for adults (including 10 km and 2.5 km), three children’s race distances, and a Para Race for participants with disabilities. There is a four-person team category with a picnic/food hamper as the prize, activities for children in Vasaparken, and every participant receives a city race medal. The organizer encourages people to register early, as places in the children’s races are limited and have sold out in previous years.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Rådhuset, with a festival area and services at the start
Children’s races and the Para Race in Vasaparken, with distances of approximately 200 m, 400 m, or 800 m to choose from
Toilets and water refill points in front of Rådhuset, near the start and finish
additional: The children’s races have three untimed distances (approximately 200 m, 400 m, and 800 m) and are limited to a maximum of 400 children. Teams of four receive a food hamper from Hemköp Malmaberg (the deadline for team registration is 31/5), and team members do not have to run the same race. Race numbers can be collected in the days before the event; they must be attached with safety pins and worn visibly on the stomach/chest. Friskis & Svettis leads a warm-up approximately 10 minutes before each race. Participants in the Para Race receive a medal and a goodie bag. There is no prize-giving or timing for the 2.5 km race; honorary prizes go to the top three finishers in the 10 km and 5 km races. Companies can book a tent (5000 kr) or a beach flag (2500 kr) via henrik@vasterasfriidrott.se. Team registration is available (teams of four receive a food hamper after finishing). All participants receive a medal and a goodie bag at the finish. There are water stations along the course and activities in Vasaparken during the event.

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
location: Gallabergsskogen, Vretstorp, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Vretstorps IF Löpning organizes Gallaberget Trailrun in Gallabergsskogen, with running around Gallabergssjön. The event is an evening race suited to recreational runners and local runners, and is part of the club’s summer calendar. Information and registration are presented on the club’s page on laget.se, and the organizers warmly welcome participants to forest trails and running close to nature.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Gallabergssjön
Evening race (start 18:00)
Natural trail and forest terrain in Gallabergsskogen
additional: Organizer: Vretstorps IF Löpning. Location listed in the calendar: Gallabergssjön / Gallabergsskogen. The calendar event appears on laget.se, and the page offers instructions for subscribing via iCal, Google Calendar and Outlook. News posts on the page include prompts such as “Click to register,” but no direct registration link was found on the pages crawled.

name: Tänndalen 100 miles
location: Tännäs, Härjedalen Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden

name: Alpaca Race
location: Hisingsparken, Göteborg, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: The Alpaca Race is a challenging trail race in Hisingparken, Gothenburg, run over laps on a technical course. The race offers four distance options (1, 3, 5 or 10 laps), with substantial elevation gain, and is intended as preparation for tough mountain races such as UTMB. The race takes place on 13–14 June 2026, with night running for the longest distances and a medal for everyone who finishes. The event is organized by IF Kville, with the gathering point and aid station at Tuve ice rink/IF Kville’s clubhouse.
course_highlights: Technical trail course in the Hisingparken/Tuve area
Lap format: choose 1, 3, 5 or 10 laps (10 laps = 106 km, +6000 metres of elevation gain)
Course designed to match UTMB’s elevation gain per kilometre (a tough elevation profile)
additional: Start and time schedule: 10 laps start Saturday at 19:00 (24 hours, 20 places); 5 laps start Sunday at 07:00 (12 hours, 50 places); 3 laps start at 10:00 (8 hours, 50 places); and 1 lap has starts around 11:00/15:00 (1–3 hours, 100 places). Check-in and place assignment take place before the start. The aid station/start is at IF Kville’s clubhouse by Tuve ice rink, with toilets and the option to change and shower. Food: barbecue and the option to bring your own food; energy drinks and evening staffing are available. A course preview run is announced separately, with its own timing for those who wish to take part. Preview run before the race (date may vary); night-running period 19:00–07:00; 24 hours/20 places; barbecue/bring your own food at base camp.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
location: Böda Sand, Böda, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a nature-focused trail race in northern Öland, with 50 km and 25 km distances for both men and women. The course runs through classic Öland woodland and coastal landscapes, passing places including Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. The 50 km race starts at Böda Sand and the 25 km race starts in Byxelkrok, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. Participants who register by 6 June receive a T-shirt.
course_highlights: Byrums raukar (coastal area of rauks, or limestone sea stacks)
Neptuni åkrar (coastal meadow landscape with views)
Trollskogen (distinctive pine forest in northern Öland)
additional: Location: Sport Camp, Böda Sand (northern Öland). Date: 13 June 2026; 50 km starts at 09:00 at Böda Sand, and 25 km starts at 10:00 in Byxelkrok; both distances finish at Böda Sand. All finishers receive a medal. To receive a T-shirt, register by 6 June and provide your shirt size (men’s/women’s). Bib collection: Friday 12 June, 19:00–20:00, and on race day, 13 June, 07:30–09:00 (the last opportunity for on-site registration). On-site registration payment: cash, card or Swish. Contact/organiser: Högby IF. Both distances finish at Böda Sand; start times are 09:00 for 50 km and 10:00 for 25 km. Registration by 6 June 2026 for advance entries and until 11 June for late entries; advance registration includes a T-shirt.

name: Urskogsloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgiften är 200 kr och anmälan stänger den 10/6.

description: Urskogsloppet is a recreational race through old-growth forest in Örnsköldsvik Municipality, organised by Björna IF. There are two distances: the original 19.7 km race (starting in Backe/Berg and finishing at Bigvallen in Björna) and a shorter 6.6 km race (starting and finishing at Bigvallen). The course partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail and runs mainly on easy forest paths over logs and rocks, with some wet and uneven terrain. Urskogsloppet has been held since 2009 and always takes place on the Saturday before Midsummer.
course_highlights: Partly follows the Urskogsleden hiking trail
Mostly easy forest paths over logs, rocks and brush, with uneven and locally wet surfaces
Checkpoints with drinks and light snacks (long race: after approximately 6, 13, 15 and 18 km; short race: at approximately 3.2 and 5 km)
additional: Participant cap: 350. Registration, parking and changing facilities are at the school in Björna; for the long race, a bus takes runners to the start in Backe after registration. Personal bags can be left at the start and collected at the finish. Food is available to purchase in the school cafeteria (cost: 120 kr; deadline to book a meal: 2026-06-01). Registration must be completed by 10:00 on race day (online registration closes 2026-06-10 at 20:00), but on-site late registration may be available if places remain. Cut-off times: the checkpoint at 6 km closes 1 hour 40 minutes after the start, the checkpoint at 13 km closes 3 hours after the start, and the finish closes 4 hours 10 minutes after the start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall and swimming pool. Participation is at your own risk. Terrain: mud and easy paths with rocks and brush; sometimes wet and uneven. The race is capped at 350 participants. Register via Svenskalag.se (Björna IF's club page). Held together with Lilla Urskogsloppet and Knatteloppet for children up to 13 years old.

name: Tjejmilen Sälen by EQPE
description: Tjejmilen Sälen is a summer race in a mountain setting, with 5 km and 10 km distances. In 2026, it will take place in Lindvallen, Sälen, on 13 June. The course offers varied terrain, including mountain trails, technical sections and open views—an experience for both first-time 10 km runners and experienced runners. The race is aimed at women and combines the natural surroundings with a sense of community. Timing is available and can be opted out of when registering.
course_highlights: Mountain trails and technical sections in a spectacular mountain setting
Moorland and views of Mellanfjället and Hemfjället
A narrow mountain trail climbing Hemfjället, with several mountain tarns
additional: Distances: 5 km and 10 km. Timing is available (optional). Age limits: 10 km from age 15 (or 13 when accompanied by an adult); 5 km from age 13 (or 11 when accompanied by an adult). Late registration is possible, subject to availability, until 2 hours before the first start and must be completed online via the regular registration page. Bus travel from Stockholm to Sälen can be booked. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Water stations are located along the course. The distances are 5 km and 10 km; start groups; late registration until 2 hours before the first start; bus travel Stockholm–Sälen; payment options include bank transfer, card, Swish and Klarna; refunds only according to the insurance terms.

name: Nalta Backyard Ultra
description: Nalta Backyard Ultra is Sweden’s northernmost backyard ultramarathon, held at the Ursberget ski lodge in Piteå. The race takes place on a 6.706 m loop, with a new start every hour on the hour—the first lap starts at 09:00—and runners must be in the starting corral to continue. Together with Piterunners, the organizers create a shared running celebration in the midnight light, with simple refreshments and a Nalta Backyard Ultra T-shirt included with regular registration. Participation is at your own risk, and the race follows the rules from bigsbackyardultra.com.
course_highlights: 6.706 m loop (approx. 6.7 km), with a new start every hour on the hour
Approx. 65 m of elevation gain; the surface is mostly forest trails, running tracks, gravel roads, and around 500 m of asphalt
The course is marked with signs and trail markers; the race takes place in the midnight light
additional: Registration and bib collection take place from 07:30–08:30 at the race management tent; a race and rules briefing is held at 08:30. All drinks and energy supplies are available at the lap area (including UMARA sports drink, water, coffee, sandwiches, pickles, crisps, sweets, and fruit); personal assistance along the course is not allowed. There are two small changing rooms (one shower) and two toilets; the organizer cannot provide supervision or storage for personal belongings. Parking is limited by the running track and at Tolvmansskolan—carpooling is recommended. A T-shirt is included with regular registration (not included with late registration). A team category is available (register individually using a team name), and the awards ceremony takes place after the last runner has finished. Registration: 07:30–08:30; no one on the course-odx; a T-shirt is included with preregistration; three-person teams are available; results are published on official websites; limited parking.

name: EcoTrail Stockholm
location: Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, Norra Djurgården, Stockholm, Sweden
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 33 km, 16 km, 8 km, 0.7 km
description: EcoTrail Stockholm is a trail race held in and around Norra Djurgården and Stockholm, with several distances on race day in June 2026. The course combines technical forest trails, coastal paths, countryside, and urban sections and sights. It suits both fast international runners and those looking to finish over the course of a full-day outing. The start and finish are at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater, and all finishers receive an annual wooden medal; the organizers also provide food and an after-run gathering at the finish. More detailed race information will be published on the website and emailed to registered participants before the race.
course_highlights: A mix of archipelago scenery, technical forest trails, countryside, urban sections, and several viewpoints
Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater on Norra Djurgården (easy to reach by metro/bus)
The 80 km course passes through seven municipalities and nine nature reserves; generous time limit (14 hours) and limited participant numbers
additional: Start and finish at Stora Skuggans Amfiteater; wooden medal for all finishers; participants must bring their own cup/mug or bottle to refill at aid stations; GPX file available to download; the 80 km race has a 14-hour time limit and is limited to 200 participants; more details and the schedule will be emailed to registered participants approximately two weeks before the race. The registration deadline for all distances is 11 June 2026. Mandatory equipment for the 80 km race: a container for at least one litre of water, a cup/mug, and a mobile phone with a fully charged battery and the race organizers’ phone number; aid stations do not provide cups.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
description: Flosjön–Edstjärn is a half marathon organised by Edstjärns IK in the Flosjön/Edstjärn area. The race is part of the club’s annual events and is aimed at recreational runners and local club members. The course route and results from previous years, including split times, are published on the club’s website. The organiser directs enquiries and contact requests to the club’s email address.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km of trail running between Flosjön and Edstjärn in Dalarna (Gagnef).
The course is approximately 80% off-road, with around 350 metres of elevation gain.
Organised by Edstjärns IK under the names Walk of Pain and Halvmaran, with an archive of results available.
additional: The course route for Flosjön–Edstjärn is published on the page “Course route for Flosjön–Edstjärn”. Results from previous races, including split times, are published on the website. The organiser is Edstjärns IK, a non-profit sports club open to everyone; contact: hej@eik.one. The Walk of Pain title is mentioned; results pages are available for Flosjön–Edstjärn; the 2020 edition was cancelled; results are available for the 2024 edition.

name: Ljungskileslingan
location: Ljungskile centrum, Ljungskile, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: LjungskileSlingan is a family-friendly running event with distances ranging from 300 metres for the youngest runners up to 10 km. The start and finish are in central Ljungskile, and the course passes through central Ljungskile and Lyckorna, partly along Ljungskile Bay and the seafront promenade. The scenic courses are only gently undulating, and the event offers a large prize pool. It is organised by Ljungskile Friluftsklubb in collaboration with Hälle IF and is held alongside LjungskileDagen and the Lions flea market.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Ljungskile
The course follows Ljungskile Bay and the seafront promenade towards Lyckorna; scenic and gently undulating
Distances: children’s race 300 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km; large prize pool
additional: The event is a community celebration held alongside LjungskileDagen and the Lions flea market, with a funfair, music and activities. There is a large prize pool: the top three in each category receive prizes, and other prizes are drawn among those who finish. The race has been held since 1994, and since 2015 Ljungskile Friluftsklubb and Hälle IF have shared the organising duties. The invitation page states that registration is open (see the invitation for more information). A children’s race for the youngest runners has been included since 2018. LjungskileSlingan is also connected to LjungskileDagen and has a history of varying distances and organisers before Hälle IF took over in 2024. In 2026, the 10 km returns with a new route.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: A warm welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on 13 June 2026! After two previous editions, we’re back with a family-friendly running festival featuring several different races for all ages and levels. The event offers chip timing, a team competition and an activity area with music and family activities. Participant numbers are limited to maintain a cosy, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s races: 450 m and 1,700 m
Distance race: 5 km
7.5 km trail mix (with trail sections on the course)
additional: Automatic chip timing and a team competition are offered. A service fee of 12.50 kr is mentioned for registrations. The event area is open 10:00–14:00. Late registration from 8–12 June costs 225:-, and registration on the day, 13 June, costs 250:-. Music and activities for the whole family; participant numbers are limited. The fun run is promoted as inclusive for everyone, but the text does not specify registration details or distances. Webscorer mentions a manual wave start that may affect the start schedule.

name: Blue Mountain TrailRun
location: First Camp Ånnaboda, Ånnaboda, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Blue Mountain Trail Run is a nature- and technical-trail-focused race held at First Camp Ånnaboda, with four distances (21 km, 15 km, 10 km and 6 km). The courses follow the Bergslagsleden and sections of mountain-bike trails, with lakeside stretches, forest trails and viewpoints such as Sånnabodahöjden. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and offers services including bib collection, food sales, and nearby showers and changing facilities. The 21 km race has an extra competitive incentive: anyone who breaks the course record will be rewarded with 5,000 SEK.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical forest trails along the Bergslagsleden and mountain-bike trails
Expansive views from Sånnabodahöjden (266 m above sea level) and several forest lakes along the course
Clear course markings, aid stations at key junctions, and approximately 527 m of elevation gain on the 21 km course
additional: Bib numbers must be collected at least 45 minutes before the start; collection opens at 09:00, and on-site late registration is from 09:00 to 09:15. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at the red SM cabin, approximately 300 m below First Camp; swimming is possible at Södra Ånnabosjön. Electronic timing uses a timing chip worn on the finger; there are aid stations on the course, and food and refreshments are sold on site. Name and category changes can be made up to and including 9 June 2026 (fee: 150 SEK); a refund protection option is available (17% of the entry fee). First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin stays when booked via annaboda@firstcamp.se using the code "TrailRun". A service fee of approximately 10 SEK applies. Registration and bib collection take place 45 minutes before the start; food and drinks are available; changing rooms, showers and toilets are near the red SM cabin by the main parking area; medical kits are available at the start/finish and at water stations. First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin rentals with the code TrailRun.

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a new city race on 14 June 2026, with two distances: half marathon (21K) and 10K. Both share a start and finish area in Dockan/Varvsstaden. The courses are flat and fast, taking you through four distinct zones—from city vibes and parks to the waterfront and sea breeze in Västra hamnen, with views of Turning Torso. The race is suited both to those chasing a personal best and to those who want to experience Malmö together with the crowds and the joy of running. The organiser is Malmö Allmänna Idrottsförening (MAI).
course_highlights: A flat, fast course through four zones: city, parks, waterfront neighbourhoods and seaside
Passes Turning Torso and a long straight stretch along Ribban and Limhamnsvägen
Surface: mostly asphalt, with sections of paved gravel paths in parks and cobblestones in central areas
additional: Registration opens on 25 November 2025. Runners can also register via Epassi (wellness benefit). Start times: 10K first wave at 10:00 (last at 10:12); 21K first wave at 10:40 (last at 10:56). Time limits: 90 minutes for 10K and 3 hours for 21K. There is a 3.5 km cut-off on the 10K, which runners must pass within 32 minutes of the last wave starting. Services: water stations with water and Umara sports drink, medical assistance, a medal/fruit/drink at the finish, and toilets along the course. Distance changes are possible for an administration fee of 95 kr (and upgrading from 10K to 21K also requires payment of the price difference). Corporate packages are available with a gathering tent and group training. Tent price examples: 25 people 15,000 kr, 50 people 25,000 kr, 75 people 35,000 kr. Distances: 21K and 10K; Epassi wellness benefits are accepted as a payment option.

name: Dadathlon Run and Festival (Stockholm, Hagaparken)
description: DaddyHood Dadathlon is a family-oriented sports event that encourages fathers and their children to move and spend quality time together. The Dadathlon is organised as a series of three discipline-specific races held at different times during the year, and participants can join live events (such as in Stockholm's Hagaparken) or take part virtually. One of the events is a running-with-kids challenge where strollers are explicitly allowed and activities are tracked with an app or sports watch and uploaded to the platform. The event emphasises participation, shared experiences and inspiring photos/videos rather than only competition.
course_highlights: Family-friendly running with kids (strollers allowed)
Live event in Stockholm's Hagaparken with a parallel virtual competition
Three-part series across the year (complete all three to become a full Dadathlon; single-event sign-up possible)
additional: Event supports both live and virtual participation; participants track activity with an app or sports watch and upload results and device activation link to the platform. A leaderboard is available, but prizes are awarded for the most inspiring pictures/videos rather than pure time-based competition. It is allowed to stop your tracking device to take breaks for the child's comfort. The organisers encourage tagging @daddyhoodeurope and using #DaddyHoodDadathlon. Free registration; Hagaparken, Stockholm; Running with children (1.5 km or 3 km); fundraising for Barncancerfonden.

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköping City Run is a fast, popular 5-kilometre race starting and finishing in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. The seventh edition takes place on Tuesday, 16 June 2026, on a flat, easy-to-run course suited to both fast runners and recreational participants. The course is lined with music stations and a large cheering crowd. After finishing, participants are treated to a summer platter from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free Ramunderstaden Little Brunnsparken Run for children, with several age groups.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (officially measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
Music stations and strong crowd support along the course
additional: Race bib collection: ICA Supermarket Söderköping, Monday 15 June, 12:00–18:00; remaining bibs can be collected in the start/finish area up to one hour before the start. The timing chip is attached as a tab at the top of the bib and must not be removed. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class leads the warm-up (15 minutes before each start; the children’s races warm up at 16:45). After finishing, ICA Supermarket serves a summer platter; massage is available after the race. Late registration: online and on site. Online registration is open through 14 June at 16:00, according to the information provided. The regular late-registration period (increased fee of 50 SEK, for a total of 375 SEK) runs from 8 June until one hour before the start; late registration is also available on site/at bib collection (the website’s news page lists the on-site fee as 345 SEK). The 5 km course runs through Söderköping; the start/finish area is in Brunnsparken; chip timing by Racetimer; warm-up before the start led by World Class; water at the start/finish and at 2.8 km; a medal for all participants; bag/outerwear drop-off at the start and finish; the Little Brunnsparken Run (1.1 km) for children; registration via the website; bibs collected at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Visby—a community running event that raises awareness of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, or take part in Lilla Blodomloppet. The courses pass through Visby’s cultural heritage areas and are open to both recreational runners and teams. The event is organised locally by VIF Gute Friidrott together with the blood donation centre in Visby, and often ends with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses run along Visby’s ring wall and through the town centre
The 10 km course includes the seafront promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Scenic historic surroundings close to the town
additional: Team registration is available and costs 1,750 kr up to and including 26 May; groups can register many participants using an Excel template imported during registration; the event highlights blood donation and provides information about gifts for blood donors; local organisers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, email visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Donation Centre in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, email blodcentralen@gotland.se). There are three categories: 10 km, 5 km and Lilla Blodomloppet; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby are listed on the website; included: technical T-shirt, race bib and medal; team registration is available for companies and groups; the event is streamed live on blodomloppet.se.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, taking place on 17 June 2026. The main race is 7.2 km, mostly on easy-to-run gravel paths along the water and through the forest. It suits both runners looking to run fast and those who prefer to jog or walk at a summer pace. The course passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus and finishes with an after-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps gård, with food, drinks and good company. There is also a KidsRun (approximately 600 m) for children born in 2016 or later.
course_highlights: 7.2 km, mostly easy-to-run gravel paths along the water in Rynningeviken
Passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus, with evening sunshine and lake views
Two wooden bridges over Lillån and two longer hills by Venastugan
additional: Start at 18:30 (warm-up at 18:15; compulsory race briefing at 18:25). KidsRun starts at 17:45 (gather at 17:40). Bib numbers can be collected from the race office from 16:00; collect by 18:10 at the latest. Timing uses a loaned transponder (800 kr charged for a lost transponder); KidsRun is not timed. Water/energy stations at 3 and 5 km; toilets are available in the event area and at the water stations. No changing facilities or showers on site. After-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps gård (BBQ 299 SEK, including water and coffee; half price for children under 12). Youth (born in 2008 or later) receive a 50% discount; group registration via info@epictrail.se. The course is described as 7.2 km in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. Transponders are loaned at the start and must be returned (800 kr charged if lost). Food and drinks are provided along the course, followed by an after-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps Gård (BBQ buffet 299 SEK, including water and coffee). No changing rooms or showers. Kids Run is not timed. The entry fee includes a place in the race, bib number, timing, medal, sports drink and energy.

name: Borejoggen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagjoggen följer samma priser som Borejoggen, alltså 300:-/person och ytterligare 50:- per person vid efteranmälan.

description: Borejoggen is a traditional Midsummer race in Torsby, welcoming elite runners, recreational runners and children. The main race is run on asphalt through central Torsby and is approximately 8.5 km. Minijoggen is a shorter class of approximately 1.5 km for children and young people. There is also Lagjoggen, a team race for teams of three, with the team’s combined time counting. The start is in the area around Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken (Minijoggen at 09:30; Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00). Registration is via RaceID or at Prima Sport/Herrgårdsparken, according to the organiser’s information.
course_highlights: The main course is approximately 8.5 km on asphalt through central Torsby
Minijoggen is approximately 1.5 km for children and young people
Water stations at 2 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: The start is on Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken. Race numbers and timing chips can be collected at Prima Sport during Midsummer week. Changing facilities and showers are available at Björnevi IP and Valbergsstugan; toilets are available at Herrgårdsparken and Björnevi IP. Prizes are offered, including sprint and hill prizes and prize money for the winners. Traffic marshals will be stationed on busy roads, and medical services will be available at the finish. The course is 8.5 km on asphalt through central Torsby. Start times are 9:30 for Minijoggen and 11:00 for Borejoggen/Lagjoggen. Registration is via RaceID or Prima Sport. Lagjoggen requires three participants per team. Water stations are provided as specified for the course.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are an MTB and running race held every year on Midsummer Eve in Orsa. The event offers a unique combination of cycling and running in beautiful natural surroundings and attracts both young people and adults. Race numbers are sent digitally in advance, and bibs can be picked up at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the start venue. A licence and membership in an association affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation are required for the MTB competition categories.
course_highlights: MTB and running race in scenic Orsa
Always held on Midsummer Eve
A licence and membership in a cycling federation are required for the MTB competition categories
additional: Registration opens on 29 April 2026. The entry fee increases by 50% from 16 June. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. Race numbers are sent digitally on 17 June. Bibs can be picked up on 18 June from 16:00 to 20:00 at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the start venue on race day. No refunds for injury or illness. A licence is required for the MTB categories. Registration is online, and race numbers are available on mobile. Held in scenic Orsa.

name: Midsommartrail - Möt ljuset
description: Midsommartrail – Meet the Light is a personal trail race held on the longest day of the year, with the experience at its heart. The race starts before dawn so you can run into the daylight along a 30 km route through beautiful forest terrain. The number of participants is limited (maximum 100) to create an intimate and considerate atmosphere, and after the finish the organizers serve a generous breakfast. Navigation is by a GPS route provided in advance and a map at the start, and there are two aid stations along the way.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running at dawn, meeting the light along the route
Two aid stations along the route
Navigation using a GPS route and map (runners are responsible for their own navigation)
additional: Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Club’s clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22, Sollentuna; easiest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro (1.5 km walk); parking at Sollentuna Golf Club (500 m walk); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not permitted; maximum 100 participants; breakfast served after the race; registration open until one hour before the start; minimum age 18. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Start time: 02:00 on 2026-06-21. 30 km trail run; GPS route and map; two aid stations along the way; breakfast after the finish; hotel discount at Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna with code NIGHTTRAILRUN.

name: Night Trail Run  Sommar 2025
description: Night Trail Run Sommartrail is a personal trail race in Sollentuna, held on the longest day of the year. The race is 30 km long and starts at dawn, giving participants the experience of meeting the summer light. Participant numbers are limited to preserve an intimate atmosphere. Participants navigate using a GPS route, sent in advance, and are also given a map at the start. After the finish, a hearty breakfast is served so you can share the experience with the other runners.
course_highlights: 30 km of trail running, starting before dawn and reaching daylight
Participants navigate themselves using a GPS route and a map provided at the start
Two energy stations along the course and breakfast after the finish
additional: Maximum 100 runners. Start/finish at Attunda Orienteering Clubhouse, Ytterbyvägen 22 in Sollentuna. Nearest public transport: commuter train to Rotebro station, followed by an approximately 1.5 km walk to the venue. Parking is recommended at Sollentuna Golf Club (approximately 500 m away); parking on Ytterbyvägen is not permitted. Participants are responsible for navigating; the GPS route is sent in advance and a map is handed out at the start. Registration is open until one hour before the race starts. Minimum age: 18. Recommended accommodation: Good Morning Hotel Sollentuna (discount code NIGHTTRAILRUN). Seasonal versions include Sommartrail, Hösttrail and Hundtrail, with the experience and the nighttime experience highlighted as the essence of Night Trail Run.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out at Böda Sand. It is a challenging competition on sand and in water, suited both to those looking to compete and to families looking to have fun, with courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 km. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. The event is held at Böda Sand Beach Resort on 24 June.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m to 10 km
A challenging competition on sand and in water
A medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Date: 24 June. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46)485-22200. The event is promoted as family-friendly and recurring in the resort’s events calendar. Special accommodation offers are available at Böda Sand; late registration and race-number pickup take place at Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a popular 10 km race in Karlstad, with something for every runner—from those chasing a personal best to those who want to enjoy the community atmosphere along the Klarälven. The event offers the classic 10 km, a shorter 5 km, and the Karlstad Minilopp and Miniminilopp for younger participants. The race starts at Tingvallabron and finishes in Museiparken; the 2026 edition opens SM‑veckan and will be broadcast on SVT. The organiser, IF Göta Karlstad, welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Start at Tingvallabron
Finish in Museiparken
Route along the Klarälven
additional: When registering, provide an estimated finish time for seeding; young people born in 2008 or later and students receive a 100 kr discount during certain periods; a 10 km team competition is available (at least six participants per team)—contact tavling@ifgota.se to register a team; payment via PlusGiro (47 37 91-2), with instructions for the race category and name; gift vouchers can be purchased via PG and notified to info@ifgota.se; participant information (PM) is sent by email and published on the website; After Run and a concert in Museiparken are part of the opening of SM‑veckan; the race is part of SM‑veckan 2026 and will be broadcast on SVT. The race offers 10 km and 5 km, as well as the Karlstad Minilopp (ages 7–12) and Miniminilopp (ages 0–6). Minimum age: 12; dogs are not allowed; walkers with a stroller or rollator may start in the last start group; participation is at your own risk; entry fees are non-refundable; publication of photos on the website and social media is permitted.

name: St Olavsloppet
description: St Olavsloppet is a three-day relay race that runs from Trondheim towards Östersund, with stages over three days. The race includes several daily stages (e.g. Day 1: Trondheim–Stiklestad, approx. 120.6 km) and alternative start and finish locations such as Stjørdal, Sandvika, Åre and Mörsil. The event is organised for teams in different categories and rewards participants with diplomas, raffle prizes and a Mini-Olav medal. Registration is by email, and payment instructions for Norwegian, Swedish and international participants are available on the registration page.
course_highlights: Day 1: Trondheim–Stiklestad, approx. 120.6 km
Three-day stage format: stages via Stiklestad and Åre, with the finish in Östersund
Alternative start points/stages mentioned: Stjørdal, Sandvika and Mörsil
additional: Registration is by email (Norwegian participants: post@stolavsloppet.no; Swedish teams: larspeterbring@gmail.com). Payment instructions are provided: Norwegian participants pay to a Sparebank1 SMN bank account; Swedish participants can pay by Swish or bankgiro; international participants can use the details for Länsförsäkringar Bank (IBAN/BIC), with St Olavsgruppens ideella förening as the payment recipient. Discounts are offered to associations/companies registering multiple teams for “St Olav 340” (team 2: 25%, team 3: 50%, team 4: 75%, from team 5: 100%). All teams taking part in the in-person race receive a diploma after finishing, and all participants receive a Mini-Olav medal. At previous events, the first start group (approx. 20 runners) set off from Trondheim Stadion at the start. The official website has information about distances, categories, participant information, accommodation and sustainability.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a long-running community celebration, always held on the first Friday after Midsummer. In 2026, the race takes place on Friday, 26 June. The course runs through picturesque summer-time Trosa, with large crowds and close to the water, creating a summery atmosphere for both competition and recreation. The event offers categories for elite runners, recreational runners, young people and children, as well as the 8,900 m main race and shorter recreational options.
course_highlights: The course runs through picturesque summer-time Trosa, close to the water
The 8,900 m main race, plus the 4 km Jogging/Walking with poles event and a 700 m children's race
Start and finish at Trosa square, with large crowds and stage activities
additional: Registration remains open until the start, and payment can be made by Swish or card; alternatively, pay to Trosa Stadslopp's bankgiro 488-8335. Folksam recreational race insurance is available (e.g. SEK 155 for basic cover, Startklar Plus SEK 275). Bib collection opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The 8,900 m main race has start groups based on target times (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there is also a children's race (700 m) and award ceremonies on stage. The organiser gives 50 cl of Vitamin Well to runners in the 8,900 m and 4 km races. The programme also includes 700 m and 900 m distances, Jogging/Walking with poles over 4 km, and information about night buses to Stockholm after the race.

name: Bocksten Trailrun
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Åkulla Bokskogar, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Marathon, 24 km, Halvmarathon, 12 km, 6.7 km, 5 km
description: Bocksten TrailRun is a nature-focused trail race with its event centre at Öströö sheep farm and courses in the Åkulla beech forests. The event offers four distances (5 km, 12 km, 22 km and Ultra 44 km) through beech and spruce forests, with lake views and varied trails. The races are spectator-friendly, have limited start places, and offer participants a special medal. Welcome to experience the joy of running and a sense of community in a magical forest setting.
course_highlights: Running in the Åkulla beech forests and enchanting spruce forests
Varied terrain: technical trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads with lake views
Plenty of elevation and scenic views; also a 6.7 km loop course for the Vineyard Backyard Ultra
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 10:15, 200 places), 12 km (start 10:00, 400 places), 22 km (start 10:30, 300 places) and Ultra 44 km (start 08:00, 100 places). The total number of start places is limited (only 1000 places). GPS coordinates for the event centre: 57.06881078975495, 12.506526026672418. Only tap water is served during the event (no plastic bottles); Tailwind and squash are available as alternatives. For the Vineyard Backyard Ultra, bringing your own cup is mandatory; a headlamp and personal medication are mandatory, and the headlamp must be worn between 20:00 and 07:00. Bib collection and registration take place in the start area (see the invitation for the specified times); if you need assistance, contact race management on 076-8159678. It is possible to take out Startklar cancellation and accident insurance (see the invitation for prices). The summer edition takes place on 27 June 2026, with distances of 5/12/22/Ultra 44 km; the winter edition is at Öströö Gård, with 5/12/24 km and 500 places. Accommodation can be booked through Åkulla Resort with a discount (code bockstentrailrun). The Backyard Ultra race at Ästad Vingård has a 6.7 km course and starts every full hour.

name: Kalmar Malkars 21 km
description: Kalmar Malkars 21 km is a fast, one-lap half marathon that takes runners through many of Kalmar’s beautiful surroundings. It is well suited to both competitive runners and recreational participants. The start and finish are at Malkars Träningscenter on Torsåsgatan, and the course offers views of Kalmarsund, Kalmar Castle and the Öland Bridge. In addition to the half marathon, Malkars Femman (5 km) is also offered and is open to walkers, wheelchair users and strollers—the focus is on the joy of exercise. All finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: One-lap course passing Kalmar Castle and Kalmarsund
Views of the Öland Bridge along Ängöleden
Fast course where many runners set personal records
additional: Start and finish at Malkars Träningscenter, Toråsgatan 1, Kalmar. Bib collection: Friday 26 June, 15:00–17:00, and Saturday 27 June, 12:00–15:00. Late registration is available through 25 June, and may also be possible at bib collection after that date. Payment for late registration: cash, card or Swish. Half-marathon water stations after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km, and at the finish (Umara sports drink and water). Everyone who registers for the 21.1 km race by 20 June receives a shirt at bib collection. All finishers receive a medal; ICA MAXI provides a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate after the race. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. The half marathon includes water stations after 5, 10, 15 and 18 km and at the finish; bibs are collected at the specified times; late registration is available through 25 June; payment by card, cash or Swish; a shirt is offered to those who register before 20 June; all finishers receive a medal.

name: Jordgubbslunken
description: Jordgubbslunken is a popular rural race in Rudskoga with the motto “walk, jog, run.” The event offers Lilla Lunken (6 km) and Stora Lunken (10 km), as well as Minilunken for children (born in 2017 or later). The start and finish are at Grunnebacka School, and the courses follow Rudskoga’s winding village roads through a beautiful cultural landscape. At the finish, all participants receive one litre of strawberries. There are also many prizes, plus a grand prize drawn using participants’ race numbers.
course_highlights: 6 km loop on gravel
10 km loop alternating between gravel roads and closely mown grass
Start and finish at Grunnebacka School; courses follow winding village roads through a cultural landscape
additional: Always held on the first Saturday after Midsummer; categories for men, women and children; Minilunken for children born in 2017 or later; all participants receive one litre of strawberries at the finish; many prizes, with a grand prize drawn using participants’ race numbers; information about this year’s race is published under “På gång i Rudskoga” on the website. The 6 km loop is on gravel, while the 10 km loop alternates between gravel roads and closely mown grass. Start at 15:00. On-site registration by 14:30 (a higher fee applies for on-site registration). Payment via Bankgiro 505-1404 or Swish 1233296605; questions can be directed to the listed phone numbers.

name: Silverleden Ultra 100 Miles
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail ultramarathon in Bergslagen, held in Hällefors with the start and finish at Hurtigtorpet over the weekend of 26–27 June 2026. The event offers distances of 33 km, 64 km and 100 miles and is promoted with slogans such as “Running joy”, “Both long & gruesome” and “Run. Survive. Brag” — a technical, hilly event for those seeking a tough experience in nature. The 100-mile class is full for 2026. The race is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and runners looking to challenge themselves on rocky, root-covered and hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Technical trails with many hills; most of the longer climbs are in the second half of the course
Roots and rock slabs that become very slippery in wet weather — trail shoes with deep lugs are recommended
Aid station at Silvergruvan (approximately 35 km) — option to have poles transported to the aid station
additional: Bus: transport from Hurtigtorpet to the 33 km start departs at 10:30. Places are limited and must be booked in advance (by 2026-06-20). Accommodation: several local options are listed within 5–20 km of the start/finish. A limited number of caravan and motorhome pitches are available — please contact info@silverledenultra.se. Electricity is available in limited supply but cannot be guaranteed. There is no facility for charging electric cars at the start/finish at Hurtigtorpet. The minimum participant age is 15 (the year they turn 15); relay teams cannot be entered in 2026. International participants can pay using the IBAN provided; the order confirmation from the registration system can be used to claim a wellness allowance. Early Bird prices are mentioned in the information, but exact amounts are not given.

name: H2 Trail
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 10 km, 5 km
description: Umara H2 Trail 2026 is OK Skogsvargarnas trail race, taking place on Saturday 27 June from the event centre at Bergagården on Hunneberg. The race programme includes several distances (80 km, 50 km, 28 km, 18 km, 11 km and 6 km), as well as a Knatte and Minitrail for the youngest participants. The courses run across Halle- and Hunneberg, with viewpoints, crofts and swimming spots in varied terrain. The event includes family-friendly activities for children and practical information about equipment and safety on the website.
course_highlights: The course runs across the plateau mountains of Halle and Hunneberg, with several viewpoints
Surface: mostly trails (approximately 73%), plus gravel roads (23%) and a little asphalt (4%)
Technical and challenging downhill section at Krösa Klev, marked with extra signs
additional: Event centre: Bergagården; parking is approximately 300 metres from the centre (follow the signs). The course is marked with blue arrows and blue-and-white ribbons. All participants must carry their own fluids and cup (cups are available for purchase at the event centre). Support is possible at two designated locations along the course (Halleberg turnaround and Hunneberg north of Fristorps Gransjö, as well as at the lap point at Bergagården). A headlamp is recommended for those completing a lap late (especially the 80 km race); a mobile phone and power bank are also recommended. Knatte/Minitrail and Miniknat have a separate, family-friendly format, a medal for all participants and a fee of SEK 50 (late or on-site registration is available for the children’s races). Showers and a sauna are available in the clubhouse at Bergagården. Event centre: Bergagården, Hunneberg. Start times by distance: 80 km 08:00, 50 km 08:00, 28 km 10:00, 18 km 09:00, 11 km 10:15; Knattetrail starts at approximately 10:45/11:00. Knattetrail and Miniknat are for the youngest age groups.

name: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi
location: Ottsjö, Åre Municipality, Jämtland County, Sweden
description: Fjällmaraton Gastronomi is a non-competitive mountain event where participants can choose between two point-to-point routes (approximately 24 km or 42 km) and enjoy both mountain scenery and local food. The routes are marked, and food stations (approximately every 7 km) serve local ingredients prepared and served in the mountains in collaboration with local producers. New routes have been created for 2026: the longer route starts and finishes in Ottsjö, while the shorter route starts in Trillevallen and finishes in Ottsjö. The event has an open start time so participants can enjoy the experience at their own pace, but early starts are recommended for those planning to walk slowly.
course_highlights: Point-to-point routes through mountain terrain, with 24 km and 42 km options
Food stations approximately every 7 km, serving local dishes in the mountains
2026 routes: the longer route starts and finishes in Ottsjö; the shorter route starts in Trillevallen and finishes in Ottsjö
additional: Non-competitive format with an open start; an early start is recommended for slower walkers. Transfers to the start are available and can be booked (transfer bookings open approximately two weeks before the event). The organizer recommends staying at Trillevallens Högfjällshotell or in Ottsjö (contact details are available on the page). Event information memos contain transport and logistics details. Open start times allow for a relaxed pace; food stations approximately every 7 km feature local producers; accommodation suggestions include Trillevallens Högfjällshotell or Ottsjö; bus transfers to the start are available from Ottsjö, Trillevallen and Undersåker; electronic timing and transport logistics are managed by the event.

name: Silverleden Ultra
description: Silverleden Ultra is a trail race in Hällefors/Bergslagen, with distances of 64 km, 33 km and 100 miles. The race takes place on 26 - 27 June 2026 and is promoted under the slogan “the joy of running” — participants can expect technical, hilly terrain with plenty of trails and climbs. The 100-mile race is sold out for 2026. The organiser’s copy and information emphasise challenging routes close to nature, and recommend bringing the right equipment.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with many climbs — the bigger climbs are mainly in the second half of the course
Technical trails with roots and rock slabs; trail shoes with a deep tread are recommended
The course passes the checkpoint at Silvergruvan (described as a checkpoint after approximately 35 km)
additional: Practical information: A bus to the 33 km start leaves Hurtigtorpet at 10:30 and must be booked in advance (booking is available until 2026-06-20); payments by methods other than card can be made to IBAN SE09 9020 0000 0906 0545 6739, using the reference number from the registration; limited pitches are available for caravans and motorhomes — please contact info@silverledenultra.se (electricity is limited); relay registration is not available in 2026; the minimum age for participants is 15 (the age they turn that year), and the 33 km race may be run under a guardian’s supervision even by younger participants; the receipt from the registration system can be used to claim a wellness allowance; equipment recommendations: trail shoes are recommended and metal studs are not; few runners use poles, but they may be recommended for the second half of the course and can be transported to the Silvergruvan checkpoint. GPX and Strava links are available; the time limit is 12 hours; there are aid stations along the course; maps and course descriptions are available on the website.

name: Kustmaran (Kristianopel)
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halvmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km
description: Kustmaran och Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family in picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast, with distances from 0.9 km up to the marathon (42.2 km). The event takes place on 27 June 2026 and offers both competitive races and recreational options, with dedicated support from Team Blekinge’s event staff. The day combines running through an idyllic summer landscape with opportunities for swimming, dining and overnight stays in the area. Everyone is welcome, from the children’s race and the untimed walk/run “Sommarlunken” to the half and full marathons for more experienced runners.
course_highlights: Run through an idyllic summer landscape around picturesque Kristianopel on the east coast
A range of distances: marathon (42.2 km), half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 0.9 km (children’s race) and Sommarlunken 4 km
The children’s race takes place inside Kristianopel Camping; swimming and local amenities are available in the village
additional: Race bibs can be collected and late entries made on race day from 08:00. Regular registration can be paid for by card or Swish; for payment by bank giro, contact register@teamblekinge.nu before registering. Electronic timing is provided by Racetimer. Participants in the half marathon and marathon must turn at least 17 during the year. Sommarlunken is untimed and no medal is awarded; prizes are drawn by lottery. Start times vary by distance; electronic timing; registration and payment options: card and Swish for regular registration, bank giro by arrangement if needed; late entries can be paid for by Swish or cash; parking outside Kristianopel; water stations, changing facilities, toilets and medical assistance at the finish area; rules in accordance with the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Kustmaran
price_range: 50 kr - 600 kr (beroende på distans och anmälningsperiod)
description: Kustmaran and Kristianopel Runt is a running festival for the whole family, held on 27 June 2026 in Kristianopel, Blekinge. With distances from 0.9 km up to the 42.2 km marathon, there is something for all levels and ages. The race offers beautiful, idyllic summer scenery, with enthusiastic support and cheerful cheers from Team Blekinge’s volunteers. Participants can also enjoy Kristianopel’s charm, with swimming, restaurants, cafés and accommodation. It is a memorable day focused on running and community, for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Distance options from 0.9 km to 42.2 km
Running through idyllic summer scenery on the east coast
Children’s race at Kristianopel Camping
additional: Race bibs can be collected and late registration completed on race day from 08:00. Electronic timing by Racetimer. Rules follow the Swedish Athletics Federation’s regulations for road races. Only participants who turn at least 17 during the year may enter the half marathon and marathon. Sommarlunken is a 4 km untimed recreational distance, with no medal and prizes awarded by raffle. Trail terrain, registration via the website, water stations, swimming facilities, camping and changing rooms are available.

name: Kristianopel Runt 10 km
location: Kristianopel, Karlskrona Municipality, Blekinge County, Sweden

name: TrailÖvik
description: TrailÖvik is a welcoming trail race in Själevad on 28 June 2026, offering several courses (Mini, 6 km, 12 km, 22 km and Night Edition) for both recreational and elite runners. The courses pass through magnificent natural scenery, with technical single-track trails, hilly terrain and several viewpoints overlooking the High Coast World Heritage Site. The event is described as both family-friendly and professionally run, with practice runs, maps and course support. The race venue and start/finish are at Skogslöparnas clubhouse, and the race has been praised for its varied and challenging trails.
course_highlights: Magnificent scenery and views of the High Coast, including from the summit of Mycklingberget
Technical trails with steep sections, stairs up Mycklingberget and ropes at some passages
The 22 km course includes three summits, bogs, stream ravines and aid stations (sports drink and water)
additional: The race venue, start and bib-number collection are on the gravel area below Skogslöparnas clubhouse (Nordhemsvägen 41, 89430 Själevad); bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start; race information will be published 10 days before the event; registration is through Mittlopp, and on-site registration opens at the venue and closes 30 minutes before each start. Practice runs and maps are available (printed maps in the mailbox at the start of Älgstråket and downloadable maps); livestreaming and live results are provided. Spiked shoes are recommended in wet weather. The 22 km course has its first aid station at approximately 4 km, with sports drink and water. Four distances and Night Edition; starts around 11:00; registration through Mittlopp; the venue is below Skogslöparnas clubhouse in Själevad (Nordhemsvägen 41); maps, practice runs and course marking are provided; results are displayed at the venue and online.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda Sand, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly fun run held at Böda Sand on Öland by Högby IF Athletics. The race offers several distances for adults and young people: 6.5 km and 4 km for adults, and 1.8 km and 1 km for young people, with the start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and a highlight of the main race is a sausage after the finish. Register at olandrunning.se or on site. The registration deadline is June 26, 2026, with late registration available until July 1.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in the Böda Sand area on Öland
Distance options: 6.5 km and 4 km for adults; 1.8 km and 1 km for young people
All finishers receive a medal, and sausages are served after the finish
additional: Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Registration deadline: June 26, 2026; late registration available until July 1. Register at olandrunning.se or on site. Payment by cash, card or Swish.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos Park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a city race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The event offers races for all ages and is well suited to both recreational runners and families. Welcome on 3 July 2026 — registration opens shortly.
course_highlights: Takes place in Gamleby’s urban setting
Starts and finishes in Unos Park
Races for all ages
additional: Registration opens shortly; start and finish in Unos Park; races are offered for all ages; organiser’s postal address: C/o Lena Persson, Lapserums Gård, 594 92 Gamleby. The race is held indoors in Unos Park; registration opens shortly for 2026-07-03.

name: Strömstadmilen
description: Strömstadmilen is organized by Strömstad Running Club and takes place on Saturday, 4 July 2026. The race offers runner-friendly distances through central Strömstad at the most beautiful time of year in Bohuslän, with the course lined by enthusiastic crowds. The main course is an accurately measured 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (5 km or 10 km); the start and finish are inside Strömsvallen. Everyone is welcome—there are also children’s races and a walking class for those who want to enjoy the event without timekeeping.
course_highlights: Runner-friendly 5 km loop through central Strömstad (run 1 or 2 laps for 5/10 km)
The course is lined with spectators and clearly marked with numerous directional signs
Start and finish at Strömsvallen; lap changes take place in the outer lanes as instructed
additional: Bib pickup and late registration: Friday 3 July, 15:00–18:00 at Strömstad Shoppingcenter, and from 09:30 on race day at Strömsvallen. T-shirts can be pre-ordered when registering by 7 June (199 kr) and collected with the race bib; sizes are available for children and adults. Timekeeping ends at 16:45. Parking at Strömsvallen is limited; alternative parking is available at Strömstad Gymnasium (~500 m away). Everyone who finishes receives a specially designed medal; photographers will be along the course, and a selection of photos will be posted on Facebook/Instagram after the race. New walking class, approximately 3 km along Strömstadvattnet; start and finish at Friluftsmuseet/Fiskartorpet; start time 11:00; distances include 10 km as two laps of 5 km, 5 km, a 4 km walk, 1 mil for youths and 1 km for the youngest children; bib pickup and late registration via Strömstad Shoppingcenter or Strömsvallen; T-shirt, medal, awards ceremony, parking and other logistics.

name: Kolmårdsrundan / Kolmården Ultra Trail

description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a welcoming but demanding trail race for both elite runners and recreational runners.
