description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a fun community event with several distances for all ages and abilities: 5 km (running/walking), 10 km (timed) and Lilla Blodomloppet for children. The courses follow walking-friendly trails and roads through beautiful, hilly countryside and suit recreational runners, walking groups and families. You can register individually or as a team (3–5 people), and the event combines exercise with raising awareness of the need for blood donation. After the finish, participants are treated to a picnic, and children receive a T-shirt and medal.
course_highlights: 5 km: walking-friendly trails through beautiful, hilly countryside
10 km: a hilly and challenging course on trails and roads between Ymer and Kype
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 800 m for children up to 12 years old; T-shirts and medals for everyone
additional: Team registration: 3–5 participants; a picnic bag is included (an extra picnic bag costs 250 kr). Teams may leave 1–2 places vacant and fill them by 20 August at the latest; the deadline for team registration is 24 August. State whether you are a blood donor to receive a 40 kr discount. To have your name printed on your bib, register by 10 August. Late registration is available on site on the day (31 August), up to one hour before the start, for an increased fee. The event offers a 5 km walk, 5 km run, 10 km run and Lilla Blodomloppet of approximately 1 km; start/finish at Skidstadion and Ymergården; the picnic bag is included with team registration; a technical-material T-shirt and a medal are available.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)
location: Ymergården och Skidstadion, Borås, Västra Götaland, Sweden
price_range: 1750 kr för laganmälan, 350-450 kr för individuella deltagare
description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a recreational race offering 5 km and 10 km running distances, as well as a child-friendly course called Lilla Blodomloppet, approximately 800 metres long. The races follow hilly trails and roads in scenic areas around Ymergården and Skidstadion, offering a wonderful nature experience for both runners and walkers. Lilla Blodomloppet is specially designed for children up to 12 years old, and all participants receive T-shirts and medals. After the race, families can explore an activity trail called “Jätten Ymers Stig”. Blodomloppet is part of a larger national initiative to raise awareness of blood donation and promote health.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on hilly trails and roads in a scenic area between Ymer and Kype
Lilla Blodomloppet, approx. 800 m, for children up to 12 years old; all receive T-shirts and medals
After the race, families can enjoy the “Jätten Ymers Stig” activity trail
additional: You can register individually or as a team (3–5 participants). Team registration includes a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event for an increased fee, up to one hour before the start. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Lilla Blodomloppet provides T-shirts and medals for all children. After the race, families are invited to explore “Jätten Ymers Stig”, an activity trail. The event includes medals, picnic bags, activities for children and the opportunity for the whole family to take part. Participants often receive technical-fabric T-shirts and medals as souvenirs.

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet (5 eller 10 km): 350 kr  t.o.m 12 augusti.

description: Join in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Växjö on 2 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a course-measured 5 km route), as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for the youngest participants. The start and finish are in Linnéparken, and the course is described as flat and fast, with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally wraps up with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linnéparken, in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, course-measured 5 km route (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for Lilla Blodomloppet (~600 m)
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 26 August 2026. An Excel template is available for bulk registrations, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies registering more than 20 participants. Changing a name or changing category/distance costs 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and you can also register on site in Linnéparken (at the late-registration and race-number pickup tent). Lilla Blodomloppet takes place on its own loop in Linnéparken, with the same start and finish. Course details: the start and finish are in Linnéparken; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration are available; a T-shirt, race number, medal and goodie bag are included; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Blodomloppet Halmstad
price_range: 350 kr t.o.m. 11 aug; 1 750 kr för lag om fem personer inklusive picknickkasse

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 750 kr för lag med fem deltagare inkl. picknickkasse t.o.m 11/8

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Halmstad, a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and there is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families. The event is organized by Halmstad Orienteering Club together with the blood centers in Halland, and many teams usually finish with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km or 10 km on a coastal route
Finish area with views of the sea at Tylösand
Separate Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families
additional: Registration is available only through the Blodomloppet website. Teams of five participants receive a picnic bag. Food, drinks and ice cream can be purchased at the existing kiosks near the start. Companies can rent tents in the finish area through Halmstad Partytält (info@halmstadpartytalt.se). Bag drop is available; start and finish information, a map and changing facilities are mentioned in the event information; tents can be rented in the finish area.

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a three-day trail running stage race in the Ramsvik area of Bohuslän on Sweden’s west coast, covering roughly 75–77 km over coastal cliffs, forest trails and beaches. The event is presented as an inclusive outdoor experience with separate starting groups for Walk, Jog and Run, so both competitive runners and those wanting a scenic multi-day hike can participate. Race Village accommodation is organised in cooperation with Ramsvik Stugby & Camping, and family-friendly options such as a Kids Camp with supervised activities are offered. Expect varied, technical terrain and daily stages that showcase the archipelago and coastal villages.
course_highlights: Three stages across coastal cliffs, narrow forest trails and beaches
Daily stages include Ramsvik–Smögen (~25 km), Bohus-Malmön–Kungshamn (~31 km) and Hunnebo–Ramsvik (~22 km)
Technical rocky peaks, enchanted forests and seaside village passages
additional: Participants choose a starting group (Walk, Jog or Run); to aim for the overall top 50, you must start all stages in the Run group. Official accommodation partner: Ramsvik Stugby & Camping (location of Race Village). There is a Kids Camp offering supervised activities (sailing, fishing and visits to Nordens Ark) while adults run the stages. Stage maps are provided for each day (Ramsvik–Smögen, Bohus-Malmön–Kungshamn, Hunnebo–Ramsvik). Kids Camp and family activities; energy stations and mandatory equipment; accommodation and transport information related to Ramsvik.

name: MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg takes place on 5 September 2026 and offers a festive evening race of 5 km or 10 km, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The races pass through the heart of the city and along Avenyn, with music, spectators and activities along the course creating a carnival atmosphere. The event welcomes individual runners, teams and companies, combining competition with a nighttime celebration. It is promoted as a memorable running experience, with late start times and a strong focus on atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two-lap course along Avenyn, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg (the 10 km race covers two laps)
Late-evening start for a unique nighttime atmosphere — the 10 km starts at 21:00
Crowds of spectators, music and activities along the course create a festive atmosphere
additional: The start area and warm-up take place at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The 5 km entry fee includes, among other things, a Björn Borg T-shirt (this year's colour/design), chip timing, energy drink along the course, and a bar/fruit at the finish; a medal can be purchased when registering. Registration through wellness-benefit providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) is available. Cut-off times: 10 km = 90 minutes (from the last start group), 5 km = 45 minutes; course closure/lap rules apply (for example, stopping at Tyska Bron for the lap and rules for the second lap). Company and team registration, as well as the purchase of gift codes, are available. Start times: 10 km at 21:00 and 5 km at 21:30. The race pack includes a T-shirt, chip and the option of a medal. Wellness subsidies are available through Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. Company and team participation is available, and a course map can be found on the website.

name: Tjejmilen
description: Tjejmilen is an iconic 10 km race for women, taking place in 2026 on Southern Djurgården and through central Stockholm on 5 September. The race is suitable for all levels—from walking to fast running—and is divided into start groups to ensure a smooth race flow. The course draws large crowds and combines scenic sections with urban surroundings. Timing is optional, and prize money is awarded to the top 3.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Southern Djurgården and through the beautiful surroundings of central Stockholm
Plenty of crowd support along the course and a high-energy atmosphere
Option to shorten the race to approximately 6 km (start group 12) for those who wish
additional: Timing is included but can be opted out of; registration is binding. Late registration is available digitally, subject to availability, until 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. The minimum age for Tjejmilen Stockholm is 15 in the year you turn 15 (13 when accompanied by an adult). The start is divided into 12 start groups, and prize money is awarded to the top 3. Two 10 km races for women (Sälen trail and Stockholm City race); start groups; minimum age 15; late registration may be available; dogs are not permitted; planning information is available on the official page.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description: The HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon is a well-organised half marathon featuring fast sections, varied terrain and a spectacular finish by the sea. The start and finish are at Dunkers Kulturhus, and the course runs through Helsingborg’s historic centre, past Kärnan, through Pålsjö Forest and Laröd. Much of the course is shared with the marathon route. It has around 170 metres of elevation gain, a hill up towards Kärnan at 2 km and a long downhill after 19 km. The race hosts the 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships and offers the option to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Dunkers Kulturhus; around 3 km through the historic centre, including Stortorget and Kärnan
The finish line and final stretch run along the sea at Gröningen, with celebrations on the pier facing the Öresund
Around 170 metres of elevation gain in total; a hill up towards Kärnan after ~2 km and a long downhill after ~19 km; mostly asphalt, with sections through forest and city
additional: The 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships are held in conjunction with the race; championship participants must represent a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation; option to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag during registration; the race-bib T-shirt must be actively selected and is specially produced (cannot be exchanged or returned); group registration is available via a dedicated group form/link (on the registration page); the course map shows the start/finish, split times, refreshment stations, toilets, cafés, parking and the Stadsdelsfesten along the route. 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships; around 4,000 starting places; fundraising for Min Stora Dag; group registration with invoice; bib collection can be linked to T-shirt selection (the T-shirt is non-returnable), according to the registration page.

name: Lydinge Resort Stafett
description: Lydinge Resort Relay is a team event over two distances—42.2 km and 21.1 km—in which teams of 2–4 people divide up our beautiful and varied courses. The race starts at Sundstorget in Helsingborg, and the routes take in everything from the city centre and the land ridge to coastal stretches, with the finish along the seafront promenade. The relay has four exchange stations and varied legs through both natural and urban settings. It is offered in men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate categories. The event also partners with Min Stora Dag to raise funds for children.
course_highlights: Start at Sundstorget and finish along the Seafront Promenade
Exchange stations including Ättekulla, Fredriksdal and Pålsjö Forest
A varied route through the city, along the coast and through nature reserves
additional: Team size: 2–4 runners; distances: 21.1 km (legs approximately 3.6–6 km) and 42.2 km (legs approximately 9–12 km); categories: men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate. Enter your teammates’ email addresses when registering so they receive confirmation by email. Larger group registrations can be made using a separate group form. A race T-shirt is optional and made to order; it can be collected at Löplabbet after the race. Test runs are offered, for example on 18 April and 6 June 2026. You can donate to Min Stora Dag during registration. Lydinge Resort Relay offers group registration with invoicing. Participants receive a T-shirt designed for the year, which can be collected at Löplabbet in Helsingborg after the race; T-shirts cannot be exchanged or returned. The partnership with Min Stora Dag helps raise funds for children in need.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is an exciting and challenging trail race in Gothenburg, with distances for everyone, from a shorter 8 km to longer 33 km and 45 km routes. The courses follow adventurous trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops, taking runners from the edge of the city into the wilderness. After the finish, AfterRun awaits, with food, a finisher item and a unique medal. The race emphasises the experience, community and sustainability, and starts and finishes in Kvibergs Park.
course_highlights: Adventurous trails, leafy forests and rocky outcrops with spectacular views
Courses passing Bergsjön, Paradiset and sections of the Bohusleden (the 33 km route follows the Bohusleden)
Technical terrain alternates with runnable sections and significant elevation gain
additional: Start and finish in Kvibergs Park (all races gather there); the 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus from Kviberg (the bus departs at 10:10); race bib collection: Friday at Löplabbet Östra Hamngatan, 11:00–18:00, and Saturday from 09:00 at the event area in Kviberg; AfterRun food is included for participants; live tracking and split times are available; registration is individual via partner Race.se and is binding (no refunds); free name changes until 2026-08-23, then 200 kr from 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-03; the organiser encourages use of public transport (trams 7 and 11, buses 56 and 510), and paid parking is available. Distances also include a 33 km start at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus to the start; the course may change, and the start and finish are in Kvibergs Park; aid and energy stations, mandatory equipment and medical support are available on site; some cutoff and finish times are listed in the race information.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
location: Dammen i Tvärred, Ulricehamn Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail race held in beautiful woodland and rugged terrain around Dammen in Tvärred, south of Ulricehamn. Choose between 7, 17 or 27 km on routes featuring narrow trails, moss-covered rocky sections and plenty of elevation. The event focuses on the experience, community and joy of running, with volunteers, a race announcer and on-site services, as well as hot food and a medal for everyone who finishes.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and moss-covered rocky sections
A challenging, hilly course with magical views
Start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred (parking nearby)
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred; parking is available nearby. There are aid stations along the course (in partnership with Umara Sports). Hot food is included for all participants after finishing, and everyone who completes the race receives a medal. A free mini-race for the youngest participants starts at 10:45, with on-site registration; a course test run takes place on 3 May with several pace groups. Västgötaloppet Trail is part of Västgötatrippeln (Classic/Skate, MTB and Trail). The event area is Dammen in Tvärred; the start and finish are centrally located, with parking nearby, and participants are offered drinks, snacks, a medal and hot food after the race. The 27 km and 17 km races have prize ceremonies; the 7 km race offers prizes by lottery. Part of Västgötaloppstrippeln.

name: LöpRallarn
location: Bottnaryds IP, Bottnaryd, Ljungby Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: LöpRallarn is part of Rallarloppen and is organized by Bottnaryds IF. The race offers shorter distances (listed as 7.5 km and 15 km) and attracts both young people and recreational runners—for example, the 2025 race drew around 102 participants. The start is at Bottnaryds IP, and the event takes place as a late-summer activity in the area around Bottnaryd. The organizer publishes results and contact details via the race’s designated email address.
course_highlights: A gently undulating loop near Bottnaryds IP (described as an 8 km loop in the Rallarloppet information)
A route that follows parts of the old, disused railway embankment
Passes natural areas near Dumme Mosse
additional: Previous editions (2025) featured both 7.5 km and 15 km, with many young people on the start list; the organizer publishes results via the same website and designated email address. LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series, alongside RallarLoppet (cross-country skiing) and CykelRallarn. The Rallarloppen course runs through the surrounding countryside, with the start and finish at Bottnaryds IP. LöpRallarn offers several distances (1 km, 2 km, 7.5 km and 15 km) for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna takes place on 7 September 2026 and is organised by Eskilstuna Friidrott. The event offers women’s and men’s 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet. The courses are described as fast and flat. The event is held in Stadsparken and combines recreational running with the aim of raising awareness of blood donation, including through a donor gift and a picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and participants can register individually or as a team.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured
The start and event area are in Stadsparken
additional: Participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team); members of the same team can take part in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template can be downloaded from the registration page, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies with more than 20 participants. Blood donor gifts are distributed at the Unilabs blood donor centre tent in the event area. Bag storage/drop-off is available (drop-off and collection are listed as 17:00–20:00). Course distances: 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet is 800 m. The event area includes bag drop and a picnic bag; participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team).

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual fun run in Skärblacka, offering a festival atmosphere for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus. There is also a 4 km walking class and a 900 m Little Children’s Race. The race is open to all levels and features generous prizes, lotteries and goodie bags for participants. Organisers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome everyone to the starting line on 9 September 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
The course includes asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and some trails
4 km walking class (shortened course) and 900 m Little Children’s Race near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday 8 September, 11:00–18:00; any remaining race numbers will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late entries are available when collecting race numbers. All participants receive a goodie bag; prizes, a sprint prize and lotteries are offered (including a tyre prize and course-record bonus). The walking class was introduced in 2024; race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via raceid; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment is accepted only by Swish or cash; a chip in the race number records the time; medical care, food and drink are available on site.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day event (11–13 September 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km to 100 miles. The routes follow technical singletrack, coastal trails and faster sections, and suit both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners, depending on the distance chosen. The event focuses on the trail-running experience, with local food, talks and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. The organisers offer GPS tracking, GPX files and aid-station support for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: A route featuring forest trails and coastal cliffs along the Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 metres of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Terrain: approximately 85% trail, 10% gravel and 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available to download; live GPS tracking and intermediate and final results are provided. The event is cupless—bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, a window decal and a handmade wooden finisher’s medal or belt buckle, depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists apply to the 100 km and 100-mile distances (including 1 litre of fluids, a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, a map, a GPS tracker, an emergency blanket, a rain jacket and a headlamp). Early cut-offs and aid-station locations have been published; the organiser plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (approximately 100 SEK, payable via Swish on site). A Night Trail and a 2 km children’s race are included; start and finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park. Bus transfers and GPX routes are included in the information for various distances.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race by Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organised by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses combine asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails, with the start and finish at Edbergavallen. There are distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes recreational runners, competitive runners and teams alike.
course_highlights: Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails along Lake Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
The 10 km course includes a hilly trail section (the illuminated trail in Humpa) and is more challenging
additional: Register via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank giro (discount codes may be available online). Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; on-site late registration is available from 10:00 (payment by Swish or exact cash). Distance information: 700 m (children, untimed), 1.3 km (children, timed), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel) and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded for completing the race for the 10th or 20th time (adult categories). Team registration (4–6 participants) includes a picnic bag intended for 5 people; team registration may close on 7 September if the bags run out. There is a kiosk at the event site. The prize ceremonies are at approximately 12:00 for the 1.3 km and approximately 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; adult categories can earn an extra commemorative medal for their 10th or 20th race; team registration is for 4–6 participants; race bib collection at Edbergavallen; an ICA picnic bag after the finish; kiosks at the event site; prize ceremonies according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Lake Nora in Nora, organised by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in early September and has historically been an important race in the Södra Svealand district, with DM/VDM status according to the district invitation. The route passes through varied scenery around the lake, including open fields, forests and streams, offering a course suited to both competitive runners and recreational runners. The race has a long tradition and is a popular part of the region’s running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Runt — a half marathon around the lake
Varied scenery along the course, with open fields, forests and streams
DM/VDM status in the Södra Svealand district and part of Södra Svealands Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the race began; the distance is a half marathon, and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Södra Svealand.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is an established cross-country race organised by IF Hagen on scenic Billingen in Skövde. The race offers a spectator-friendly 4.4 km course, run once or twice, along with a separate youth category and a children’s race for the youngest participants. The event has a long tradition and recently celebrated its 50th edition, with a focus on forest trails and the joy of running. Welcoming to both runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Scenic Billingen in Skövde
Spectator-friendly 4.4 km course, run once or twice (8.8 km)
Youth categories over 2.5 km and a special children’s race for the youngest participants
additional: Registration is via Race-ID, according to the invitation; the race information sheet (preliminary) is published ahead of the race. Late registration is permitted on site, approximately 45 minutes before the start (according to a previous information sheet). Results are published under Documents/Results (listed as Raceresult for previous years). The text mentions the 50th edition of Hagenloppet; the race takes place at Billingen in Skövde.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a welcoming trail race offered over 5, 10 and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast-running asphalt with winding trails through beech and coniferous forests, offering magnificent views of Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed to be as much about the experience as the performance, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, finishing with a descent down Grännaberget on a winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail, with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trails through beech forest, gravel roads and challenging hills, with magnificent views
additional: A mass start from the square takes runners through Gränna to the harbour, where timing begins; timing on all distances; a unique medal for all participants; the event venue and finish area are in the centre of Gränna, close to cafés, restaurants and accommodation; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a Backyard Ultra race held at Ästad Vineyard in Varberg. The race follows a 6.7 km loop that starts every full hour; the first start is at 09:00, and everyone who finishes in time starts the next loop until only one runner remains. The course consists of gravel and grass and offers views of vineyards and lakes. The organizer emphasizes that places are limited (200) and that participants take part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop (gravel and grass)
Views of vineyards and lakes along most of the loop
Starts every full hour (Backyard Ultra format), first start at 09:00
additional: Bib distribution/registration takes place in the start area in the morning (listed as 07:30–08:45 / 07:45–08:45 in the information). Mandatory equipment: headlamp and personal medication (the headlamp must be used between 20:00 and 07:00). Participants must bring their own cup (no disposable cups are provided). The start/finish and race area are at Ästad Vineyard’s staff car park near the high ropes course; places are limited to 200 participants and participation is at your own risk. Maximum 200 participants; registration 07:30–08:45; headlamp mandatory 20:00–07:00; own cup mandatory; Tailwind drinks; meals at scheduled times; signs and guidance on site; take care at crossings and follow instructions.

name: USWE Paradiset STHLM
description: USWE Paradiset STHLM is a 26 km trail race in Paradiset Nature Reserve south of Stockholm. The race features technical, winding trails over rocky outcrops, boardwalks across marshes and through open pine forest—a challenging yet scenic trail event. The distance is a round in the Outnorth Trailtour, and the race emphasises community, personal challenge and a festive atmosphere after the finish. The organiser is Trailrunning Sweden AB, and the event is aimed at trail runners who want to experience the wilderness south of Stockholm.
course_highlights: Technical singletrack trails with climbs and descents over rocky outcrops
Boardwalks across marshes and small tarns, as well as stretches of open pine forest
26 km through Paradiset Nature Reserve—a round in the Outnorth Trailtour
additional: The race date is listed as 12 Sep 2026. The event highlights the post-race celebration and finish-line atmosphere, and that the race is part of the Outnorth Trailtour. The organiser is listed as Trailrunning Sweden AB (Hästtorget 6, 312 30 Laholm). The terrain is described as challenging, with winding trails, rocky outcrops, boardwalks and marshes. The courses are marked with course tape, with start groups for each distance; start times and aid stations are listed; dogs are not allowed; there is a hydration arrangement and an after-party at Oasen.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes Nybro Backyard 12h as part of its annual race program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format that welcomes runners seeking an ultra challenge at a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature, and also offers rentals and personal training in Nybro. Contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on its website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
The organizer focuses on exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish payment number: 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rentals (roller-ski and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race features a 6,706 m loop, starts every full hour, and has changing rooms and showers nearby; parking is available at the stadium, and camping and motorhome pitches are available through Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp, and race bibs can be collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Södra änggårdsloppet
location: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Södra Änggården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Södra Änggårdsloppet is an inviting trail race in Södra Änggården, held for the third year. The course is approximately 8 km long with around 310 metres of elevation gain and runs through Änggårdsbergen. Participants are divided into groups so that both competitive runners and recreational runners feel comfortable. The event has a festive atmosphere, with smoke fireworks, food trucks, a DJ, and a medal and drink for participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km trail race
Around 310 metres of elevation gain through Änggårdsbergen
The course follows forest trails in Södra Änggården
additional: Participants are divided into groups/waves. The event has a festive atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, and a DJ. The participant package includes a nice medal, sparkling wine at check-in, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. The event time is listed as Saturday 12:00–16:00. The organiser is listed as WAI AB (contact: Byhrviktor@gmail.com), and Trailrunning Sweden AB is listed as the contact/organiser portal (info@trailrunningsweden.se). 8 km trail race through Änggårdsbergen with around 310 metres of elevation gain; participants are divided into groups; festival atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, and a DJ; medal, sparkling wine at check-in, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish; register via the link below.

name: Duvnäsloppet
description: Duvnäsloppet is a family-friendly race and fun run in Saltsjö-Duvnäs, winding through a beautiful, hilly residential area. The event is organised by Saltsjö-Duvnäs Sports Club and includes races for children and adults, starting and finishing at Ringparken. Everyone can take part, whether you run for fun or are more competitively minded, and the event emphasises community and enjoyment. Registration opens on 1 June 2026, and the race takes place on 12 September 2026.
course_highlights: Hilly residential area with several steep hills (including Fogdevägen and Vargungevägen)
The 5 km and 10 km courses follow the same route; the 10 km is two laps
Shorter race (1.7 km) and children’s race start and finish at Ringparken
additional: Registration opens on 1 June 2026. The regular advance-registration deadline is (usually) around 11 September; registration is accepted after that until race start for a higher fee. Race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on Friday evening from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 10:00 (at least one hour before the start). The timing chip is attached to the race number; 10 km runners use two race numbers (one at the front and one at the back). Registration is binding. Registration opens on 1 June 2026; distances are 5 km and 10 km (10 km is two laps); the children’s race starts at 11:00 and the adult race at approximately 12:30; race numbers can be collected at Ringparksstugan on race day or the evening before; advance registration is open until 11 September; the race is looking for volunteers.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott; Ideon Science Park; Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a team relay held in the Brunnshög and Ideon areas in north-eastern Lund. The start, finish and relay exchange area are in Nobelparken, and the course winds north towards ESS and through Kunskapsparken before returning to Nobelparken. Teams compete in women’s, men’s or mixed categories, and each runner covers approximately 5 km. The event is organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village. It is well suited to companies, student teams and families, alongside Nobelloppet and Brunnshögskalaset.
course_highlights: The course passes through Nobelparken and Kunskapsparken and heads towards ESS/Max IV
A relatively flat course with approximately 10 metres of elevation change
A mix of gravel and asphalt, with views over north-western Lund from the hill
additional: Teams consist of 2–4 people (company pages state 2–4; some texts mention 4); each runner covers approximately 5 km. The first leg starts together at 14:00; subsequent exchange times depend on the team’s pace (there is no time limit). Changing facilities, storage for outerwear, and food and drink are available in Nobelparken; runners receive a medal or a sausage after finishing. Recommended transport: tram line 1 to Brunnshögstorget. Four-person teams; start, finish and relay exchange area in Nobelparken (Brunnshög); the course heads towards ESS and Kunskapsparken; late registration on 1 September; student pricing; a Mecenat card is mentioned for bib collection; organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village.

name: Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years away, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö—a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event features four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman and the classic main race, Mälarömilen (10 km). The start and finish are at Träkvista sports ground, and the event emphasizes community, the joy of exercise and fast courses for those who want to compete. Teams and companies can also register together through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Paved walking paths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground; the course passes along the walking path north of the sports ground
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is available on race day for an increased fee. The number of places is limited, and registration is valid only once payment has been completed. Timing and race bibs are used in all categories (except Mälarö Knattelopp, which is untimed; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys aged 9–11 are timed but not ranked). The event area is at Träkvista sports ground, with medical services, a water station just after the start/lap point, and toilets, showers and changing rooms in KOM-huset. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301–311 (Träkvista Idrottsplats stop). The total limit is 1,000 runners, and all proceeds go back to Mälarö SOK’s sports activities. The race offers company and team registration, as well as support for teams.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running race in Lidköping organised by Lidköpings VSK. The 2026 race is planned for 13 September, with the start and finish at Rådåsgården and routes through the Rådaskogen fitness trails. Participants can choose from several distances: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km, with different start times. Timing is provided by C-time, and Umara sports drink is served during the races; registration is via RaceID. The race is part of a long tradition dating back to the 1960s and also includes a papricalopp for younger children.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rådåsgården in Lidköping, with routes through the scenic fitness trails in Rådaskogen
Several distances for different levels: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km
Timing provided by C-time, with Umara sports drink served during the races
additional: Rådalunken 2026 takes place at Rådåsgården, Lidköping, with several distances and timing and drink sponsors; a papricalopp for younger children is part of the event week. Registration is via RaceID, and race numbers are collected before the start.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is for teams of four, with each runner covering a leg of approximately 3 km. The race starts at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw after the finish. The event welcomes everyone from elite teams to recreational runners and encourages colourful and creative touches along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team competition: 4 people per team, each leg approximately 3 km
Awards ceremony at approximately 18:15 and a prize draw using race bib numbers
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday 11 September from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday 12 September from 11:00 to 13:30 (after that, in the start and finish area). Food is available on site, and an After Run package for the whole team is offered (price: 140 kr). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (water stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and prize draws. Teams collect their bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually from 11:00 to 13:30 on the days before), and After Run packages are available for teams (e.g. 140 kr according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety measures in line with recommendations from the authorities and encourages a focus on sustainability in themed activities.

name: Kung Björn Loppet

tiers.description: Fram till 14/9 Mini Kung Björn 95 kr.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 14/9 till 18/9 Löplabbets butik på Dragarbrunns Torg 6. Endast swish-betalning! Mini Kung Björn 95 kr.

description: Uppsala Running Club welcomes elite runners, recreational runners and children of all ages to the King Bear Race, Uppsala’s cross-country race with families at its heart. The race takes place at OK Linné’s clubhouse and offers several distances (10 km, 6 km, a trail race and children’s races). The event now has set start times, race-number collection with electronic chips and an awards ceremony, as well as the race’s 20th anniversary in 2026.
course_highlights: The course is mostly gravel roads and forest trails, with some sections of asphalt
Three distances: approx. 10 km, just over 6 km and a trail race of approx. 5 km; the courses are marked every kilometre
Water stations: two on the 10 km course and one on the 6 km course; water is also available at the finish
additional: Race numbers with electronic chips can be collected at Löplabbet, Dragarbrunns Torg 6, on Friday 19 September from 12:00 to 18:30, or on race day from 09:00 until one hour before each start (30 minutes before the children’s races). Those who collect their race number on Friday get 20% off regular prices at the Löplabbet store (excluding electronics). Paid parking is available; the organisers recommend public transport (bus route 7) or cycling. Changing rooms and showers are available, but space is limited. There is a kiosk on site, an awards ceremony at approx. 13:30 and a prize draw. Start groups: the 10 km has start group 1 (under 50 minutes) and group 2; the 6 km starts in one combined group. Members who have completed at least one volunteer shift can register for free via kb.loppet@gmail.com. Water stations; race-number collection at Löplabbet (Dragarbrunns Torg 6); Swish payment; start times: 11:00 (10 km), 12:00 (6 km), 12:15 (trail); awards ceremony at approx. 13:30; a medal for all finishers; paid parking; public transport or cycling recommended; no timing for the children’s races.

name: Kistaloppet
description: Kistaloppet is a family-friendly urban running event organised by Löparakademin, with races for all ages: Kistaloppet 5 km, Lilla Kistaloppet/Fun Run 1.6 km and Kistaloppet MINI for the youngest participants. The courses offer a varied running experience through the million-programme high-rise housing area, the green spaces of Järvafältet and Kista’s IT cluster, with the start and finish at Jan Stenbecks torg next to Kista Galleria. The event emphasises accessibility and community (including the #RUN4ZERO initiative) and is designed both for recreational runners and for those who want to race on the officially measured 5 km course. The event is usually complemented by music, entertainment and a festive atmosphere along the course.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km course through Kista, passing high-rise buildings, the green spaces of Järvafältet and the IT cluster
Start and finish in a central location on Färögatan at Jan Stenbecks torg, next to Kista Galleria
Music stations/DJs and entertainment along the course create a festive atmosphere
additional: Registration is free and includes a medal; registration is open through 17 September (subject to availability). Race bib collection is at the event centre in Kista Galleria (premises opposite McDonald’s): Friday 19 September 12:00 - 18:00 and Saturday 20 September 09:15 - 13:00 (race bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start). There is a water station at the finish; medical staff will be on site. Only the adult race (Kistaloppet 5K) has general timing; the other races, including Fun Run, are untimed. Volunteers are expected to be available from approximately 09:00 - 15:30. Races for the whole family: 5K, LILLA Kistaloppet, Kistaloppet MINI and Fun Run; registration is free; Lilla Kistaloppet is approximately 1.6 km and MINI is 500 m; all who complete Lilla Kistaloppet receive a medal; start times and race bib collection are at Kista Galleria.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Kretsloppet in Borås is a street festival where runners of all ages are invited to run 5 km or 10 km through the city streets and parks. Younger participants can take part in children’s races (400 m and 2 km), and the event finishes in the heart of Borås, in the city centre/city park. The event welcomes both experienced runners and recreational runners, and encourages people to take part in groups with family, friends or colleagues. The organisers describe a joyful atmosphere with music, cheers from the crowd and activities around the race.
course_highlights: Race through the streets and parks of Borås
Finish in Borås city centre/city park (selfie booth at the finish)
Children’s races of 400 m and 2 km, specially suited to younger participants
additional: Registration is available on the website until race day (no later than 1 hour before each race). Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. Payment can be made by card or Swish; group registration for companies/organisations is available, with invoicing through a group account. Items can be pre-ordered during registration: the Kretsloppet functional T-shirt (150 kr, order by 19 August), wooden medal (50 kr, last day to pre-order 11 September) and ICA City recovery bag (70 kr, last day to order 11 September). After registering, a booking confirmation is sent by email; approximately one week before the race, a race pass with a QR code is sent, which is used to collect the race bib. Registration for the 10 km closes on 30 June; on-site registration is available until 1 hour before the start. Registration for the 5 km can be made via the website up to and including race day. Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. The race pass with QR code and race bib can be printed or shown at the venue. Group registration is available for companies/organisations. Add-on items can be pre-ordered: T-shirt 150 kr, medal 50 kr and ICA Recovery Bag 70 kr. A certificate is available via the results website.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås, offered over several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a varied 10-mile (16.1 km) loop featuring technical trails, running tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails and some asphalt. The race is organised by Västerås Löparklubb. Finishers receive a medal, and runners who complete the 100 miles in under 24 hours receive a belt buckle.
course_highlights: One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km); the race consists of repeated loops
Varied surfaces: technical trails, running tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails and some asphalt
An urban course, with the start, lap point and finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course in under 24 hours receive the BRR belt buckle; other finishers receive a medal. Participants may decline the medal, in which case the organiser donates SEK 20 to Médecins Sans Frontières. The course is permanently marked with red posts. The 100-mile distance has a 24-hour time limit.

name: Lergöksloppet
location: Råbocka camping, Kronoskogen, Ängelholm Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Lergöksloppet is a recreational race organised by FK Snapphanarna on winding trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm. The start and finish are at Råbocka Camping, and the race welcomes children, recreational runners and competitive runners. After finishing, participants receive a medal, and fruit/juice or coffee/tea and a sandwich are served, depending on the class. Shower and changing facilities are limited, and it is also possible to register on race day for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Winding trails and forest roads in Kronoskogen
Start and finish at Råbocka Camping
A forest setting near Ängelholm, suitable for children and recreational runners alike
additional: Race bibs are handed out at Råbocka Camping from 09:00 on race day. Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 for an additional fee, until 30 minutes before the start. Medals go to everyone who finishes; prizes are awarded to the top woman and man. Shower and changing facilities are available in limited numbers. Class 1 can be run together with children at no extra cost. The race starts and finishes at Råbocka Camping, with Kronoskogen as the venue; free parking is available, and shower and changing facilities are available in limited numbers. After the finish, participants can take a dip in the sea near the shore of Skälderviken.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast, scenic half marathon on a former railway embankment between Forshaga and Karlstad. The course is entirely traffic-free and has no steep climbs. The race is certified by the Swedish Athletics Association and has three hydration stations serving water and sports drink. The race starts at Forshaga Learning Centre and finishes in Karlstad, where participants are offered fruit and refreshments after the finish. It is a popular race that attracts many runners looking to set a personal best in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows a former railway embankment and is entirely traffic-free, with no steep climbs
Three official hydration stations serving water and sports drink
Certified half marathon with central sanctioning from the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: The start is at Forshaga Learning Centre, with race-bib collection from 09:00 to 10:00. A bus leaves from Karlstad City Library for the start at 09:00 and has room for equipment. The maximum time allowed for the race is 2:45 hours; a sweeper minibus is available. Bag transport to the finish is provided. Medical care is available at the start, finish and hydration stations. After the finish, bananas, buns and chocolate are offered. Sports drink is supplied by Umara, with a discount code for participants. The event also includes other distances, such as 7.5 km, as well as longer cycling and roller-ski races; corporate challenges and health initiatives are also available.

name: Hökensås Trail
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race taking place on 20 September 2026 in the area around First Camp Hökensås, outside Tidaholm. The race offers three distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km, with the start and finish at First Camp Hökensås between 10:00 and 14:00. Organizer CKU6 (Cykelklubben U6) offers the race as part of Motionsloppet, in collaboration with Grebbestad Multisport, according to the information provided. The terrain combines forest roads and trails with roots and rocks, offering nature-close challenges in the Hökensås area.
course_highlights: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km
Start and finish at First Camp Hökensås in Tidaholm
Start times between 10:00 and 14:00
additional: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km; starts from First Camp Hökensås; Start times 10:00–14:00; Sports drink supplier: Umara; Organizer: CKU6 as part of Motionsloppet; Contact: hokensastrail@motionsloppet.se

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race organised by IFK Skövde (now run by IFK Skövde Skidor), with a history dating back to 1966. Since 1993, both men and women have competed in the main 10.5 km race, which has strong local and historical roots and listed course records. In recent years, the event has expanded to include categories for younger runners and a Nordic walking category. Welcome to a classic cross-country challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Billingen.
course_highlights: A traditional cross-country race on the slopes of Billingen
Main distance: 10.5 km (since 1993), on varied terrain
Categories for younger runners (Knatteloppet, Lilla Billingehusloppet) and Nordic walking
additional: Organised by IFK Skövde Skidor. Course records are listed on the website (e.g. Men’s 10.5 km: 31:51; Women’s 10.5 km: 37:44). There is an archive of results, separate shorter children’s races, and a Nordic walking category. Cross-country race distances range from 1.6 km to 10.5 km; Nordic walking is available on all courses; Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet are for younger runners; results and registration are available via links on the Svenskalag page.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping, starting and finishing in Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organised by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration is through cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members, the race is free with the campaign code LGIF2024; the price for other participants is listed on the website. The event is also looking for volunteers and offers a clear city-run experience in central Linköping.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Trädgårdsföreningen, in central Linköping
A city run focused on central Linköping
The LGIF2024 campaign code makes the race free for LGIF members
additional: The website includes sections on Time & place, Registration fee, Registration, Timing, Prizes, Time limit, Race bibs, Race confirmation, Transfer of entry, Category change, Unable to attend/Insurance, Changing & showers, Bag drop, Toilets, Warm-up, Food & drink, Energy, Medical care, Results and Terms. Registration through cooplinkopingrunt.se; campaign code LGIF2024 makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are wanted.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race in central Trollhättan, starting and finishing at Folkets Park. The courses follow technical trails and many staircases along the waterfall and canal lock area, offering varied, hilly terrain with sections of gravel and asphalt. The event offers several distances for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners—from the Mini Trail children’s race to the longer Half Marathon+. Runners with dogs are also welcome in designated start groups.
course_highlights: Technical, winding trails and challenging staircases in central Trollhättan
Passes sights including Kopparklinten, Gamle Dal, several canal locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
Varied, hilly terrain with sections of gravel and asphalt; the 22.5 km course includes an extra loop with more technical trails
additional: Bib pickup from 11:30 at the start (Folkets Park). Marked and signposted changing rooms are available at Arena Älvhögsborg (Storgatan 1). Toilets are available at the start and in the changing area. There are three aid stations with water and sports drink along the course, plus an aid station at the finish. Trollhättan Mini Trail (0.8 km) is a children’s race with no timing. The 8.5 km and 14 km distances are also open to dogs on a leash in separate start groups (in cooperation with MIMsafe). GPX files are available; start times according to the race information: Trollhättan Mini Trail at 13:00, other distances at 14:00 and 14:15; aid stations along the course and at the finish; bag storage at the start/finish; changing rooms at Arena Älvhögsborg.

name: Sicklaloppet
description: Sicklaloppet is an autumn running festival in Nacka that welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. The main event is a 10 km fun run along the beautiful lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad, starting and finishing at Sickla Köpkvarter. There is also a 5 km Energilopp and Lilla Sicklaloppet for children up to 12 years old. The race offers a scenic, fast course, a wonderful atmosphere and plenty of crowd support. Sicklaloppet is organised by Järla IF Orientering and is a major community celebration for the whole family.
course_highlights: The course runs along the lakeshores of Sickla and Hammarby Sjöstad
The surface is approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel and 10% wooden boardwalk
Start and finish at Sickla Köpkvarter, with beautiful scenery and crowd support
additional: Race bibs can be collected from partner XLL Sickla köpkvarter in the days before the race and on race day. The event venue opens at 08:00 and offers services and food trucks. There is a warm-up on site before the start. Race-day registration is available for an increased fee if the event is not sold out. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. The 10 km starting pen opens at 12:30. The 10 km time limit is approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes; after that, a rope will be put across the course at Kyrkviken for safety reasons. Terrain: scenic course along lakeshores, registration via partner XLL Sickla köpkvarter, family-friendly event, includes children’s races

name: TCS Lidingöloppet (Lidingöloppshelgen)
distance_verbose: 30 km, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 kr till och med 6/9 2026 (Gruppanmälan öppen tom 6/9)

description: TCS Lidingöloppet is the world’s largest cross-country race and takes place on the last weekend of September on Lidingö. The weekend offers events for all levels—from a 1.7 km children’s race to the classic 30 km race—and attracts over 30,000 runners to its scenic, hilly courses. The event is both a competitive challenge and a celebration of running, with a Sports Expo where you collect your race number and meet exhibitors. The natural surroundings and soft trails are hallmarks of the race.
course_highlights: Hilly, soft trails through forest and open areas, alternating between flat meadows, gravel roads, sloping paths and steep hills
TCS Lidingöloppet 30 km: approximately 522 metres of elevation gain
TCS Lidingöloppet 15 km: approximately 250 metres of elevation gain; starts at Koltorp and finishes at Grönsta Gärde
additional: Everyone who finishes receives the TCS Lidingöloppet bronze medal, featuring a unique Carl Milles design each year. A silver medal is available if you meet the silver-medal time and started in starting group 2 or lower. A diploma is provided as a PDF in the results email (a printed diploma can be ordered for 50 kr, including postage). Enervit offers on-course support stations (product stations for a fee). Minimum ages: 30 km = 17 years, 15 km = 15 years (other races have various age limits). The Sports Expo is used for race-number collection and features exhibitors. Lidingöloppet is a non-profit, association-run organisation (contact: Vasavägen 82, 181 41 Lidingö; telephone 08-7652615; email info@lidingoloppet.se). The early Early Bird discount (20%) has already been deducted from prices marked with *. Plan your experience: race-number collection, partners and exhibitors are on site. Environmentally friendly travel options include a free bus from Ropsten to Lidingövallen, runner buses from several locations in central Sweden, bicycle parking and carpooling. Access is limited and parking is scarce during the event. Seeding race ahead of the weekend: Vårmilen can be purchased as a seeding race (price 100–200 kr).

name: Hiit Out Trailrun 2027
location: Mellingerum, Oskarshamn Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden

name: Tjurruset
price_range: early bird priser, exakt belopp inte specificerat
description: Tjurruset in Karlstad is one of the year’s most eagerly anticipated and muddiest running festivals. The race offers a challenging course with obstacles, mud and water, creating a unique and fun running experience for all participants. The atmosphere is defined by camaraderie, fighting spirit and joy, making Tjurruset a memorable event for both runners and spectators. Registration is open, and booking your place early is a good way to get the best price and motivation to train.
course_highlights: Challenging obstacle course with mud and water
One of the year’s muddiest and most fun running festivals
Strong camaraderie and spectator energy along the course
additional: Team registration is available for teams of 5–6 people, with the five fastest times counting. Register teams by email at tavling@ifgota.se, as the team registration form is currently not working. The race is approximately 10 km long, with team and children’s races also available. Medical staff will be on site, and participants must register in person with their race number and chip.

name: TCS Lilla Lidingöloppet (Rosa Bandet-loppet)
description: The Pink Ribbon Race is part of TCS Lidingöloppet weekend on Lidingö and offers 4 km or 10 km of running in support of the Swedish Cancer Society. The race starts follow the Grönsta and Koltorp start times, and the courses are soft and scenic. From 2025, a new 4 km category for ages 9–15 (FP-9-15) is available. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes in full to the Swedish Cancer Society, and the Pink Ribbon Race@Home option is available for running at home. The Pink Ribbon Race is part of Lidingöloppet weekend and of Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.
course_highlights: 4 km and 10 km on soft courses through Lidingö’s scenic terrain
SEK 100 of the entry fee goes in full to the Swedish Cancer Society
New FP-9-15 category in the 4 km race from 2025 for younger runners
additional: The minimum age for Lilla Lidingöloppet is 7–15 years. Start times are listed by the Grönsta and Koltorp start groups, and warm-up and start corral rules are strictly followed. SEK 100 of the entry fee goes to the Swedish Cancer Society, and the Pink Ribbon Race is part of Lidingöloppet weekend, Tjejklassikern and Kortklassikern.

name: Ekerumsloppet
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, an autumn cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organised by Högby IF Friidrott. The race offers 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners, starting at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively. The start and finish are at Ekerum Resort. The registration deadline is 26 September 2026; late registration is available at race-number collection from 09:00 on race day. The race follows cross-country trails through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners
additional: A cross-country race through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline: 26 September 2026; Late registration at race-number collection from 09:00 on race day

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a running event in Tidaholm, Sweden, organized by Motionsloppet. Official information and results are published on motionsloppet.se. The event is promoted on Motionsloppet’s Facebook page and listed as Tidaholm Marathon on the municipality’s events page, suggesting it is a recurring race in the area.
additional: Results are available on motionsloppet.se; the event has been promoted via the municipality’s Facebook events page (Tidaholm Marathon).

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 295 kr jubileumspris max 100 platser eller till och med 31 mars

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a family-friendly trail race in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve in Borås, with several distances for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The race features beautiful trails, challenging hills and stunning views of lakes and cliffs. The event is a festival at the start and finish area, with music, exhibitors and a runners’ lounge. It has been held since 2017 and offers both children’s races and sanctioned competitions.
course_highlights: Beautiful trails and challenging hills, including Djävulsbacken/Björbotoppen
Scenic views and sections by Rya Klint and Fjällsjön; the 24 km course has approximately 685 metres of elevation gain
Varied terrain: technical trails, gravel roads and a final downhill stretch
additional: Race bib collection is available Friday 13:30–18:00 at Glasögonmäster and Saturday 09:45–12:45 at the event area. Chip timing is provided by Eq Timing; bags can be left at the start/finish area. Parking is available on Almenäsvägen, at Ryda Sportfält and in Knalleland; nearby bus stops have good connections. The runners’ lounge and food/coffee are available on site; changing facilities and showers are available at Borås Camping. Aid stations: the 24 km course has 4 stations and the 12 km course has 2 stations (Umara sports drink). Recommended equipment: mobile phone, elastic bandage and trail shoes (especially for 24 km). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; part of the Trailtour. Start time: 13:00. The 2025 race was moved to 5 October due to a weather warning. Contact and registration: info@ryaasartrailrun.se. Results are published on the race results page.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, hilly trail race held from the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget. The race offers several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and several children’s/youth classes) and runs partly on trails and partly off-trail, with significant elevation gain and technical descents. A special feature is Strutsabacken, where climb times are recorded and the Bergatroll award goes to the fastest ascent. The event is family-friendly, with food and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly trail sections on both trails and off-trail terrain
Strutsabacken (the ski slope), with a separately timed climb and the Bergatroll award
Views over Lake Vättern and a technical descent through Ulvadalen
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15 and worn visibly at the front during the race; the chip does not need to be returned. Aid stations are located along the course (with kilometre markers for each distance). Changing rooms and showers are available in the IKHP cabin, valuables can be stored in a locked area at bib collection, and food is available at the start/finish. After finishing, participants are treated to a “troll menu” by the organiser (show your race bib). Hamburgers are served after the race; aid stations are available along the course; changing rooms and showers are available; Startklar insurance is available (175 kr/year); maximum 500 participants; race bibs must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:00.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a familiar yet new course, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organised by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants: both 5 km and 10 km are available. Promoted as one of Sweden’s most beautiful recreational races, the event welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to take part on 3 October.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken in central Motala
A familiar yet new course through central parts of Motala
Short recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for recreational runners
additional: Organiser: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as “Sweden’s most beautiful recreational race”. The website encourages visitors to save 3 October in their calendars and notes that prices apply until 28/9 (the next price increase). There are four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth) and 400 m (children’s race). Race numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on 2–3 October. The prize ceremony takes place in Stadsparken at approximately 14:30.

name: Förbifartspremiären
description: The Förbifartspremiären is a one-off event where you can run or walk on the new E4, both above ground and through its tunnels, before the road opens to traffic. The race takes place on 3 October 2026, starting and finishing at the new Akalla interchange, and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There will be a competitive class (approximately 12 km), a recreational class (choice of approximately 4, 7 or 12 km) and a walking class (Herr Gårman, approximately 4 km). The event is billed as a unique “once in a lifetime” experience—the chance to be among the first to set foot on the new road.
course_highlights: The route runs both above ground and through tunnels on the new E4.
Start and finish at the new Akalla interchange (Vandagatan).
The recreational class has exits after approximately 4, 7 or 12 km, so you choose your distance during the race.
additional: Registration opens on 5 February at 12:00. The race has a maximum time of 1 hour 30 minutes; the competitive class starts at approximately 09:00, the recreational class has start times between 10:00 and 17:30, and Herr Gårman (walking) between 18:00 and 19:30. Customer service: Gustavslundsvägen 18, 167 51 Bromma, telephone +46 8 545 66 440, opening hours Tuesday–Thursday 09:00–15:00 (lunch 12:00–13:00). Individuals can pay by card, Klarna invoice or Swish; company invoices are available only for groups of 20 or more through a designated contact. Registration is binding and personal. Registration opens on 5 February at 12:00; the first section, Hjulsta–Häggvik, is planned to open at the end of 2026; the entire Förbifart Stockholm is due for completion in 2030; starting places are sold through Marathongruppen; the race includes a race bib, timing, finish-line services and a medal; approximately 10,000 starting places were sold in the first hour.
