description: Höstruset is a fast 5 km race in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. There is also a 700 m children’s race for ages 3–7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated ahead of the 2026 edition.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers are available)
Course measured and certified (measurement date: 2024-09-08); timing by ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from 29 September (at an increased fee) is available through the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Race bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is recorded using an ankle transponder, which must be returned (a fee of SEK 400 is charged for a lost transponder). Parking at the school is very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Motionscentral is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration incurs a higher fee, and Swish is used on race day. Register via anmalmig.nu; results are available online via Hug Timing.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
description: FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to Vånga Mountain Xtreme on 4 October 2026. Choose between 8, 16 or 40 km of trail running with 300, 600 and 1,500 m of elevation gain respectively; the course features the steep Vångabacke, winding trails through wilderness, and views of small lakes and quarries. The race is billed as both beautiful and very challenging, and one that leaves a lasting impression. The youngest runners can take part in VMX Kids, with free registration on site.
course_highlights: The steep, classic Vångabacke, a short but powerful climb
Winding trails through wilderness, past small lakes and deep quarries
Total elevation gain: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Online registration via the website is open until Wednesday 30 September 2026 at 23:59. Late registration is available at the venue, subject to availability, until approximately one hour before the start; on-site payment is by Swish. Registration is binding, and refunds of the entry fee are available only through valid insurance (for example, Startklar). The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Organizer: FK Göingarna. VMX Kids: free registration on site. Maximum number of participants: 800; online registration until 2026-09-30 at 23:59; start time: VMX Kids starts at 12:15; time limits: 3 hours (16 km) and 7 hours (40 km); Startklar insurance is recommended; VMX Kids has free registration on site; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Skrylle naturreservat, Södra Sandby, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-focused race organised by Björnstorps IF, with the start and finish at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organiser is introducing a new, more trail-focused loop course, with the option to run one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a nature-close and challenging experience on the area’s best trails, and information will be updated throughout the spring. Early bird entry is available, and there is also a 600 m children’s race.
course_highlights: Loop course starting and finishing at Skryllegården
More trail—the course uses the area’s best trails
Cut-off for the 25 km: pass the 12.5 km point by 12:15 (based on a 10:30 start)
additional: You can register online until 60 minutes before the start, or register on site. On race day, name or distance changes can be made for an administration fee of 100 SEK (changing from 12.5 km to 56 km costs 200 SEK). On-site payments are accepted by Swish only. The 600 m children’s race is free, includes a medal and does not allow pre-registration; race numbers can be collected when checking in on race morning. Parking at Skryllegården will be limited, so the organiser encourages carpooling or cycling. The first start for 12.5 km is at 11:00 and the 25 km start is at 10:30. The 25 km has a cut-off at the lap point at 12:15. Online registration is open until 60 minutes before the start; distance or name changes are allowed for a fee. You can also register on site on race day and pay by Swish. Race numbers can be collected at Löplabbet in Lund before the race or at Skryllegården on race day. Bag drop is available, and the 600 m children’s race is free.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is organised by Ryssbergets IK and offers several races on the same race day: 10.0 km, 5.0 km, a 2.0 km children’s race, and a Walk - Jog - Run option. Registration is via the club’s registration page, and course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km races are published on the website. The club encourages participants to review the age/class categories and volunteer information in advance. The organiser shares practical information on an ongoing basis via its website and contact email.
course_highlights: 10.0 km and 5.0 km courses (course maps are available on the website)
2.0 km children’s race and a Walk - Jog - Run option
Age/class categories (see the categories on the website)
additional: Course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km races are published on the website. There is a volunteer registration option—the organiser is seeking volunteers, and volunteering affects the handling of entry fees (see volunteer registration). Contact details and postal address: Ryssbergets IK, Kyrkvägen 1, 29535 Bromölla; tel. 0705876711; email info@ryssbergetsik.se. Results are published after the race.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. The race is organised by the Mental Health Run association, and all proceeds go directly to psychiatric research. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone can take part, regardless of background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History on Djurgården
An easy-to-run or walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
A course on Djurgården with lake views and urban scenery
additional: A virtual option is available (listed as 10–18 October 2026). The event offers a medal as an optional add-on when registering, as well as the opportunity to donate. Optional items and medals are mailed within one month after the virtual race ends. Information about race bibs and collection is published on the news pages (in previous years, race bibs have been available for collection at Filmstaden Sergel). You can add a medal and donate to psychiatric research; the medal is mailed within one month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app from 10–18 October using a special code, and results are displayed in the finish area. Timing is provided by Racetimer. Bag drop, an accessible toilet and refreshments are available. Nordic walking poles are permitted, and dogs must start further back.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, 11 October 2026—a fast, well-organised 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby in north-west Stockholm. The course is flat, officially measured at exactly 10,000 m and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people is also held on the same day. This page contains all the information about the course, start, registration and practical details for runners.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on an all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: The event centre is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100). The start is on a field 400 m from the sports grounds, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometre away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5–13 can take part in the Lilla Hässelbyloppet. The maximum time allowed is 2 hours. The course has been officially measured by an approved course measurer and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The event is streamed live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approx. 37:30–60 min). A live stream of the event is offered according to information from the organiser.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a road race in Örebro that showcases the city at its best along the Svartån. On 10 October 2026, participants can choose from 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and the Ullmax KidsRun for children. The race is organised by KFUM Örebro Friidrott, with the start and race services at Tybblelundshallen. Information is updated regularly on the organiser’s Facebook page. The race courses are officially measured, and the event is held in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Runs along the beautiful Svartån
Passes the scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Race numbers are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (no ID is required, and you can collect them for multiple participants). Timing uses transponders attached to the foot or ankle, which must be returned at the finish or if you withdraw; a lost transponder is charged at 400 kr. Some participants receive disposable chips attached to their race numbers, which do not need to be returned. Changing facilities and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets and medical assistance are available along the course; water and sports drinks are provided on the 10 km and 21.1 km courses and at the finish. Parents may run with their child in the KidsRun at no charge. Half-marathon participants must turn 17 during the year; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km. Register at anmalmig.nu; timing is transponder-based, and race-number collection is at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations are located along the course. The half-marathon has a minimum age of 17; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a classic race taking place for the 52nd time in 2026, offering marathon and half marathon distances, with the start and finish inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The course was officially measured in 2024. It is a flat, straight out-and-back course that follows the cycle path along the old railway embankment by the coast, with the turnaround at Lilla Amundön. Half marathon runners complete one lap and marathon runners two, offering good opportunities for fast times. The race is organised by Solvikingarna, with the race centre at Friidrottens hus.
course_highlights: Flat, straight out-and-back course along the old railway embankment by the coast, turning at Lilla Amundön
Half marathon = 1 lap; marathon = 2 laps. Every kilometre is marked
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The race centre is Friidrottens hus (bib pickup and race-day registration). Start groups: 10:00 Marathon; 10:30 Half marathon (estimated time under 1:45); 10:45 Half marathon (estimated time over 1:45). Aid stations are located at approximately 4.2 km, 8.4 km, 12.6 km and 16.8 km, offering water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins. After finishing, all participants receive a drink, a banana, coffee/tea and a sandwich. Personal drinks/energy can be transported to the aid stations. The registration deadline is race day, 2026-10-10 at 09:00, if the race is not full; it is possible to transfer or sell a place through MittLopp until 2026-10-07 for a fee of 100 kr. The distance can be changed until 2026-10-07 or on race day up to one hour before the start (any difference in the entry fee may apply). Participants must be at least 17 years old during the year. Distances: marathon and half marathon. In 2025, more than 500 people started (514 participants, 354 finishers), according to the results page. The race takes place in October. The start and finish of Diabetes Wellness Göteborg Marathon 2025 were at Slottsskogsvallen.

name: Ultunamilen
description: Ultunamilen is a recreational race in Uppsala offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The results list published for the race on 10 October 2026 shows the men’s events at those distances. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration handled via SportAdmin. The date of the edition mentioned is 2026-10-10, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Results published (men’s events) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, with registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows 2026-10-10 as the date and lists the 5 km and 10 km distances. Note that external pages (such as the Stockholm update) require login for full information.

name: Umemaran
description: Umemaran is a traditional marathon and half marathon organised by Jalles TC Umeå together with IFK Umeå, starting and finishing at Tegs Centralskola. The marathon course (42 km) follows the Ume River for much of the route, via Ön, and includes a partly new, faster section. The course has been officially measured by an SFIF course measurer, and every kilometre is marked. Water stations serving Umara sports drink and water are located approximately every four kilometres. Chip timing and shower facilities are available at the start area. Medals are awarded at the finish for both the 42 km and 21 km races, and the 42 km race is held concurrently with the Northern Norrland Championships for senior and veteran runners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Ume River for much of the route, via Ön, on both sides
Partly new, faster route; officially measured by an SFIF-certified course measurer
Every kilometre is marked; water stations with Umara sports drink and water approximately every 4 km
additional: Timing is by chip (chips must be returned at the finish); race numbers and chips are collected at Tegs Centralskola no later than 45 minutes before the start. Late entries can be made at the start venue by Swish or cash. Showers are available in Jubileumshallen (basement level) for men and women. Prize ceremonies: 21 km immediately after finishing; 42 km at approximately 16:20 in the auditorium. The entry fee includes a participant medal, an Umara energy bar, coffee and a sandwich; Team Sportia Ersboda raffles a bicycle among 42 km finishers who are present at the prize ceremony. Start times (according to the 2025 invitation): 42 km at 11:00; 21 km at 11:30. Fees: Half marathon SEK 300 (late entry SEK 400); Marathon SEK 500 (late entry SEK 600). Water every 4 km; changing facilities and showers in Jubileumshallen. Registration via raceid.com; chip timing and medals included; coffee and a sandwich after the race, plus prize draws.

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
FK Friskus-Varberg invites you to a running race on Saturday, October 18, with the start and finish at Friskusstugan.

The course takes you past large parts of Varberg. You’ll run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget, with magnificent views over the sea. The route also passes through several parks and urban forests, including the lovely Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen. In addition to the half marathon, an 11.5 km course is also offered.

All information and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se

images.alt_text: Man springer längs en kuststig med havet i bakgrunden under Varberg Halvmarathon.
Deltagare i Varberg Halvmarathon startar loppet bland höstfärger.
Glad löpare med medalj och nummerlapp vid Varberg Halvmarathon.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Craft Idre Fjällmaraton
description:
Become unbeatable
We believe everyone has the right to feel unbeatable at some point. Not in relation to anyone else, but in relation to yourself. Unbeatable because you achieved something you didn’t think was possible. Because you dared to do something you didn’t think you could. Because you ventured into unknown territory and won. You won over that little voice telling you that you can’t.

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund, Tanum Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a coastal 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand. The race is the final event in Outnorth Trailtour and is expected to bring together Sweden’s trail-running elite for the deciding contests. The course is hilly and features rocky outcrops, winding trails and sweeping sea views along Bohuslän’s distinctive coastline. The organiser also recommends accommodation and the banquet at TanumStrand to round off the weekend.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running along the coast from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Rocky outcrops, jetties and coastal views with the scent of seaweed
Winding trails through fishing villages and varied terrain (mountains, forest and sea)
additional: Final event in Outnorth Trailtour; part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia; recommended accommodation and banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort; newsletter offers from partners (including 20% off Asics trail shoes via Outnorth). Start in Havstenssund, with buses to the start from TanumStrand; orange course markings; some sections are narrow and technical, and water levels may be affected by high tide; shoes with metal spikes are not allowed; bag drop costs 30 kr; name changes cost 200 kr; dogs are not allowed; toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården—a fun and challenging trail race where determination often matters more than perfect running form. The course features forest trails, muddy sections, wet stretches and technical terrain. Adults can choose between 5 or 10 km. For children, there is Kalvruset (approx. 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approx. 700 m). The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården features forest trails, muddy sections and wet stretches
Adults can choose between 5 km and 10 km; Kalvruset is approx. 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approx. 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills, where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that may not make it home. Kalvruset has a medical first-aid team on site, and all children receive a medal bearing the year. Organised by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; any surplus goes back to sport. Group registration for companies; corporate tent and meeting point; any surplus goes back to sport.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
distance_verbose: 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 1.7 km, 0.6 km, 0.3 km
description: Running Lights is an evening race held during the Lights in Alingsås festival, offering a magical, illuminated urban setting. The event has distances for all ages—from Maxi-Knatte and youth races to 5 km, 10 km and a 3×1660 m relay. The start and finish are at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan), and the courses pass through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is family-friendly and is part of the Västsvenska löparcupen.
course_highlights: Courses through illuminated urban areas during Lights in Alingsås
Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Distances: Maxi-Knatte 300 m, Energiloppet 600 m, youth race 1660 m, relay 3×1660 m, 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps)
additional: Start times: Maxi-Knatte 16:00, Energiloppet 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 16:45, the relay 17:05, 5 km 18:00, 10 km 19:00. Start and finish at Stora torget (Kungsgatan). The 5 km is one lap; the 10 km is two laps. The races are part of the Västsvenska löparcupen. Part of the Västsvenska löparcupen; registration and race pack collection 9–10 October; running expo with free admission; After Run starts at 19:00 with the discount code 'runninglights' for 15% off.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Nordiska Mästarnas Backyard Ultra
description:
Location:
Fyskompaniet Training Center at Rattens gränd 1, Bromölla

Event venue:
The event venue is next to the entrance to Fyskompaniet. The area is paved. We will not know until early October whether we can use a large indoor warehouse or set up a large event tent outside on the paved area. The start and finish will be outside on the paved area, where there is room to put up your own small tents.

Course:
The course has been carefully designed to allow as many laps as possible and is currently certified for 81 laps. Asphalt 2,530 m, lawn 152 m, trail 1,301 m, gravel/farm road 2,700 m, wooden bridge 23 m, with approximately 30 metres of elevation gain.
Trash bins are located at approximately 1, 3 and 6 km.
Take a look at the course in this YouTube video: www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBX3idm2zDo. However, the start will differ slightly from the video, depending on how we arrange the start in October. In addition, the whole course is beautifully coloured by all the shades of autumn.
The entire course is marked with reflective fabric markers. Arrows are also placed at every junction and anywhere the route may be unclear.

Aid station:
There will always be a well-stocked aid station with water, sports drinks, food, snacks and anything else you can think of that you might need for a long run.

We will also serve:

Dinner: after the 17:00 lap
Evening sandwiches: after the 20:00 lap
Breakfast: between 05:30 and 07:30, starting Sunday
Lunch: after the 11:00 lap, starting Sunday
And so on...
We always have vegan and gluten-free options.

Changing rooms, showers, sauna and toilets:
The changing rooms are close to the event venue. There are spacious changing rooms for women and men, with several showers and a sauna. Toilets are also available there.

Toilets in the event area will be portable toilets, accessible both before and after the start.

Start:
Saturday 11/10 at 10:00

Finish:
When the last runner runs their final lap.

Rules:
We follow the official rules, which you can find here: ultrasignup.com/register.aspx?did=113992

Timing / results:
Timing is done with a chip attached around the ankle. Your time is recorded at the lap timing gate after each completed lap.

Accommodation:
We have a couple of accommodation suggestions for those travelling from further away.

Hotell Iföhus
Approx. 1.3 km from the event venue
hotellifohus.se/

Bromölla Camping & Hostel
Approx. 0.8 km from the event venue
bromollacamping.se/

Camping is not permitted within the event area.

Spectators:
Come and cheer on your friends. The easiest place to follow them is from the start area. Käsebron and the northern sections along Lilla Kungsleden are also nice places to watch.

Race organisers:
Jimmy Schön: 076 105 73 77
Anna Schön: 073 355 64 68
Email: tavling@fyskompaniet.se

name: Rosa Bandet-loppet 2025
description:
Nordic Wellness, together with Öresjö Ängar, invites you to the 2025 Pink Ribbon Run. Join us for a day filled with movement, community and joy—all in support of the Swedish Cancer Society’s Pink Ribbon fundraising campaign.
Date: Saturday, 25 October 2025, 09:30–13:00
Location: Start and finish at the new residential area Öresjö Ängar, Borås (address: Klättergatan 9–11).
Parking is limited, so we recommend travelling by public transport.
Bus 150 to Tosserydsvägen stop

10:00: Children’s race—for the youngest runners, full of encouragement and energy (approx. 350 metres)
11:00: 4 km public race—walk, jog or run; everyone can take part
11:10: Student race—with a focus on costumes. The most creative costume will be crowned the winner
The course covers 3 kilometres on forest trails, with 1 km on asphalt.
Cost
Children’s race: SEK 100
4 km public race: SEK 150
Student race: SEK 120 (Mecenat card must be presented)
All proceeds go directly to the Pink Ribbon campaign.

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description:
Run a marathon distance in backyard format!

A backyard race lasting 6 hours. One 6.7 km lap each hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one 8.7 km lap. 42.195 km in total. Complete the race and you’ll have run a marathon! The first to finish the final lap wins.

The course mostly follows the exercise trail and is generally accessible, though it has moderate elevation changes.

Registration is via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race. The kids’ race is free. See the website for more information.

images.alt_text: Karta över Tyresö Night Run 10 km och 5 km med höjdprofiler.

name: Gävle Adventslopp
description:
Gävle Advent Race is the winter city race that everyone can take part in, young and old, slow and fast.
With this race, we want to inspire the joy of running even during our colder months!

The race starts below the mini-golf course, then runs through beautiful Boulognerskogen and finishes at Boulognerskogen Café, where we serve warm cordial and gingerbread cookies.
Honorary prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and great prizes are also raffled among all participants.

For our youngest runners, we offer the Little Advent Race. The course is 500 m long and starts and finishes near the stage at Boulognerskogen Café.
Before the race, we warm up together with our mascots, the Snowman and the Reindeer.

All information and registration can be found at adventsloppet.se

images.alt_text: Gävle Adventslopp vinterlopp med löpare och julbock.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: The best race of the year, with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is a race of approximately 3 km, or alternatively 6 km, for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog or run—it’s up to you! Run, walk or roll in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. Join us for the most festive day of the year, filled with community, atmosphere and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The whole city is transformed into a running Christmas party, with mulled wine, gingerbread and, of course, a medal for everyone! Buy your place, including a Santa costume, today. All proceeds go to children and young people with disabilities, supporting an active life on their own terms. WELCOME!

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Österlen Spring Trail
description: Österlen Spring Trail was founded in 2015 and can be described as a recreational race where nature, camaraderie and the experience take centre stage, while performance and time are secondary. The race offers all runners, regardless of ability, a fantastic opportunity to take part in one of three distances: 60 km (Simris Alg Ultra), 30 km (Duo Trail) and 22 km (Teleservice trail). It takes place amid the beautiful natural surroundings of Christinehof Castle in Andrarum, Skåne County, and has 500 metres of elevation gain.

name: Nora Marathon
description:
A hilly marathon, most of which is run on asphalt, but also includes gravel roads.
You run four laps.
If you choose the half marathon, you run two laps, and if you choose the quarter marathon, you run one.

name: Uddloppet
description:
Uddloppet is a spring race in Karlshamn, Blekinge, for both recreational and elite runners. It’s a perfect start to the running season and a great way to check your fitness after winter training.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Distances:
4 km (09:45)
10 km (11:00)
Half marathon (11:00)
Children’s race, 400 m (10:30)
Walking class, 2.5 km (between 09:00 and 13:00)

Course: A scenic, gently hilly route along the sea and through the forest east of Karlshamn. Start and finish at Vägga sports ground.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

Practical information: Parking at Vägga IP; changing facilities and showers at Väggahallen. Race numbers can be collected at Intersport in Karlshamn from Wednesday to Saturday, or at the race-day secretariat.
uddloppet.ifudd.se

The event also offers activities for the whole family, including a mascot, prize-giving, face painting and refreshments on site.

organizer: Centralföreningen för Gymnastik- och Idrottssällskap i Göteborg
description: Flat course, mostly on asphalt, around the central parts of Kungsbacka. The world’s oldest annual long-distance race, held every year without interruption since 1898,
additional:
Start at Kungsbacka’s square in central Kungsbacka
Quarter marathon 12:00
Half marathon 13:00

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to enjoy running on Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in the Billingen recreation area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 metres of elevation gain. It goes all the way around northern Billingen, along beautiful trails by the edge of the mountain. Runners will experience varied terrain, including deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows and spruce forest, with beautiful views across the landscape in several places. The surface ranges from easy running to about 6 km of asphalt and some more challenging sections.

The intermediate course, 21 km, follows the northern part of the Billingeleden trail and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain. It includes a mix of trails, meadows and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, has just over 200 metres of elevation gain and follows trails of varying difficulty, with some shorter sections on roads.

Course information and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, 10:00, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.
21 km, 10:45, Björnasäter, Lerdala. Bus departs from the Billingen Recreation Area at 10:05.
12 km, 11:30, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

All finishes are at the stadium.
course_highlights: 47 km around all of northern Billingen — just over 47 km and approximately 930 metres of elevation gain
Varied terrain: deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows, spruce forest and sections of asphalt (about 6 km)
The 12 km course has just over 200 metres of elevation gain; the 21 km course follows the northern part of Billingeleden and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km loop with 400 m of elevation gain. After five loops, you’ll have covered the ultra distance of 50 km and 2,000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail running on singletrack and animal trails through dramatic forest! Welcome!
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories
Isaberg Gravel: a circuit of approximately 45 km, starting and finishing in Åsenhöga; Elite/up to age 50: 3 laps, older riders/sport recreation: 2 laps, recreational: 1 lap
additional: Contact GI by mobile at +46 703 815 118 or email at gimulti@gmail.com. Organisers: GI Folkestad and Martin Jepson. Guided rides for cycling groups can be booked; the organisers have ready-made routes that can be adapted to the group’s needs. Main distance: approximately 10.5 km (Distans Trailtour); Kids Trail: approximately 2 km with approximately 150 metres of elevation gain; start time: Sunday at 12:00; location: Isaberg/Anderstorp; contact: niklas@isabergtrail.se.

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a well-established race for all ages, with children’s races in the morning and adult races at 12:30. Choose between two distances, 6 or 12 kilometres, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it’s not entirely flat…), with the start and finish on Ålstensgatan, giving it perhaps the most impressive start straight in Swedish running. In between, you’ll run along the streets of Bromma, with the feeling of running through gardens in apple blossom. The experience is enhanced by the many neighbours who come out to cheer, or even set up their own small refreshment stations or sprinklers—each offering its own kind of cooling relief. All this has helped inspire the race’s slogan: Stockholm’s most charming running race.

Frosta OK is organising an evening race for the 53rd time during Hörby Market, with three different distances:

Marknadsloppet 12.6 km: the competitive class starts at 18:30, and the recreational class starts at 18:40.

Bil-Månsson loppet 6.1 km: everyone starts at 18:50.

CAN-CAN loppet 3.4 km: everyone starts at 19:00.

The race starts and finishes in central Hörby, with much of the route running through woodland.

Don't miss this opportunity!

name: Mariestads Marathon
description: The race follows the shore of Lake Vänern along a cycle path. It is a lap race: the 7 km distance is one lap, 21.1 km is three laps, and 42.2 km is six laps.
additional: Information will be available on the website.

images.alt_text: Starten av Mariestads Marathon med löpare vid målbannern.

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is the most generous race of the year, where the joy of running meets the beautiful scenery of Djurgården. The course winds along gravel and asphalt roads, offering a wonderful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 people to register will receive a specially designed T-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, a relaxing After Run awaits with a barbecue and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. A portion of the registration fee also goes to Sweden for UNHCR, so every step counts—for you and for someone in need.

name: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE
description: Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is the trail adventure for those who love experiences, running and beautiful nature. Choose to run 42 km, 21 km or 10 km, and the children can also take part in Barnens Fjällmaraton. Along mountain trails, paths, boardwalks and gravel roads, nature will challenge you on your way to the finish and the After Run at Experiumtorget in Lindvallen. Fjällmaraton Sälen by EQPE is a deluxe running challenge! Join us and experience the joy of running in the mountains!

images.alt_text: Lycklig löpare med armarna i luften under Fjällmaraton Sälen i vacker fjällnatur.
Deltagare springer i Fjällmaraton Sälen på en träspång genom fjällandskap.
Fjällmaraton Sälen med löpare i naturskön fjällterräng. 10/21/42 km den 29 augusti 2026.

name: Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Experience Borås at its best—run Kretsloppet! On September 19, we’ll once again fill the streets of Borås with runners of all ages for a running festival you have to experience. Sign up with family, friends and colleagues, and cross the finish line to the cheers of the crowd in the heart of Borås city centre. All courses are on asphalt, relatively flat and in central Borås. name: Änglamilen
description: Änglamilen is a long-established fun run in the heart of Ängelholm. Participants experience the town, the sea and the forest all in the same 10 kilometres. The 5 km race begins with a lovely run through the park in the charming Hembygdsparken. After approximately 2.7 km, the course crosses the Rönne River and continues along the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen. Finally, the course turns back across the river, with a sprint to the finish at Tullakrok. The 10 km course starts the same way as the 5 km route, but turns north after about a kilometre. Runners are treated to beautiful views over Skälderviken and its harbour, with Kullaberg visible in the background. After approximately 7.7 km, the courses join again, and runners can enjoy the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen.
additional:
The deadline for standard registration is 18 May, but late registration is available until one hour before the start of each race.

name: Backyard Ulötra Sölvesborg
description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!

name: Säve Trail Run
description: Säve Trail Run is a trail race in Säve where you run along trails, through forests and across open landscapes, away from asphalt and the noise of the city. Choose between 12 km, 7 km or 2 km—each route features varied and challenging terrain. Along the way, course marshals and cheers create an encouraging atmosphere, and the hydration stations offer sports drink from local brand UMARA. The start and finish are at Säve Sports Club, where runners, family and friends gather in a simple, welcoming atmosphere. Whether it’s your first trail race or one of many, you set your own pace—the experience is what counts.

name: Fredsloppet
description: Fredsloppet 2026 is a peace and solidarity race held at several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm, between 15 August and 18 October 2026. The event is more than a running race; it is an expression of peace, justice and solidarity, supporting Palestinian and Cuban organisations. Participants can choose from different distances, including 5 km and 10 km, as well as walking categories and mini peace races for children. The event encourages people to organise their own Fredsloppet races, and the surplus goes to peace and solidarity work.
course_highlights: Several locations in Sweden, including Stockholm
Distances for all ages and levels, including children’s and family races
Focus on peace, solidarity and justice, supporting Palestinian organisations
additional: 75% of the proceeds go to Palestinian aid, and the event celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. Participants can register via fredsloppet.se. The event includes water stations, medals and the option to register on the day.

name: Häljebodaloppet
description: You run or walk 7.3 km through beautiful scenery on gravel roads and along a section of the Finnskogleden trail. The race has received a lot of praise for its scenic course.
additional: Prizes will be awarded, including a perpetual trophy from Magnor Glassworks (one for the men and one for the women), as well as first, second and third prizes in each class. A “mountain prize” will also go to the first woman and the first man to reach the course’s highest point. Those who prefer to take it a little easier won’t go home empty-handed either. All participants receive a certificate, and there will be a draw based on race numbers.
